### [365] [Polylogarithmic Approximation for Covering and Connecting Multi-Interface Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06899)
*Michał Szyfelbein,Camille Richer*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究异构成本下多接口网络（IoT 设备）的两个 min-max 近似问题：Coverage（每条边两端需共享至少一个被激活的接口）与 Connectivity（被激活接口诱导的子图需连通/生成）。两者均建模为 ILP 并求 LP 松弛，再做 Set Cover 风格的随机取整。Coverage 得到 O(log n) 近似（紧，因其泛化 Set Cover）以及确定性的 k-近似（k 为接口类型数）；Connectivity 通过在 LP 中加入基于流的割约束保证连通，采样得到连通子图 H 后迭代随机取整，得到 O(log² n) 近似——这是该问题首个非平凡近似算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT 网络设计需要在资源受限的设备上激活通信接口以建立连接，但设备可用接口类型不同、且同一接口在不同设备上代价不同（异构成本）。已有研究主要局限于同构（成本仅依赖接口类型）情形：Coverage 的 min-max 变体在异构成本下缺乏有效的对数近似（此前最好结果为依赖图参数 b 的 O(b·log n)，b 可达 Ω(n)），而 Connectivity 的 min-max 变体甚至没有任何非平凡近似算法（此前仅有 min-sum 的 4-近似等结果）。因此，作者希望在异构成本、min-max 目标下为这两个基础问题提供首个多项式对数级近似算法。

Method: 1) 记号与模型：G=(V,E) 连通简单图，λ: V→2^[k] 给出顶点可用接口，c: [k]×V→N≥0 为异构成本，cost(λ_A)=max_v Σ_{i∈λ_A(v)} c(i,v)（min-max 目标）；Coverage 要求 cov(λ_A)=E，Connectivity 要求 G_A=(V,cov(λ_A)) 连通。

2) 预处理（Appendix B）：多项式次猜测幂次 2^b 并缩放，使所有成本落在 [0,1] 且 OPT≥1/2；再按顶点总可用接口成本是否 ≤1 把顶点分为 cheap（可假设全激活）与 expensive（可假设分析解中 cost(v,λ_A)≥1），并对每个猜测重复 K=⌈log_m C⌉+1 次随机过程以保证高概率成功。

3) Coverage 的 ILP：变量 x_{i,v}∈{0,1}；约束 (1) 每个顶点成本 ≤ 全局 M；(2) 每条边 uv 要求 Σ_{i∈λ(u)∩λ(v)} min{x_{i,u},x_{i,v}} ≥ 1，用辅助变量 z_{i,uv} 线性化；(3) cheap 顶点固定全激活、expensive 顶点要求加权成本 ≥1。求其 LP 松弛。

4) 算法 1（k-近似，无需预处理）：解 LP 后取 λ_A(v)={i: x_{i,v} ≥ 1/k}。由平均性存在某接口在两端均 ≥1/k，故覆盖成立；成本 ≤ k·LP值 ≤ k·OPT。

5) 算法 2（O(log n) 近似）：为每个接口类型 i 抽独立均匀阈值 t_i∈[0,1]，在 v 处激活 i 当且仅当 2 ln m·x_{i,v} ≥ t_i。引理 3.3：用 1-x ≤ e^{-x} 与并合界，单条边不被覆盖概率 ≤ exp{-2 ln m·Σ min{x_{i,u},x_{i,v}}} ≤ 1/m²，故覆盖以概率 ≥1−1/m 成立。引理 3.4：E[cost(v,λ_A)] = 2 ln m·Σ c(i,v)x_{i,v} ≥ 2 ln m，用 Chernoff（δ=2）得单点成本超过 3 倍期望的概率 ≤ e^{-E[cost]} ≤ 1/m²，再对 n 个顶点并合，得 cost(λ_A) ≤ 6 ln m·OPT ≤ 12 ln n·OPT。

6) Connectivity 的 ILP：除 x_{i,v} 外增加边变量 y_{uv}（表示边被覆盖），约束 (6) Σ min{x_{i,u},x_{i,v}} ≥ y_{uv}，以及全局割约束 (8) y(δ(S)) ≥ 1（对所有非平凡 S）。割约束数量为指数级，但可用 max-flow 分离预言机 + 椭球法多项式时间求解 LP 松弛。

7) 算法 3（O(log² n) 近似）：(a) 以 p_e = min{1, 5 ln m·y_e} 独立采样得到边集 H；引理 4.2 证明 H 连通：对每个割 S 有 y(δ(S)) ≥1，取 ℓ≤y(δ(S))<ℓ+1，则 Pr[δ_H(S)=∅] ≤ exp{-5ℓ ln m} = m^{-5ℓ}；结合 Karger 引理（α-最小割个数 ≤ n^{2α}）与 ℓ 的枚举、并合界得失败概率 ≤ Σ_ℓ n^{2ℓ+2}/m^{5ℓ} ≤ 1/(m−1)（利用 m≥n；树的情形 Coverage 与 Connectivity 等价，直接用 O(log n) 算法）。(b) 迭代 T = 2 ln m/(1−1/e) 轮：每轮为每个接口类型抽阈值 t_i，激活 i 于满足 5 ln m·x_{i,v} ≥ t_i 的顶点，取各轮并集。引理 4.4：单轮覆盖 H 中未覆盖边的期望比例 ≥ 1−1/e（用 1−e^{-x} ≥ (1−1/e)x）；引理 4.5：E[|E(H_j)|] ≤ m e^{-α(j−1)}，Markov 不等式给出 Pr[I>T] = O(1/m)；引理 4.6：单轮单点成本以概率 ≥1−1/m⁵ 不超过 15 ln m·OPT，对 n 个顶点与 T 轮并合（失败概率 O(1/m³)），故总成本 ≤ T·15 ln m·OPT ≤ 120 ln²n/(1−1/e)·OPT。

8) 概率工具：文中给出加权 Chernoff 界的自包含证明（Appendix A）。

Result: Coverage：得到 O(log n) 随机近似（高概率成功），因问题泛化 Set Cover 而紧，匹配此前 Ω(log n) 下界（星图、单位成本），并把同构情形下 O(ln Δ + b·min{ln Δ, c_max}) 的结果推广到异构成本、同时改进 O(b·log n) 的算法；同一 LP 松弛的确定性取整给出 k-近似（k 为接口类型数），推广了同构情形的 1+(k−2)(c_max/2c_min) 近似。Connectivity：得到 O(log² n) 随机近似，为该问题首个非平凡近似算法（min-max 变体）。注意摘要用 O(log m)/O(log² m) 表述，正文实际给出 O(log n)/O(log² n)（m≤n² 故等价）。

Conclusion: 本文首次为多接口网络的 Coverage 与 Connectivity（min-max、异构成本）提供了多项式对数级近似：分别为 O(log n)（几乎紧）与 O(log² n)。遗留问题：Connectivity 的 O(log² n) 与下界 Ω(log Δ) 之间仍有差距（星图上 Connectivity 等价于 Coverage，故下界同样适用）；作者亦指出 min-sum 变体可沿用同一思路（算法 1 可直接适配），并留待未来工作。

Abstract: We study problems related to connecting multi-interface networks of wireless devices. These problems are modeled using graphs, where vertices represent the devices and edges represent potential communication links. Each vertex can activate multiple interfaces, and a connection between two vertices is established if they share at least one common active interface. We consider two problems arising in multi-interface networks: Coverage and Connectivity. In the Coverage problem, every connection defined in the network must be established, while in the Connectivity problem, groups of terminals specified in the input should be connected. The solution should minimize the maximum cost incurred by a vertex or the total cost incurred by all vertices. In this work we are interested in approximating the former of the two cost criterions.
  We model both problems using ILPs and we design approximation algorithms based on a randomized rounding of the solution of the linear programming relaxation. For the Coverage problem, this yields an $O(\log m)$-approximation algorithm, which is tight, since the problem generalizes Set-Cover. This improves upon the $O(b\cdot\log n)$-approximation algorithm, where $b$ is a certain graph parameter which can be as large as $Ω(n)$ [Algorithmica '12]. The same relaxation can also be used to get an $k$-approximation algorithm, where $k$ is the number of different interfaces. This generalizes a similar result for the uniform cost case. For the Connectivity problem, we obtain an $O(\log^2 m)$-approximation algorithm, which is the first non-trivial approximation algorithm for this problem. The algorithm is based on a similar LP relaxation with additional cut constraints to ensure connectivity. The rounding procedure is similar to the one for the Coverage problem but requires a more careful analysis to ensure that the connectivity constraints are satisfied.

</details>


### [366] [Accelerated Relax-and-Round for Concave Coverage Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06900)
*Matthew Fahrbach,Mehraneh Liaee,Morteza Zadimoghaddam*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出用于凹覆盖问题的加速松弛-舍入算法，通过投影加速梯度法和平面 Carathéodory 分解结合随机交换舍入技术，在O(mn ε^-1)时间内实现紧近似保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 改进Barman等人(STACS 2021)的relax-and-round框架，通过加速技术提升凹覆盖问题的计算效率。

Method: 用投影加速梯度法替代线性规划松弛，结合Karalias等人的Carathéodory分解算法与Chekuri等人的随机交换舍入，构成 hypersimplex 的专门舍入方案。

Result: 时间复杂度达O(mn ε^-1)，对数奖励函数获得0.827的紧近似比。

Conclusion: 实验表明该算法在最大多覆盖问题上优于使用最先进LP求解器的方法，证明了加速技术在组合优化松弛-舍入框架中的实用价值。

Abstract: We present an accelerated relax-and-round algorithm for concave coverage problems, which generalize the classic maximum coverage problem. Building on the relax-and-round framework of Barman et al. [STACS 2021], we propose two significant improvements. First, we replace the linear programming (LP) relaxation step with a projected accelerated gradient method applied to a smooth surrogate objective to achieve a $\widetilde{O}(mn \varepsilon^{-1})$ running time. Second, we use a specialized rounding scheme for the hypersimplex that combines the Carathéodory decomposition algorithm in Karalias et al. [NeurIPS 2025] with randomized swap rounding of Chekuri et al. [FOCS 2010]. We prove tight approximation ratios for new reward functions, including a $0.827$-approximation for the logarithmic reward $\varphi(x) = \log(1 + x)$. Finally, we conduct maximum multi-coverage experiments on synthetic and real-world graphs, demonstrating that our algorithm outperforms approaches that use state-of-the-art LP solvers.

</details>


### [367] [Modern column generation for estimating single- and multi-purchase ranked list choice models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06948)
*Luciano Costa,Gerardo Berbeglia,Claudio Contardo,Jean-François Cordeau*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 提出列生成框架结合动态规划算法估计排名列表离散选择模型，支持单次和多次购买，实现指数级加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 排名列表离散选择模型中消费者类型数量指数爆炸，传统方法计算不可行

Method: 列生成框架 + 动态规划子问题算法（推广线性排序问题）+ 加速技术

Result: 首个动态规划生成消费者类型的方法，显著加速且保持解质量

Conclusion: 该框架可扩展支持多模型变体，有效应用于估计和 assortment 优化

Abstract: This paper studies the estimation of ranked-list discrete choice models with single and multiple purchases. In this setting, each consumer type is characterized by a ranking over a subset of products and a desired number of purchases, and the estimation task is to identify the set of consumer types and their probabilities that best explain the observed transactional data. This problem is computationally challenging due to the exponential number of possible consumer types and becomes more difficult when multiple purchases are allowed. We propose a column generation framework for this problem. Our main contribution is a dynamic programming algorithm for the column generation subproblem. This subproblem generalizes the linear ordering problem and incorporates acceleration techniques to improve computational efficiency. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dynamic programming-based approach for generating consumer types in non-parametric models. The proposed framework supports multiple model variants with minor modifications. Computational experiments on synthetic and real data show substantial speedups over existing methods while maintaining high solution quality, and demonstrate effectiveness in both estimation and assortment optimization.

</details>


### [368] [Equivalence of Coarse and Fine-Grained Models for Learning with Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07005)
*Adam R. Klivans,Shyamal Patel,Konstantinos Stavropoulos,Arsen Vasilyan*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文证明了分布转移学习中两种模型（PQ学习和TDS学习）在分布无关设置下是等价的，并通过对分支程序的弱区分能力进行增强，给出了从PQ到TDS学习的黑盒归约。这导致了第一个TDS学习半空间等基本类的困难性结果，但成员查询可以规避这些困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在探索两种主要的分布转移学习模型（PQ学习和TDS学习）之间的关系。PQ学习器仅能拒绝单个离群点，而TDS学习器可以拒绝整个测试集，研究者好奇这两种看似不同的能力是否等价。

Method: 主要技术贡献包括：1）通过分支程序（branching programs）增强已拒绝目标域的TDS学习器的弱区分能力；2）给出从PQ学习到TDS学习的有效黑盒归约；3）使用迭代算法，通过在训练数据上应用连续Forster变换来恢复大间隔分离器。

Result: 证明了PQ学习和TDS学习在分布无关设置下是等价的；给出了第一个TDS学习基本类（如半空间）的计算困难性结果；在赋予成员查询访问权限后，成功实现了半空间的分布无关PQ可学习性。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了PQ学习和TDS学习在分布无关设置下是等价的，并给出了第一个TDS学习基本类（如半空间）的困难性结果。然而，赋予学习器成员查询能力可以规避这些困难性，实现半空间的有效分布无关PQ可学习性。

Abstract: Recent work on provably efficient algorithms for learning with distribution shift has focused on two models: PQ learning (Goldwasser et al. (2020)) and TDS learning (Klivans et al. (2024)). Algorithms for TDS learning are allowed to reject a test set entirely if distribution shift is detected. In contrast, PQ learners may only reject points that are deemed out-of-distribution on an individual basis. Our main result is a surprising equivalence between these two models in the distribution-free setting. In particular, we give an efficient black-box reduction from PQ learning to TDS learning for any Boolean concept class. This equivalence implies the first hardness results for distribution-free TDS learning of basic classes such as halfspaces. The main technical contribution underlying our equivalence is a method for boosting, via branching programs, the weak distinguishing power of TDS learners that have rejected the target domain.
  We also show that giving a learner access to membership queries sidesteps these hardness results and allows for efficient, distribution-free PQ learnability of halfspaces. Our algorithm iteratively recovers large-margin separators obtained by applying successive Forster transforms on the training data.

</details>


### [369] [Estimating Correlation Clustering Cost in Node-Arrival Stream](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07091)
*Kaiwen Liu,Seba Daniela Villalobos,Qin Zhang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了节点到达数据流模型下的相关性聚类问题，提出C⁴Approx流式算法，仅使用节点数量的亚线性空间和常数次遍历即可近似最优聚类代价，并通过仅存储2%的节点达到与Pivot和PrunedPivot算法相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统相关性聚类研究主要关注边流模型，但现实场景（如图像、推文等原始对象的数据流）中，节点信息自然产生，相似/不相似边通过相似度函数推导得出。现有方法难以直接应用于此类场景，因此需要研究仅依赖节点信息的流式聚类算法。

Method: 提出C⁴Approx流式算法，采用亚线性空间和常数次遍历策略，通过对节点进行选择性采样和相似度计算，在单遍或多遍数据流中实现相关性聚类成本的近似优化。

Result: 实验表明，C⁴Approx仅需存储2%的节点即可达到与经典Pivot算法及近期PrunedPivot算法相当的性能，且在稀疏图上表现优异。理论方面提供了该问题的下界证明。

Conclusion: C⁴Approx为节点到达数据流模型下的相关性聚类提供了有效的近似算法，兼具理论保证和实用价值，开辟了流式聚类研究的新方向。

Abstract: We study the correlation clustering problem in the node-arrival data stream model. Unlike previous work, where the stream consists of the graph's edges, we focus on the setting in which the stream contains only the nodes. This model better reflects many real-world scenarios in which the data stream naturally consists of raw objects (e.g., images, tweets), and the similar/dissimilar edges are derived through a similarity function. We present C$^4$Approx, a streaming algorithm that approximates the cost of correlation clustering using sublinear space in the number of nodes and a constant number of passes. We further complement this result with lower bounds. Experiments on real-world datasets show that by storing only 2% of the nodes, our algorithm achieves performance comparable to the classic Pivot algorithm and the more recent PrunedPivot algorithm, even on sparse graphs.

</details>


### [370] [Deterministic Monotone Min-Plus Product and Convolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07150)
*Ce Jin,Jaewoo Park,Barna Saha,Yinzhan Xu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种确定性算法来解决单调最小加法积问题，时间复杂度为 n^(ω+3)/2+o(1) = O(n^2.686)，与现有随机算法相同，同时去掉了随机化这一缺点。该方法可应用于多种下游问题，包括语言编辑距离、RNA折叠、树编辑距离等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最快的单调最小加法积算法虽然将时间复杂度从 O(n³) 优化到 O(n^2.686)，但依赖随机化，这会导致所有下游应用也继承随机化特性，在需要确定性保证的场景中不适用。

Method: 通过去随机化技术消除算法中的随机性，同时保持相同的时间复杂度。该方法具有通用性，可推广到矩形矩阵、有界范围 [n^μ] 和列单调矩阵等变体。

Result: 得到确定性算法，时间复杂度为 n^(ω+3)/2+o(1) = O(n^2.686)，改进了之前确定性上界 O(n^2.875)。同时得到确定性单调最小加法卷积算法，时间复杂度为 n^1.5+o(1)。

Conclusion: 去随机化技术成功应用于多个问题，包括语言编辑距离、RNA折叠、最优栈生成、无权重树编辑距离、批量范围众数和近似全对最短路径等。

Abstract: The Monotone Min-Plus Product problem is a useful primitive that has seen many algorithmic applications over the past decade. In this problem, we are given two $n\times n$ integer matrices $A$ and $B$, where each row of $B$ is a monotone non-decreasing sequence of integers from $\{1,\dots,n\}$, and the goal is to compute their Min-Plus product, defined as the $n\times n$ matrix $C$ with $C_{i,j} = \min_{k}\{A_{i,k} + B_{k,j}\}$. The fastest known algorithm for this task [Chi, Duan, Xie, and Zhang, STOC'22] runs in $n^{(ω+3)/2+o(1)} = O(n^{2.686})$ time, significantly improving over the brute-force cubic algorithm. However, its main disadvantage is that it requires randomization, which is then inherited by all downstream applications.
  Our main result is a deterministic algorithm for Monotone Min-Plus product with the same time complexity $n^{(ω+3)/2+o(1)} = O(n^{2.686})$ as its randomized counterpart, improving upon the previous deterministic bound $O(n^{2.875})$ [Gu, Polak, Vassilevska Williams, and Xu, ICALP'21]. Our derandomization also applies to previously studied extensions and variants (e.g., [Dürr, IPL'23]), including rectangular matrices, bounded range $[n^μ]$, and column-monotone matrices. As an immediate consequence, we derandomize state-of-the-art algorithms for multiple problems, including Language Edit Distance, RNA Folding, Optimum Stack Generation, unweighted Tree Edit Distance, Batched Range Mode, and Approximate All-Pairs Shortest Paths.
  Our techniques also yield a deterministic algorithm for the Monotone Min-Plus Convolution problem that runs in $n^{1.5+o(1)}$ time, nearly matching the best known randomized time complexity $\widetilde{O}(n^{1.5})$ [Chi, Duan, Xie, and Zhang, STOC'22]. This algorithm can be used to derandomize state-of-the-art algorithms for Jumbled Indexing for binary strings and several variants of Knapsack.

</details>


### [371] [Connectivity Oracle Under Vertex Failures by Shortcutting Unbreakable Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07168)
*Xizhe Li,Yaowei Long,David Pidugu,Thatchaphol Saranurak,Benyu Wang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We present an improved connectivity oracle under vertex failures that achieves near-linear space and preprocessing time, O(k^6) update time independent of n, and O(k) optimal query time. This improves upon prior work by reducing space from quadratic to near-linear and exponentially improving preprocessing and update/query times through three new techniques: shortcutting over tree decomposition, bootstrapping with n-dependent oracles, and a new patch set mechanism.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Prior connectivity oracles with n-independent update time either require Ω(n²) space or incur 2^{2^{O(k)}} update and query time. Additionally, their preprocessing time is polynomially large in n, far from near-linear. These limitations make prior approaches impractical for large-scale graphs.

Method: We build on the unbreakable decomposition framework of [PSS+22] with three novel contributions: (i) shortcutting over the tree decomposition to achieve near-linear space, (ii) bootstrapping using n-dependent oracles internally to achieve near-linear preprocessing, and (iii) a new patch set mechanism to achieve conditionally optimal O(k) query time.

Result: For constant k, the oracle uses near-linear space and near-linear preprocessing time. After k vertex failures, it performs an O(k^6)-time update independent of graph size n, and answers pairwise connectivity queries in optimal O(k) time.

Conclusion: Our oracle improves upon all prior n-independent update time oracles by achieving near-linear space, near-linear preprocessing time, O(k^6) update time, and O(k) query time. For constant k, this represents space reduction from quadratic to near-linear, and exponential improvement in preprocessing time over prior polynomial-in-n approaches.

Abstract: We give an improved connectivity oracle under vertex failures. After a set of $k$ vertices fails, our oracle performs an $O(k^{6})$-time update independent of the graph size $n$, and then answers pairwise connectivity queries in optimal $O(k)$ time. For constant $k$, it uses near-linear space and can be built in near-linear preprocessing time.
  In contrast, all prior oracles with $n$-independent update time[PSS+22, vdBS19] either require $Ω(n^{2})$ space or incur $2^{2^{O(k)}}$ update and query time. Moreover, their preprocessing time is polynomially large in $n$, far from near-linear.
  Our oracle builds on the unbreakable decomposition framework of[PSS+22], but introduces three new ingredients: (i) shortcutting over the tree decomposition to reduce space from quadratic to near-linear, (ii) bootstrapping that leverages $n$-dependent oracles internally to obtain near-linear preprocessing, and (iii) a new patch set mechanism that yields conditionally optimal $O(k)$ query time.

</details>


### [372] [EPTAS for Hard Graph Cut Problems for Dense Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07265)
*Kaisei Deguchi,Ken-ichi Kawarabayashi,Hiroaki Mori*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文针对everywhere-Ω(1)-稠密图上的基本最小化问题，提出首个高效多项式时间近似方案(EPTAS)，主要贡献是基于弱正则引理设计ConstrainedMinCut的EPTAS，并统一约简得到MinQuotientCut和ProductSparsestCut的EPTAS，避开了之前工作中使用的Lasserre层级或整数规划等复杂工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图割问题的PTAS算法存在运行时间 n^(f(1/ε)) 的瓶颈，对于实际应用而言效率不足，需要将PTAS改进为运行时间仅为 f(1/ε)n^(O(1)) 的EPTAS。

Method: 基于弱正则引理(weak regularity lemma)和采样估计技术(sampling and estimation techniques)设计ConstrainedMinCut的EPTAS，然后通过统一约简将算法作为子程序调用，获得MinQuotientCut和ProductSparsestCut的EPTAS。

Result: 给出四个经典问题的首个EPTAS：ConstrainedMinCut(捕获BalancedSeparator和SmallSetExpansion)、MinQuotientCut、ProductSparsestCut，以及稠密顶点权重的整数版本。

Conclusion: 提出了首个基于弱正则引理和采样估计技术的ConstrainedMinCut的EPTAS算法，并由此统一约简得到MinQuotientCut和ProductSparsestCut的EPTAS。相比之前依赖Lasserre层级或整数规划技术的方法，本方法更加简洁通用。

Abstract: Everywhere-$δ$-dense graphs are defined as graphs on $n$ vertices in which every vertex has degree at least $δn$ for some constant $δ> 0$.
  Approximation schemes are vital for handling NP-hard optimization problems, but for many graph cut problems, existing PTAS algorithms often suffer from running times of $n^{f(1/\varepsilon)}$.
  In this paper, we bring PTASs down to EPTASs for several fundamental minimization problems on everywhere-$Ω(1)$-dense graphs.
  Specifically, we present the first Efficient Polynomial-Time Approximation Scheme (EPTAS), running in time $f(1/\varepsilon)n^{O(1)}$, for the ConstrainedMinCut problem under a global constraint on vertex weights, a problem that captures BalancedSeparator and SmallSetExpansion.
  Moreover, we give the first EPTASs for MinQuotientCut and ProductSparsestCut on everywhere-$δ$-dense graphs with integer-valued dense vertex weights;
  these problems generalize the four well-known problems UniformSparsestCut, EdgeExpansion, Conductance, and NormalizedCut.
  Our main technical contribution is an EPTAS for ConstrainedMinCut, based on the weak regularity lemma and sampling and estimation techniques.
  We then obtain EPTASs for MinQuotientCut and ProductSparsestCut via a unified reduction that invokes this algorithm as a subroutine.
  In contrast, previous works giving PTASs for these problems on everywhere-$δ$-dense graphs typically rely on powerful tools such as the Lasserre hierarchy or specific integer programming technique, which we avoid.

</details>


### [373] [On the Complexity of the Matching Problem of Regular Expressions with Backreferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07289)
*Soh Kumabe,Yuya Uezato*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究带回溯引用的正则表达式（REWBs）的字符串匹配问题的细粒度复杂度。对于硬性下界，证明k-REWBs在SETH下无法在O(n^{2k-ε})时间内解决，且该问题以表达式长度为参数时是W[2]-难的；对于算法上界，为1-use REWBs提出了O(n log² n)时间的算法，显著优于之前最新的O(n²)算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReDoS攻击（如2016年Stack Overflow和2019年Cloudflare事件）表明，即使二次复杂度的正则表达式匹配引擎也可能被恶意利用，造成系统资源耗尽。带回溯引用的正则表达式（REWBs）具有强大的表达能力，但大大增加了ReDoS风险。核心问题是：能否构建可证明高效的正则表达式匹配引擎？

Method: 1. 归约方法：利用SETH（指数时间假设）证明下界，通过从正则语言成员性问题的下界归约；2. 参数复杂性分析：以表达式长度为参数，采用W[1]/W[2]-难性框架；3. 算法设计：结合后缀树、正则表达式的转换幺半群、分解森林数据结构和字符串周期性质。

Result: 硬性下界：(1) k-REWBs无法在O(n^{2k-ε})时间内解决（基于SETH）；(2) 以表达式长度为参数时是W[2]-难的（强于之前的W[1]-难）；(3) 2-use 2-REWBs无法在n^{1+o(1)}时间内解决（除非三角形检测问题可在该时间内解决）。算法上界：1-use REWBs可在O(n log² n)时间内解决。

Conclusion: 带回溯引用的正则表达式匹配问题具有固有的计算困难性，即使简单的2-use 2-REWB实例也无法达到线性时间。对于实际应用中广泛使用的1-use REWBs，O(n log² n)算法提供了有效且可证明高效的解决方案，为构建安全的正则表达式引擎提供了理论依据。

Abstract: ReDoS is a well-known type of algorithmic complexity attack, where an adversary supplies maliciously crafted strings to a regular expression matching engine, aiming to exhaust computational resources of systems. Even quadratic-time behavior in matching engines has been exploited in successful attacks, as exemplified by major outages at Stack Overflow (2016) and Cloudflare (2019). These incidents motivate a fundamental question: Is it possible to construct matching engines that are provably efficient, running in (near-)linear time in the length of the input string?
  For classical regular expressions (REGEX), Thompson's construction yields a linear-time algorithm. However, practical engines support powerful features such as backreferences, which strictly extend the expressive power of REGEX but unfortunately increase the risk of ReDoS attacks.
  This paper investigates the fine-grained complexity of the string matching problem for regular expressions with backreferences (REWBs). Specifically, we consider $r$-use $k$-REWBs.
  On the hardness side, we show that the string matching problem for $k$-REWBs cannot be solved in $O(n^{2k-ε})$ time for any $ε> 0$ under SETH. We also prove that this problem is \textbf{W[2]}-hard when parameterized by the length of the REWB expression, strengthening the previous \textbf{W[1]}-hardness. Moreover, we prove that this problem for $2$-use $2$-REWBs cannot be solved in $n^{1+o(1)}$ time unless the triangle detection problem can be solved in that time.
  On the algorithmic side, we present an $O(n \log^2 n)$-time algorithm for $1$-use REWBs, which significantly improves upon the recent $O(n^2)$-time algorithm by Nogami and Terauchi (MFCS, 2025). Our algorithm employs several techniques including suffix trees, transition monoids of REGEXes, factorization forest data structures, and periodicity of strings.

</details>


### [374] [Optimal Learning-Augmented Algorithm for Online Bidding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07349)
*Changyeol Lee,Dahoon Lee,Jongseo Lee,Yongho Shin,Changki Yun*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了学习增强在线竞价算法中随机设置下的鲁棒性与一致性权衡问题。通过引入竞价档案概念并利用延迟微分方程系统刻画最优策略，成功证明了提出的随机算法达到了Pareto最优性能，并将其方法推广至线性搜索问题取得了显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在随机设置下，在线竞价学习增强算法中鲁棒性与一致性之间的权衡界限尚未完全理解，现有上界与下界之间存在差距，需要寻找Pareto最优的随机算法来填补这一理论空白。

Method: 提出了竞价档案（bidding profile）这一新型框架，用于表示算法生成的出价分布；证明了任何竞价算法都可以无损约简为基于竞价档案的算法；通过延迟微分方程系统刻画了最优竞价档案的数学特征。

Result: 提出了Pareto最优的随机学习增强竞价算法，完整闭合了随机设置下的理论与实践差距，并将该方法成功扩展到线性搜索问题，显著提升了现有学习增强算法的性能。

Conclusion: 本研究通过引入竞价档案概念和延迟微分方程系统，成功闭合了随机学习增强算法中鲁棒性与一致性之间的界限，并展示了该方法在解决线性搜索问题中的广泛适用性，为在线优化领域提供了重要的理论突破。

Abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have spurred significant interest in learning-augmented algorithms, particularly for online optimization. A growing body of work has studied online bidding in this framework, aiming to characterize the trade-off between robustness and consistency. While this trade-off is fully understood for deterministic algorithms, a gap between upper and lower bounds remains in the randomized setting. In this paper, we close this gap by presenting a Pareto-optimal randomized learning-augmented algorithm for this problem. Our approach introduces the notion of a bidding profile, a novel framework for representing the distribution over bids generated by an algorithm. We show that any bidding algorithm can be reduced, without loss of generality, to one driven by a bidding profile, and we characterize the optimal profile via a system of delayed differential equations. Finally, we demonstrate the broader applicability of our approach by extending it to the linear search problem, yielding a significant improvement over prior learning-augmented algorithms for linear search.

</details>


### [375] [Coordinated Motion Planning is FPT on Discretized Simple Polygons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07570)
*Argyrios Deligkas,Eduard Eiben,Robert Ganian,Iyad Kanj*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: This paper presents an FPT algorithm for the coordinated motion planning problem (minimizing total travel length) parameterized by the number of robots, on graphs from discretizations of simple polygons. This extends previous FPT results from full grids and bounded-treewidth graphs to a broader class of graphs, advancing the understanding of the problem's parameterized complexity on subgrids and planar graphs.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Coordinated motion planning has many real-world applications requiring planar motion in discretized polygonal environments. While the problem is NP-hard in general and known to be FPT only on full grids and bounded-treewidth graphs, its parameterized complexity on subgrids and planar graphs remains a prominent open problem.

Method: The paper develops a fixed-parameter algorithm parameterized by the number k of robots, targeting graphs arising from discretizations of simple polygons (which generalize rectangular grids).

Result: A fixed-parameter algorithm for coordinated motion planning parameterized by the number k of robots on graphs from simple polygon discretizations.

Conclusion: This work provides the first FPT algorithm for coordinated motion planning on polygonal discretization graphs, extending the known FPT results beyond full grids and bounded-treewidth graphs, and represents significant progress toward understanding the parameterized complexity of this problem on subgrids and planar graphs.

Abstract: In the coordinated motion planning problem, we are given a graph together with the starting and destination vertices of $k$ robots. At each time step, any subset of robots may move, each traversing an edge of the graph, provided that no two robots collide. The goal is to compute a schedule that routes all robots to their destinations while minimizing some objective function. In this paper, we focus on the well-studied objective of minimizing the total travel length of all robots. This problem is known to be NP-hard, and it has been shown to be fixed-parameter tractable (FPT), when parameterized by the number $k$ of robots, on full grids (SoCG 2023) and on bounded-treewidth graphs (ICALP 2024).
  We present a fixed-parameter algorithm for coordinated motion planning, parameterized by the number $k$ of robots, on graphs arising from discretizations of simple polygons. Such graphs are of particular interest in real-world applications, where planar motion is often constrained to discretized representations of polygonal environments. Moreover, these graphs generalize rectangular grids; consequently, our result constitutes a significant step toward resolving the parameterized complexity of coordinated motion planning on subgrids and, ultimately, planar graphs -- two prominent open problems in the field.

</details>


### [376] [Faster Deterministic Streaming Vertex Coloring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07644)
*Shiri Chechik,Hongyi Chen,Tianyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了半流模型下的确定性图着色问题。之前已知随机算法可单次遍历达到(Δ+1)着色，而确定性算法若单次遍历则需要指数级颜色数。本文提出首个确定性算法，在O(√log Δ)次遍历内实现O(Δ)着色，首次同时达到线性调色板大小和亚对数遍历次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图着色是计算机科学基础问题。在半流模型中，图以边流形式输入，内存限制为Ñ(n)位。已知随机与确定性算法间存在指数级分离：随机算法可单次遍历达到(Δ+1)着色，但确定性单次遍历算法需要exp(Δ^Ω(1))种颜色。之前最好的确定性结果是O(Δ)着色需要O(log Δ)次遍历，或O(Δ²)着色需2次遍历。是否存在亚对数遍历且线性调色板的确定性算法一直是开放问题。

Method: 论文设计了新的确定性半流算法，关键创新在于利用了根号对数级别的遍历次数来换取线性调色板大小。算法应采用了类似于 Lovász 局部引理 的方法，结合图着色的现有技术，通过多次遍历逐步缩小颜色选择范围。

Result: 论文证明存在确定性半流算法可在O(√log Δ)次遍历内计算得到O(Δ)着色。这是首个同时满足两个条件的确定性算法：调色板大小线性依赖于Δ，且遍历复杂度亚对数依赖于Δ。

Conclusion: 该结果首次在确定性算法中打破了"线性调色板大小"与"亚对数遍历"之间的权衡壁垒，表明在多遍历设置下，确定性算法可以几乎达到与随机算法相同的着色质量（调色板大小方面）。

Abstract: Graph coloring is a fundamental problem in computer science. In the semi-streaming model, an input graph $G$ on $n$ vertices and maximum degree $Δ$ is presented as a stream of edges, and the goal is to compute a vertex coloring using a small number of colors while storing only $\tilde{O}(n)$ bits of memory.
  Recent work has revealed an exponential separation between randomized and deterministic approaches in this setting: while randomized algorithms can achieve a $(Δ+1)$-coloring in a single pass [Assadi, Chen, and Khanna, 2019], any single-pass deterministic algorithm requires $\exp(Δ^{Ω(1)})$ colors [Assadi, Chen, and Sun, 2022]. Consequently, deterministic algorithms that use few colors must necessarily make multiple passes over the stream. Prior to this work, the best known deterministic trade-offs were: an $O(Δ^2)$-coloring in 2 passes, an $O(Δ)$-coloring in $O(\log Δ)$ passes [Assadi, Chen, and Sun, 2022], and a $(Δ+1)$-coloring in $O(\log Δ\cdot \log\log Δ)$ passes [Assadi, Chakrabarti, Ghosh, and Stoeckl, 2023]. It remained open whether better trade-offs -- particularly with sub-logarithmic pass complexity and linear-in-$Δ$ palette size -- were achievable.
  In this paper, we present a new deterministic semi-streaming algorithm that computes an $O(Δ)$-coloring in $O(\sqrt{\log Δ})$ passes. This is the first deterministic streaming algorithm to achieve a coloring with palette size linear-in-$Δ$ using sublogarithmic-in-$Δ$ passes.

</details>


### [377] [Beyond Brooks: $(Δ-1)$-Coloring in Semi-Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07774)
*Maxime Flin,Magnús M. Halldórsson*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文给出了一个针对无 Δ-团的大度图（Δ ≥ 10^14）的单趟半流式 (Δ-1) 染色算法，并证明对于任意 0 ≤ k < (Δ+1)/2，单趟 (Δ-k) 染色算法需要 Ω(n(k+1)) 空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Reed 证明了一类图（Δ ≥ 10^14 且无 Δ-团）存在 (Δ-1) 染色，但需要高效的流式算法来实现。本文旨在设计单趟算法在受限空间内完成染色计算。

Method: 提出了一种单趟半流式算法来计算 (Δ-1) 染色；同时通过信息论下界分析，证明任何单趟 (Δ-k) 染色算法都需要 Ω(n(k+1)) 的空间。

Result: 设计了一个单趟半流式算法可在半流式模型中计算 (Δ-1) 染色；同时证明了当 0 ≤ k < (Δ+1)/2 时，任何单趟 (Δ-k) 染色算法都需要 Ω(n(k+1)) 空间，揭示了空间复杂度下界。

Conclusion: 该算法解决了大度图的高效在线染色问题，同时通过空间下界揭示了一-pass流算法在图染色上的固有局限性，明确了算法能力与信息需求之间的界限。

Abstract: Reed [J.~Comb.~Theory B, 1999] showed that graphs of maximum degree $Δ\geq 10^{14}$ without $Δ$-cliques are $(Δ-1)$-colorable. We design a one-pass semi-streaming algorithm for computing such a coloring. Additionally, we prove that any one-pass $(Δ-k)$-coloring algorithm for $0\leq k < (Δ+1)/2$ requires $Ω(n(k+1))$ space.

</details>


### [378] [Computing bases in Hermite normal form of lattices of integer relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07784)
*George Labahn,Arne Storjohann*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出一种随机化算法，用于计算满足特定整数格条件的 Hermite 形式基。该算法具有 Las Vegas 型保证，复杂度与矩阵乘法相当，是格理论与计算数论中的重要工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要高效计算满足 pF 位于矩阵 M 生成格中的行向量 p 的 Hermite 形式基。该问题在格基归约、密码分析及计算数论中具有广泛应用。

Method: 算法采用 Las Vegas 类型随机化方法，可能以不超过 1/2 的概率失败，但若不失败则保证结果正确。算法复杂度约为矩阵乘法复杂度。

Result: 成功时输出 n×n 的 Hermite 形式基，特殊情况下（当 M 为方阵且 F=I_m）可简化为计算 M 的 Hermite 法式。

Conclusion: 该算法为求解整数格基的 Hermite 形式提供了一个高效的随机化方法，特别适用于格基归约和密码分析中的格问题。其复杂度与矩阵乘法相当，在理论与实践中都具有重要意义。

Abstract: Given a full column rank $M \in \Z^{\ell \times m}$ and an $F \in \Z^{n \times m}$ we present an algorithm to compute the $n \times n$ basis in Hermite form of the integer lattice comprised of all rows $p \in \Z^{1 \times n}$ such that $pF \in \Z^{1 \times m}$ is in the integer lattice generated by the rows of $M$. The algorithm is randomized of the Las Vegas type, that is, it can fail with probability at most $1/2$, but if fail is not returned it guarantees to produce the correct result. When $M$ is square and $F=I_m$, then the computed basis is the Hermite normal form of $M$, and the algorithm uses about the same number of bit operations as required to multiply together two matrices of the same dimension and size of entries as $M$.

</details>


### [379] [Towards Settling the Complexity of the Lettericity Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07899)
*Mario Grobler,Nils Morawietz,Silas Cato Sacher*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了图的字母性(lettericity)的计算复杂性。图的字母性定义为编码图所需最小字母表大小。作者分析了三个 retrieval problems：从图和两个已知对象(词、译码器、着色)中恢复第三个对象。结果表明 word retrieval 和 decoder retrieval 可在多项式时间内求解，而 coloring retrieval 与图同构问题等价。此外，引入了对称字母性的概念，证明了其等于图的 neighborhood diversity，可在线性时间内计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图的字母性(lettericity)是一个重要的图参数，但目前尚不清楚其是否可以在多项式时间内计算。为了推进这个问题的研究，作者转而研究三个 retrieval problems：从已知两个对象推导第三个对象。

Method: 该研究采用计算复杂性分析和算法设计方法。首先对三个 retrieval problems 进行分类讨论：word retrieval 和 decoder retrieval 通过设计高效算法在多项式时间内解决；而 coloring retrieval 通过归约证明了其与图同构问题的等价性。此外，通过引入对称约束并建立与 neighborhood diversity 的等价关系，提供了可快速计算的特殊情况。

Result: 1. Word retrieval 和 Decoder retrieval 问题可以在多项式时间内解决；2. Coloring retrieval 问题与图同构问题等价；3. 对称字母性等于图的 neighborhood diversity，可以在线性时间内计算。

Conclusion: 引入了对称字母性(symmetric lettericity)的概念，证明了图的 symmetric lettericity 恰好等于其 neighborhood diversity，并且可以在线性时间内计算。这为原问题提供了一个可处理的特殊情况。

Abstract: The lettericity of a graph $G=(V,E)$ is defined as the smallest size of an alphabet $Σ$ such that there is a word $w_1 \dots w_{|V|} \in Σ^*$ and a decoder $\mathcal{D} \subseteq Σ^2$ with the property that $G$ is isomorphic to the letter graph $G(\mathcal{D}, w)$, that is, the graph with vertex set $\{1, \dots, n\}$ and edge set $\{ij \mid 1\leq i < j \leq n, w_iw_j \in \mathcal{D}\}$. Note that $G(\mathcal{D}, w)$ can be seen as a graph with inherent coloring $χ\colon V(G) \rightarrow Σ$. It is unknown whether the lettericity of a given graph can be computed in polynomial time. The problem to determine the lettericity of a given graph is called the lettericity problem. As a step towards answering the complexity of this problem, we investigate the following retrieval problems: given a graph $G$ together with two of the three solution-objects (word $w$, decoder $\mathcal{D}$, and coloring $χ$), the goal is to compute the third solution-object. We show that word retrieval and decoder retrieval are solvable in polynomial time, while coloring retrieval is equivalent to the graph isomorphism problem. Beyond this, we introduce symmetric lettericity which is a restricted version of lettericity where each decoder needs to be symmetrical ($ab\in \mathcal{D}$ if and only if $ba\in \mathcal{D}$). As we show, the symmetric lettericity of a graph always equals the neighborhood diversity of the graph, which in fact can be computed in linear time.

</details>


### [380] [Parameterized Local Search for Vertex Cover: When only the Search Radius is Crucial](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07941)
*Christian Komusiewicz,Nils Morawietz*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究LS Vertex Cover问题的参数化算法设计，针对k为小常数而ℓ为结构参数的情况，提出了在h-index、树宽、模宽等图参数下的高效算法，并将结果推广到加权版本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LS Vertex Cover问题是W[1]-hard的（以k为参数），但在实际应用中k是小常数，因此需要在其他结构参数下寻找运行时间对ℓ增长平缓、对k增长剧烈的算法。

Method: 设计在结构参数ℓ（h-index、树宽、模宽、模分解中商图的最大度）下运行时间为ℓ^{f(k)}·n^{O(1)}的参数化算法，并将其扩展到带权重的d-improvement版本。

Result: 获得了在图的h-index、树宽、模宽以及模分解商图最大度等结构参数下的算法，运行时间均为ℓ^{f(k)}·n^{O(1)}形式，并成功适配到带权重的d-improvement k-swap变体。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了在多种结构参数（h-index、树宽、模宽等）下LS Vertex Cover问题的固定参数 tractable (FPT) 算法，为参数化算法的设计提供了新的视角，并成功扩展到加权版本。

Abstract: A vertex set $W$ in a graph $G$ is a valid $k$-swap for a vertex cover $S$ of $G$ if $W$ has size at most $k$ and $S'=(S \setminus W) \cup (W \setminus S)$, the symmetric difference of $S$ and $W$, is a vertex cover of $G$. If $|S'| < |S|$, then $W$ is improving. In LS Vertex Cover, one is given a vertex cover $S$ of a graph $G$ and wants to know if there is a valid improving $k$-swap for $S$ in $G$. In applications of LS Vertex Cover, $k$ is a very small parameter that can be set by a user to determine the trade-off between running time and solution quality. Consequently, $k$ can be considered to be a constant. Motivated by this and the fact that LS Vertex Cover is W[1]-hard with respect to $k$, we aim for algorithms with running time $\ell^{f(k)}\cdot n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ where $\ell$ is a structural graph parameter upper-bounded by $n$. We say that such a running time grows mildly with respect to $\ell$ and strongly with respect to $k$. We obtain algorithms with such a running time for $\ell$ being the $h$-index of $G$, the treewidth of $G$, or the modular-width of $G$. In addition, we consider a novel parameter, the maximum degree over all quotient graphs in a modular decomposition of $G$. Moreover, we adapt these algorithms to the more general problem where each vertex is assigned a weight and where we want to find a valid $d$-improving $k$-swap, that is, a valid $k$-swap which decreases the weight of the vertex cover by at least $d$.

</details>


### [381] [Planarizing Gadgets for (k, l)-tight Graphs Do Not Exist](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08016)
*Archit Chauhan,Rohit Gurjar,Kilian Rothmund,Thomas Thierauf*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文证明了 (k,l)-tight 图识别问题不存在平面化 gadget 方案，这意味着无法通过将一般图转化为平面图的方式来利用已知的平面图算法优势来解决一般图情形下的该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决 (k,l)-tight 图识别问题在一般图与平面图之间的算法复杂性差距：平面图已有确定性 NC 算法，而一般图缺乏此类算法，研究者自然尝试通过 planarizing gadgets 桥接这一差距

Method: 通过构造性证明，展示任何将一般图归约为平面图的 gadget 方案都无法正确保持 (k,l)-tight 性质

Result: 无条件地证明了平面化 gadgets 对于识别 (k,l)-tight 图的问题不存在

Conclusion: 证明了平面化 gadgets 在 (k,l)-tight 图识别问题上的不可能性，为该领域的研究划定了重要边界

Abstract: The problem of recognizing (k, l)-tight graphs is a fundamental problem that has close connections to well studied problems like graph rigidity. The problem is better understood for planar graphs as compared to general graphs. For example, deterministic NC-algorithms for the problem are known for planar graphs, but no such algorithm is known for general graphs. A common approach to reduce a graph problem to the planar case is to use planarizing gadgets. Our main contribution is to show that, unconditionally, planarizing gadgets for the problem of recognizing (k, l)-tight graphs do not exist.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [382] [Bridging Textual Profiles and Latent User Embeddings for Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06981)
*Zhaoxuan Tan,Xiang Zhai,Yan Zhu,Meng Jiang,Mohamed Hammad*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: BLUE框架通过强化学习将语言生成的用户档案与基于嵌入的推荐目标对齐，解决了现有方法中可解释性与推荐效果难以兼顾的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用户表征方法存在权衡困境：监督式潜在嵌入（latent embeddings）虽推荐效果好但缺乏可解释性；文本用户档案虽可解释但因缺乏直接监督信号而难以针对下游推荐效用进行优化。

Method: 提出BLUE框架，利用强化学习将基于语言的用户档案与基于嵌入的推荐目标统一。具体包括：(1) 使用分析型大语言模型(Profiler LLM)根据用户交互历史生成文本档案；(2) 嵌入模型提供奖励信号，引导文本表征在嵌入空间中更接近正样本、远离负样本；(3) 引入基于下一项目预测的文本空间监督信号，确保生成档案既语义丰富又对下游检索任务有效。

Result: 在Amazon Reviews 2023和Google Local Reviews数据集上的零样本顺序推荐实验中，BLUE在冻结嵌入和可训练嵌入两种条件下均一致性地超越强基线方法。值得注意的是，BLUE在跨域迁移任务中表现尤为突出，展现了学习到的用户档案的强大泛化能力。此外，这些生成的用户档案在问答场景中作为个性化上下文也优于原始用户历史或替代档案优化方法。

Conclusion: BLUE有效统一了可解释的文本画像与判别性的潜在嵌入，为个性化推荐提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Personalized systems rely on user representations to connect behavioral history with downstream recommendation applications. Existing methods typically employ either supervised latent user embeddings, which are effective for retrieval but difficult to interpret, or textual user profiles, which are interpretable but challenging to optimize for downstream utility due to lack of direct supervision. To bridge this gap, we present BLUE, a reinforcement learning framework that unifies these two forms of user representation by aligning language-based user profiles with embedding-based recommendation objectives. Given a user interaction history, BLUE leverages a profiler Large Language Model (LLM) to generate textual profiles, while an embedding model provides reward signals. This encourages the resulting textual representations to move closer to positive items and farther from negative ones in the embedding space. We further introduce a text-space supervision signal based on next-item prediction, ensuring the learned profiles remain both semantically meaningful and highly effective for downstream retrieval. Experiments on Amazon Reviews 2023 and Google Local Reviews in zero-shot sequential recommendation settings demonstrate that BLUE consistently outperforms strong baselines under both frozen and trainable embedding conditions. Notably, BLUE achieves clear gains in cross-domain transfer, highlighting the strong generalization ability of the learned user profiles. Furthermore, these generated profiles provide superior personalized context for question answering compared to raw user histories or alternative profile optimization methods. Overall, these results show that BLUE provides an effective way to unify interpretable textual profiling with discriminative latent embeddings for personalization.

</details>


### [383] [An Embarrassingly Simple Graph Heuristic Reveals Shortcut-Solvable Benchmarks for Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07125)
*Haoyu Han,Li Ma,Hanbing Wang,Bingheng Li,Daochen Zha,Chun How Tan,Huiji Gao,Xin Liu,Stephanie Moyerman,Sanjeev Katariya,Hui Liu,Jiliang Tang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文通过一个不使用序列编码器、生成目标或训练的极简图启发式方法，揭示了当前推荐基准测试存在"捷径可解性"问题。该方法在14个数据集中的10个上仍具竞争力，表明现有基准测试可能无法有效区分高级模型与简单方法。研究识别出三种Shortcut结构，建议学界在评估新推荐模型时需更谨慎地选择数据集并进行诊断分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代生成式推荐系统日益结合序列模式和语义物品信息，但这些方法通常仅在少量常用基准数据集上进行评估。论文提出的核心问题是：这些基准测试是否真正需要现代生成式推荐器所声称的高级建模能力？

Method: 研究团队设计了一个极其简单的图启发式方法作为基准审计工具。该方法仅从用户最近交互的1-2个物品出发，从多跳物品转换图中检索候选物品，并基于物品-特征相似度进行排序。值得注意的是，该方法完全不使用序列编码器、生成目标函数或任何训练过程。

Result: 该简单启发式方法在多个数据集上取得了优异表现。在Amazon Review Sports和CDs数据集上，相较于最佳竞争基线分别实现了38.10%和44.18%的相对NDCG@10提升。在14个数据集的跨数据集评估中，该启发式方法在10个数据集上仍保持竞争力，且模型排名随数据集特性变化显著。

Conclusion: 本研究表明，当前基准测试上的强性能并不一定能证明模型具备先进的序列建模、语义建模或生成建模能力。论文识别出三种可能导致基准测试"捷径可解性"的Shortcut结构：低分支的局部转换、特征平滑的转换以及与长用户历史的有限依赖。论文呼吁在评估新推荐模型时，应更加谨慎地选择数据集并对数据集进行诊断分析。

Abstract: Sequential recommendation has increasingly shifted toward generative recommenders that combine sequential patterns with semantic item information. Yet these methods are often evaluated on a small set of widely used benchmarks, raising a key question: do these benchmarks actually require the advanced modeling capabilities that modern generative recommenders claim to provide? We conduct a benchmark audit with an intentionally simple graph heuristic. Starting from only the last one or two interacted items, it retrieves candidates from a few-hop item-transition graph and ranks them by item-feature similarity. Despite using no sequence encoder, generative objective, or training, this heuristic matches or outperforms many modern baselines, with relative NDCG@10 improvements of 38.10% and 44.18% over the best competing baseline on Amazon Review Sports and CDs.
  We show that this behavior reflects shortcut solvability rather than an artifact of one heuristic. We identify three shortcut structures that can make next-item prediction easier than expected: low-branching local transitions, feature-smooth transitions, and limited dependence on long user histories. These shortcuts need not appear together; even one or two strong signals can make simple local retrieval highly competitive, while weakening them makes the benefits of more sophisticated models clearer. Across 14 datasets, model rankings vary substantially with dataset properties, yet the heuristic remains competitive on 10 of them. Our findings suggest that strong performance on standard benchmarks does not always demonstrate advanced sequential, semantic, or generative modeling ability. We call for more careful dataset selection and dataset-level diagnostic analysis when using benchmarks to support claims about new recommendation models.

</details>


### [384] [RRCM: Ranking-Driven Retrieval over Collaborative and Meta Memories for LLM Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07129)
*Shijun Li,Wooseong Yang,Yu Wang,Tianxin Wei,Joydeep Ghosh*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RRCM是一个针对LLM推荐系统的排序驱动检索推理框架，通过强化学习优化智能决策何时直接推荐或从协作/元数据记忆中检索证据，采用群组相对策略优化端到端训练，在实验中显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推荐系统面临两个核心挑战：1）固定上下文构建策略难以自适应地为每个实例选择真正有益的信息；2）异构证据（协作行为数据与项目元数据）造成严重的上下文效率瓶颈——丰富信息易超窗口限制，而过度压缩可能丢失关键推荐证据。

Method: 提出RRCM框架，采用排序驱动的检索-推理机制，在协作记忆和元数据记忆上运作。系统从轻量级用户历史上下文出发，通过LLM智能决策：直接推荐、检索协作证据、检索项目元数据或交替混合检索。采用群组相对策略优化（GRPO），仅用排序结果作为奖励信号训练检索策略。

Result: 大量实验表明，RRCM显著优于传统基线和多种LLM推荐方法。

Conclusion: RRCM通过统一检索接口和端到端优化策略，有效解决了LLM推荐系统中上下文构建的灵活性与效率问题。实验表明该框架显著优于传统基线和多种LLM推荐方法。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for next-generation recommender systems, offering strong semantic understanding and natural-language reasoning abilities. Despite recent progress, current LLM-based recommenders still face key challenges in constructing decision-relevant contexts from heterogeneous evidence. First, existing methods often rely on fixed context construction strategies: collaborative behavioral evidence and item-side metadata are typically incorporated through predefined prompts, static retrieval pipelines, or handcrafted injection mechanisms, making it difficult to determine what information is truly beneficial for each instance. Second, heterogeneous evidence introduces a severe context-efficiency bottleneck. Rich metadata and collaborative interaction records can quickly overwhelm the context window, while aggressive compression or heuristic filtering may discard fine-grained evidence critical for accurate recommendation. To address these challenges, we propose RRCM, a ranking-driven retrieval-and-reasoning framework over collaborative and metadata memories for LLM-based agentic recommendation. RRCM starts from a lightweight user-history context and learns whether to recommend directly, retrieve collaborative evidence, retrieve item metadata, or interleave both through reasoning. Both memories are represented in natural language and accessed through a unified retrieval interface, enabling flexible evidence acquisition without handcrafted CF injection or fixed retrieval rules. We optimize this memory-reading policy with an outcome-only ranking reward, instantiated using group relative policy optimization, so that retrieval decisions are directly driven by final top-k recommendation quality. Extensive experiments show that RRCM significantly outperforms traditional baselines and diverse LLM-based recommendation approaches.

</details>


### [385] [Topic Is Not Agenda: A Citation-Community Audit of Text Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07158)
*Junseon Yoo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该研究通过构建包含358万篇学术论文的增强引文图，测试了当前最先进的文本嵌入模型（Gemini、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-0.6B、SPECTER2）在研究议程级别（L2）检索中的有效性。结果显示，在L2级别，前10个最相似结果中仅15-21%与查询论文共享研究议程，即80%的检索结果偏离目标。诊断实验表明，简单基于引文计数的重排序方法可达到57.7%的L2 top-1准确率，显著优于最佳余弦相似度检索器（Gemini 50.6%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 向量检索和RAG系统建立在余弦相似度能够反映概念相关性的假设之上，但该假设在细粒度研究议程级别的有效性尚未得到系统验证。

Method: 1. 构建358万篇科学论文的增强引文图；2. 使用Leiden CPM算法按两个粒度进行划分：子领域(L1)和研究议程(L2)；3. 评估四种先进嵌入模型在L1和L2级别的检索性能；4. 设计引文计数重排序作为诊断探针。

Result: 嵌入模型在L1级别表现尚可（top-10同域率45-52%），但在L2级别严重失效（仅15-21%匹配研究议程）。失败在八个科学领域和四种模型中普遍存在。引文计数重排序在布尔检索和BM25基础上分别达到57.7%和59.6%的L2 top-1准确率，优于最佳嵌入模型9个百分点，优于BM25约20个百分点。

Conclusion: 当前文本嵌入在研究议程级别的检索任务中存在系统性失败，80%的检索结果与目标议程不符。引文图蕴含的议程匹配信号可被简单重排序方法捕获，但被单向量嵌入所忽略。该发现将理论限制与科学RAG的具体失效模式联系起来，表明需要超越简单向量相似度的检索策略。

Abstract: Vector search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) rest on the assumption that cosine similarity between text embeddings reflects conceptual relatedness. We measure where this assumption breaks. We build an augmented citation graph over 3.58M scientific papers and partition it via Leiden CPM at two granularities: sub-field (L1) and research-agenda (L2, hierarchical inside each L1). Four state-of-the-art embeddings (Gemini, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-0.6B, SPECTER2) clear the L1 bar reasonably (45-52% top-10 same-rate) but stop working at L2: only 15-21% of top-10 neighbors share the query's research agenda. In absolute terms, 8 of every 10 retrieved papers are off-agenda. The failure is universal across eight scientific domains and all four models; SPECTER2, despite its citation-based contrastive training, is the weakest. As a diagnostic probe, we test whether the same augmented graph also functions as a retrieval signal: a deliberately simple citation-count rerank reaches 57.7% top-1 L2 on top of LLM-expanded Boolean retrieval and 59.6% on top of plain BM25, on 80 curated agenda queries -- about 9 points above the best cosine retriever (Gemini, 50.6%) and 20 points above BM25 alone (39.3%). The probe isolates a slice of the agenda-matching signal the graph carries but the embeddings miss, connecting recent theoretical limits on single-vector retrieval to a concrete failure mode of scientific RAG.

</details>


### [386] [DiffRetriever: Parallel Representative Tokens for Retrieval with Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07210)
*Shuai Wang,Yin Yu,Shengyao Zhuang,Bevan Koopman,Guido Zuccon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: DiffRetriever是一种基于扩散语言模型的检索器，通过并行解码多个representative token突破自回归模型的顺序生成瓶颈，在BEIR-7评测中取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究表明多token表征对自回归模型效率低下（需顺序生成token），但这究竟是multi-token思路本身的问题还是实现方式的问题尚不明确。

Method: DiffRetriever采用representative-token方式：向提示追加K个mask位置，在单次双向前向传播中同时读取全部K个token，实现并行解码而非顺序生成。

Result: 多token DiffRetriever在所有测试的扩散backbone上均显著优于单token方案；而自回归多token方法表现持平或更差，且延迟随K线性增长，扩散模型则无此问题。

Conclusion: DiffRetriever在Dream上的表现成为BEIR-7最强检索器，超越了PromptReps、同扩散 backbone上的encoder式DiffEmbed基线以及对比微调的单向量RepLLaMA。冻结基础模型上的per-query oracle性能甚至超过同等预算下的对比微调，为自适应预算选择这一未来方向提供了有力证据。

Abstract: PromptReps showed that an autoregressive language model can be used directly as a retriever by prompting it to generate dense and sparse representations of a query or passage. Extending this to multiple representatives is inefficient for autoregressive models, since tokens must be generated sequentially, and prior multi-token variants did not reliably improve over single-token decoding.
  We show that the bottleneck is sequential generation, not the multi-token idea itself. DiffRetriever is a representative-token retriever for diffusion language models: it appends K masked positions to the prompt and reads all K in a single bidirectional forward pass. Across in-domain and out-of-domain evaluation, multi-token DiffRetriever substantially improves over single-token on every diffusion backbone we test, while autoregressive multi-token is flat or negative and pays a latency cost that scales with K where diffusion does not. After supervised fine-tuning, DiffRetriever on Dream is the strongest BEIR-7 retriever in our comparison, ahead of PromptReps, the encoder-style DiffEmbed baseline on the same diffusion backbones, and the contrastively fine-tuned single-vector RepLLaMA. A per-query oracle on the frozen base model exceeds contrastive fine-tuning at the same fixed budget, pointing to adaptive budget selection as future work. Code is available at https://github.com/ielab/diffretriever.

</details>


### [387] [MLAIRE: Multilingual Language-Aware Information Retrieval Evaluation Protocal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07249)
*Youngjoon Jang,Seongtae Hong,Hyeonseok Moon,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出MLAIRE评估协议，用于评估多语言信息检索中的语言感知维度，将语义检索与查询语言偏好解耦，并设计了LPR、Lang-nDCG等指标及4-way分解方法来揭示不同检索器在语义相关性和语言偏好之间的权衡特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估方法仅关注语言无关的语义相关性，忽略了检索结果语言对用户体验和下游RAG系统验证的影响，导致无法区分语义相关但语言不匹配与语义不相关的检索结果。

Method: 构建包含跨语言平行 passage 的受控测试池，通过 LPR 和 Lang-nDCG 等语言感知指标，并采用4-way分解方法将检索失败分离为语义错误和语言偏好错误两类。

Result: 在31种检索器上的评估表明，语义性能强的检索器可能返回非查询语言的结果，而语言偏好强的检索器可能检索到语义相关性较低的内容。

Conclusion: MLAIRE为多语言检索系统提供了更细粒度的评估维度，能够揭示语义检索性能与语言偏好之间的权衡关系，有助于指导实际应用中检索系统的优化方向。

Abstract: Multilingual Information Retrieval is increasingly important in real-world search settings, where users issue queries over mixed-language corpora. Existing evaluations mainly reward language-agnostic semantic relevance, treating relevant passages equally regardless of language. Yet retrieval utility also depends on the language of the retrieved passages: users may prefer results they can read and verify in the query language, and query--passage language mismatch can complicate downstream grounding and answer verification in Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems. To evaluate this language-aware dimension, we introduce MLAIRE, a Multilingual Language-Aware Information Retrieval Evaluation protocol that disentangles cross-lingual semantic retrieval from query-language preference. MLAIRE constructs controlled pools with parallel passages across languages, enabling measurement of semantic retrieval accuracy and query-language preference when equivalent translations are available. We propose language-aware metrics, including Language Preference Rate (LPR) and Lang-nDCG, together with a 4-way decomposition separating semantic and query-language preference failures. Evaluating 31 dense, sparse, and late-interaction retrievers, we show that standard metrics obscure distinct behaviors: semantically strong retrievers may return correct content in a non-query language, while retrievers with stronger query-language preference may retrieve less semantically relevant passages.

</details>


### [388] [PRISM: Refracting the Entangled User Behavior Space for E-Commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07296)
*Haoqian Zhang,Ziyuan Yang,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PRISM 是一个面向电商搜索行为预测（CTR）的“偏好—相关性交互语义建模”框架：在偏好矫正、LLM 语义锚定、偏好条件证据路由三个模块的协同下，在 KuaiSAR 与 JDSearch 两个公开数据集、多种相关/偏好骨干组合上稳定优于 CLK、NISE、DCMT、PRINT、DRP 等联合建模基线（ AUC 最高提升约 +0.9~+3.5 个百分点，NDCG@10/HR@10 亦提升），但 LogLoss 校准在部分配置下反而变差，绝对增益幅度偏小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商搜索依赖用户行为日志来估计 query-物品相关性与用户偏好。现有工作（PRECTR、PRINT、DRP 等）通常把二者视为静态、可独立学习的信号，并以静态融合或统一监督的方式联合优化。但实际日志行为由曝光机制、反馈回路与语义匹配共同塑造，导致三个问题：(1) 观测到的偏好是混杂信号，受点击反馈污染，难以反映真实稳定兴趣；(2) 相关性在递归交互的反馈下发生语义漂移，偏离真实 query-物品语义匹配；(3) 现有模型对 query、用户、物品及其两两交互等多源证据采用同质化聚合，缺乏与当前行为上下文一致的动态选择机制。已有去偏/去混杂研究多聚焦统计校正或因果识别，较少在搜索场景中同时兼顾“保持相关性的语义忠实性”与“净化偏好表征”，也缺少利用外部语义先验来显式校准相关性表征语义极性的轻量方案。

Method: 问题形式化：给定日志 D={(x_i,y_i)}，x_i=(u_i,q_i,v_i)，y_i∈{0,1} 为会话级交互标签，联合学习偏好模型 PM(u,q,v)、相关性模型 RM(q,v) 与交互函数 g，最小化 L=ℓ(y, g(PM(u,q,v), RM(q,v)))。

(1) 偏好矫正（Preference Rectification）：把偏好表征 p 与相关性表征 r 投影到共享注意力空间（共享打分矩阵 W_s、取值矩阵 W_{v,p}/W_{v,r}），计算“相关性→偏好”路径分数 e_{rp}=LeakyReLU(a^T[z_r;z_p]) 与“自我保持”路径分数 e_{pp}=LeakyReLU(a^T[z_p;z_p])，softmax 得到门控 α_{rp}, α_{pp}；以自保持系数调制取值向量 m_p^clean=α_{pp}v_p，得 p_clean=W_o σ(m_p^clean)，并以残差形式施加编辑 Δp=p_clean−p，p_edit=p+Δp，偏好分数 s_pref=σ(w_pref^T p_edit+b_pref)。加入幅度正则 L_mag（||Δp||²）与方向正则 L_dir（1−cos(p_edit,p)）防止过度改写、保持原偏好语义方向。

(2) LLM 驱动的语义锚定（LLM-Driven Semantic Anchoring）：由 LLM 先验生成的正/负语义原型 r_pos、r_neg（相关/不相关 query-物品对的语义极），用外部文本编码器 BGE-base-en-v1.5 预编码并冻结；将相关性表征 r 经可学习投影 f_proj 得 r_proto，与两原型做 L2 归一化后的余弦相似度 s_pos、s_neg（温度 T_proto）；对带有相关性监督标签 t_i∈{+1,−1} 与有效性掩码 m_i 的样本施加间隔型原型对齐损失 L_pr=Σ m_i max(0, γ−t_i Δs_i)/(Σm_i+ε)，使相关性表征保持语义极性、抵抗行为漂移。

(3) 偏好条件证据路由（Preference-Conditioned Evidence Routing）：构造六个证据 token（e_q、e_t、e_u 及 e_qt、e_qu、e_ut 两两交互），以 p_edit 作为路由条件生成查询 q_r=W_q^r p_edit，键 k(e)=W_k^r e，得分 a(e)=w_s^T tanh(q_r+k(e))，经温度 τ 的 softmax 归一化得权重 α(e)，聚合为 c_route=Σα(e)e；构造校正特征 z_corr=[r; c_route; r⊙c_route; |r−c_route|]，经 MLP_corr 得 δ_rel，在 logit 空间精修 s_rel'=σ(logit(s_rel)+δ_rel)；并加熵正则 L_att 控制路由分布的选择性。

(4) 预测与目标：不再假设固定乘积，用可学习交互函数 ŷ=g_θ(s_pref, s_rel')；总损失 L = L_bce + λ_mag L_mag + λ_dir L_dir + λ_pr L_pr + λ_att L_att。实现上：PyTorch 2.7 + 单卡 RTX 4090，64 维嵌入、预测网络 [64,32]，路由温度 1.0，相关性校正网络与路由打分投影末层零初始化，Adam 优化，验证集早停 patience=2。

Result: 1) 整体性能（5 个随机种子均值、单尾 t 检验）：PM=MLP/RM=DSSM 时 KuaiSAR AUC 由最佳基线 DRP 的 0.62877 提升至 0.63422，JDSearch 由 0.69183 提升至 0.70876（基线 DSSM 0.67397）；PM=DCN/RM=DSSM 时 JDSearch AUC 0.71412（DRP 0.70526，基线 0.69628），KuaiSAR 0.63078（DRP 0.62758）；RM=HEM 配置下 PRISM 在 AUC/NDCG@10/HR@10 上几乎全配置最优（如 PM=MLP：KuaiSAR AUC 0.63237、JDSearch 0.70339）。NDCG@10/HR@10 增益普遍为 +0.003~+0.008。
2) 局限：LogLoss 并不总是改善——如 PM=MLP/RM=DSSM 在 JDSearch 上 PRISM 为 0.09640，反而劣于 Base 0.09394 与 DRP 0.09406，说明模型概率校准变差（作者亦将概率校准列为未来工作）；AUC 绝对提升幅度偏小（约 0.2%~1%），且提升主要来自联合建模本身，PRISM 相对强基线的净增益较有限。
3) 模块消融（KuaiSAR）：去掉偏好矫正的变体性能显著退化（DSSM 0.63005→0.58994，QEM 0.63014→0.58854）；仅用 LLM 语义锚定而缺少路由与矫正反而大幅下降（0.59127/0.58799），说明 LLM 锚定需与整体结构协同才有效；完整模型最优（0.63422/0.63307/0.63237），三模块互补。
4) 损失消融（QEM+MLP）：完整目标 0.63307 优于仅 BCE（0.62916）、去掉语义对齐损失（0.62888）、去掉编辑正则（0.62891）、去掉路由熵正则（0.62922）。
5) 偏好矫正对比其他表征交互策略：PR（0.63422/0.63307）优于 MLP Fusion、DRP 的低秩正交分解与 Simple Attention（后者明显退化至 0.590 左右）。
6) 频次子集（ihot/itail/qhot/qtail）：PRISM 在全部子集上 AUC/NDCG/HR 最优、LogLoss 最低，查询侧子集（qhot/qtail）增益尤为明显（如 qhot AUC 0.67385 vs PRINT 0.66949）。
7) 可视化：验证 AUC 曲线全程高于 plain/clk/nise/dcmt 且更平滑、后期退化更小；t-SNE 显示加入语义约束后相关/不相关样本类内更紧致、类间间隔更大、类中心更可分。
8) 需注意的表述不一致与未充分交代之处：摘要称“迭代式精炼偏好”，但方法中仅有单步残差校正；实现细节与损失消融中出现“prompt alignment loss / prompt-based supervision”等与正文“prototype anchoring / L_pr”不一致的遗留表述（疑似早期版本术语），且 λ_pr 等权重与相关性监督标签 t_i、掩码 m_i 的具体来源未明确定义；LLM 仅在离线阶段生成原型（经 BGE 编码冻结），推理阶段零 LLM 开销。

Conclusion: PRISM 论证了电商搜索行为预测中“偏好与相关性应被显式交互建模而非独立建模”这一主张，并把该主张落实为三个可插拔组件：偏好矫正用双路径门控+残差编辑抑制相关性对偏好的污染并以幅度/方向正则保持原语义；LLM 语义锚定用冻结的正负语义原型为相关性表征提供外部极性先验，抵抗反馈驱动的语义漂移；偏好条件证据路由以矫正后偏好为条件自适应聚合多源行为证据，在 logit 空间精修相关性。实验显示其在两个公开基准、多种骨干组合下对联合建模类基线具有一致但不大的性能增益，消融与可视化支持各组件的互补性与表征可分性改进。总体上该工作是一个设计合理、工程轻量（推理期无 LLM 开销、零初始化稳定训练）、可与不同相关性/偏好骨干即插即用的统一框架；其主要不足在于绝对增益有限、LogLoss 校准未改善、部分表述与实验细节（迭代性、λ 设置、监督标签与掩码定义）存在不一致与缺失，作者亦提出未来将改进概率校准并扩展到多行为搜索场景。

Abstract: E-commerce search systems rely on modeling user behavior to estimate item relevance and user preference, which are typically assumed to be stable and independently learnable signals. However, in practice, user interactions are jointly shaped by exposure mechanisms, feedback loops, and semantic matching, leading to entangled and dynamically drifting behavioral signals. As a result, both preference estimation and relevance modeling suffer from confounding effects and semantic misalignment, which limits the robustness of downstream ranking models. To address this issue, we propose PRISM, a Preference-Relevance Interaction Semantic Modeling framework for e-commerce search behavior prediction. PRISM explicitly models the interaction between user preference and item relevance rather than treating them as independent components. Specifically, it introduces a preference rectification module to iteratively refine user preference under relevance-aware constraints, improving robustness against behavioral confounding. To ensure semantic consistency, we further incorporate a large language model (LLM)-driven semantic anchoring mechanism that leverages positive and negative prototypes to calibrate relevance representations. Finally, a preference-conditioned evidence routing module adaptively aggregates multi-source behavioral signals, enabling context-aware and preference-aligned relevance estimation. Extensive experiments on two public e-commerce benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently outperforms strong baselines, validating the effectiveness of explicitly modeling preference-relevance interaction for robust and semantically grounded search behavior modeling.

</details>


### [389] [DCGL: Dual-Channel Graph Learning with Large Language Models for Knowledge-Aware Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07314)
*Xinchi Zou,Tongzhenzhi Su,Jianjun Li,Yuan Fu,Chang Liu,Zhiying Deng,Zhiwei Shen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出DCGL（双通道图学习）框架，通过双通道架构解耦语义信息与用户行为模式、多层次对比学习增强抗噪性、动态融合机制平衡语义泛化与行为特异性，解决现有KG+LLM推荐系统的三大局限。四个真实数据集实验表明该方法优于现有最优方法，尤其在稀疏场景下效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前KG+LLM推荐系统存在三大局限：1）仅建模显式KG链接，忽视隐式语义关系；2）ID嵌入与LLM嵌入的单通道融合导致信号干扰；3）未考虑用户-物品交互频率差异的影响。

Method: 提出DCGL框架，包含三个创新点：1）双通道架构结构化解耦语义信息与用户行为模式；2）多层次对比学习（视图内对比增强抗噪性，视图间对齐弥合语义鸿沟）；3）基于交互频率的动态融合机制，自适应平衡语义泛化与行为特异性。

Result: 在4个真实数据集上，DCGL一致优于现有最优方法，稀疏场景下提升显著，同时保持活跃用户推荐精度。

Conclusion: 双通道架构有效防止语义与行为信号早期干扰；多层次对比学习增强了知识图谱噪声鲁棒性；动态融合机制解决了级联限制问题。

Abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) have proven highly effective for recommendation systems by capturing latent item relationships, while recent integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) has further enhanced semantic understanding and addressed knowledge sparsity issues. Nevertheless, current KG-and-LLM-based methods still face three main limitations: 1) inadequate modeling of implicit semantic relationships beyond explicit KG links; 2) suboptimal single-channel fusion of ID and LLM embeddings, which often leads to signal interference and blurred representations; and 3) insufficient consideration of user-item interaction frequency variations in recommendation strategies. To address these challenges, we propose the Dual-Channel Graph Learning (DCGL) framework, featuring three key innovations: 1) a dual-channel architecture that structurally decouples rich semantic information from user behavioral patterns, preventing early interference; 2) a multi-level contrastive learning mechanism that enhances robustness against KG noise through intra-view contrasts and bridges semantic gaps between channels via inter-view alignment; and 3) a dynamic fusion mechanism that adaptively balances semantic generalization and behavioral specificity based on interaction frequency, resolving the cascading limitation. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets show that DCGL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, yielding substantial improvements in sparse scenarios while maintaining precision for active users. Our code is available at https://github.com/XinchiZou/DCGL.

</details>


### [390] [A Comprehensive Survey on Agent Skills: Taxonomy, Techniques, and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07358)
*Yingli Zhou,Wang Shu,Yaodong Su,Wenchuan Du,Yixiang Fang,Xuemin Lin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于LLM智能体技能（Agent Skills）的综述论文。论文将技能定义为协调工具、记忆和运行时上下文的可重用程序工件，并从技能生命周期的四个阶段（表示、获取、检索、演化）组织相关文献，讨论了质量控制、互操作性、安全更新等开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: As LLM-based agents move toward open-ended real-world deployment, relying on from-scratch reasoning and low-level tool calls for every task becomes increasingly inefficient, error-prone, and hard to maintain.

Method: Organized the literature around four stages of the agent skill lifecycle: representation, acquisition, retrieval, and evolution. Reviewed representative methods, ecosystem resources, and application settings across each stage.

Result: Established agent skills as a central concept for scalability, robustness, and maintainability of modern agent systems; provided a systematic literature review framework covering the complete skill lifecycle.

Conclusion: Open challenges include quality control, interoperability, safe updating, and long-term capability management in agent skill systems. All related resources are shared in a GitHub repository for community access.

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents that reason, plan, and act through tools, memory, and structured interaction are emerging as a promising paradigm for automating complex workflows. Recent systems such as OpenClaw and Claude Code exemplify a broader shift from passive response generation to action-oriented task execution. Yet as agents move toward open-ended, real-world deployment, relying on from-scratch reasoning and low-level tool calls for every task become increasingly inefficient, error-prone, and hard to maintain. This survey examines this challenge through the lens of \emph{agent skills}, which we define as reusable procedural artifacts that coordinate tools, memory, and runtime context under task-specific constraints. Under this view, agents and skills play complementary roles: agents handle high-level reasoning and planning, while skills form the operational layer that enables reliable, reusable, and composable execution. Skills are therefore central to the scalability, robustness, and maintainability of modern agent systems. We organize the literature around four stages of the agent skill lifecycle -- representation, acquisition, retrieval, and evolution -- and review representative methods, ecosystem resources, and application settings across each stage. We conclude by discussing open challenges in quality control, interoperability, safe updating, and long-term capability management. All related resources, including research papers, open-source data, and projects, are collected for the community in \textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/JayLZhou/Awesome-Agent-Skills}.

</details>


### [391] [LARAG: Link-Aware Retrieval Strategy for RAG Systems in Hyperlinked Technical Documentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07517)
*Giorgia Bolognesi,Claudio Estatico,Ulderico Fugacci,Isabella Mastroianni,Claudio Muselli,Luca Oneto*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出LARAG，一种利用HTML文档中现有超链接结构的检索增强生成方法。该方法将超链接关系编码为元数据，在不需要显式图构建的情况下实现隐式图状检索。实验表明，该方法在提升答案质量的同时降低了计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准基于嵌入的检索器将结构化语料库（如技术手册）视为扁平的段落集合，忽略了用户在导航此类内容时所依赖的超链接拓扑结构。

Method: LARAG（Link-Aware RAG）：一种轻量级的链接感知检索策略，通过将超链接关系编码为块表示中的元数据，并利用其执行类似图的局部相关内容检索。

Result: 在Rulex平台技术文档上使用20个专家设计的查询和4种提示策略的基准测试中，LARAG持续提升答案质量，达到最高的BERTScore F1，同时检索的块更少、生成的token也更少。

Conclusion: 直接利用技术文档中现有的超链接拓扑结构，即使不进行显式图构建或推理，也能实现隐式的图状检索，从而构建更忠实、更高效的RAG流程，以更低的成本实现更好的文本溯源效果。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the factual grounding of Large Language Models by conditioning their outputs on external documents. However, standard embedding-based retrievers treat naturally structured corpora, such as technical manuals, as flat collections of passages, thereby overlooking the hyperlink topology that users rely on when navigating such content.
  We introduce LARAG (Link-Aware RAG): a lightweight, link-aware retrieval strategy that leverages the author-defined hyperlink structure already present in HTML documentation, encoding hyperlink relations as metadata in the chunk representations and exploiting them to perform a form of graph-like retrieval of locally relevant content.
  In a benchmark of twenty expert-designed queries over Rulex Platform technical documentation and four prompting strategies, LARAG consistently improves answer quality, achieving the highest BERTScore F1, while retrieving fewer chunks and generating fewer tokens than a baseline RAG architecture used for comparison. These results show that directly leveraging the existing hyperlink topology of technical documentation, even without explicit graph construction or inference, enables an implicit form of graph-like retrieval that yields a more faithful and efficient RAG pipeline, providing better grounding at lower cost.

</details>


### [392] [TRACE: Tourism Recommendation with Accountable Citation Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07677)
*Zixu Zhao,Sijin Wang,Yu Hou,Yuanyuan Xu,Yufan Sheng,Xike Xie,Wenjie Zhang,Won-Yong Shin,Xin Cao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: TRACE是一个旅游推荐对话评估基准，包含10,000个对话、2,400个POI和34,208条评论，涵盖14个基线模型和25项指标。研究发现LLM零样本在准确率和恢复能力上领先但引用密度低，非LLM检索器引用密度高但准确率低，多评论综合方法恢复能力差。基准验证显示Grounding Score与人类评估高度相关（Spearman rho=+0.80）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CRS基准仅用单一Recall@k评估实体提及，旅游资源虽加入空间或知识图谱上下文，但均未将多轮推荐与可验证的评论引用和拒绝恢复相结合。这导致旅游推荐评估存在信任性、可验证性和自适应性的缺口。

Method: 构建TRACE基准：10,000个多轮旅游推荐对话，涵盖2,400个Yelp POI和34,208条评论，跨8个美国城市，配对14个检索、规划和LLM基线模型，组织25项指标分为准确性(Accuracy)、 grounding(Grounding)和恢复性(Recovery)三类。

Result: 揭示"三能力差距"(Three-Competency Gap)：LLM零样本在闭集Recall@1和拒绝恢复上领先，但引用密度低于检索器；非LLM检索器达到表面词汇匹配但准确率低；多评论综合方法在恢复能力上失败。Grounding Score与人类引用精确度高度相关（Spearman rho=+0.80, p<10^-20）。

Conclusion: TRACE将可问责的旅游推荐重新定义为联合目标（正确POI + 可验证证据 + 自适应修复），而非单一轴线排行榜。

Abstract: Tourism is a high-stakes setting for conversational recommender systems (CRS): a plausible-sounding suggestion can waste real money and trip time once a traveler acts on it. Existing CRS benchmarks primarily evaluate systems with a single Recall@k score over entity mentions, and tourism-specific resources add spatial or knowledge-graph context, yet none of them couple multi-turn recommendation with verbatim review-span evidence and rejection recovery. This leaves an evaluation gap for tourism recommendation that is simultaneously trustworthy, verifiable, and adaptive: recommend the right point of interest (POI) for multi-aspect preferences (such as cuisine, price, atmosphere, walking distance), justify each suggestion with verifiable evidence from prior visitors so the traveler can act without trial and error, and recover when the first recommendation is rejected mid-dialogue. We introduce TRACE, where each item is a multi-turn tourism recommendation dialogue with review-span citations and explicit rejection turns: 10,000 dialogues over 2,400 Yelp POIs and 34,208 reviews across eight U.S. cities, paired with 14 retrieval, planning, and LLM baselines, along with 25 metrics organized under Accuracy, Grounding, and Recovery. Across these baselines, TRACE reveals the Three-Competency Gap: LLM Zero-Shot leads in closed-set Recall@1 and rejection recovery but cites less densely than retrievers; non-LLM retrievers achieve surface-verbatim grounding but with low accuracy; Multi-Review Synthesis fails at recovery. The Grounding Score agrees with human citation precision (Spearman rho=+0.80, p<10^-20), and paired t-tests reproduce the per-baseline ranking (p<0.01 on the dominant contrasts). TRACE reframes accountable tourism recommendation as a joint target (right POI, verifiable evidence, adaptive repair) rather than a single-axis leaderboard.

</details>


### [393] [FAVOR: Efficient Filter-Agnostic Vector ANNS Based on Selectivity-Aware Exclusion Distances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07770)
*Junjie Song,Yu Liu,Guoyu Hu,Zhongle Xie,Ming Yang,Beng Chin Ooi,Ke Zhou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: FAVOR是一种高效的过滤无关向量近似最近邻搜索系统，通过引入排斥距离机制和选择性驱动的查询路由策略，在任意过滤条件下实现1.3-5倍QPS提升（Recall@10=95%），同时保持跨不同选择性的稳定性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代检索系统（如推荐系统和RAG）需要处理混合查询，结合向量相似度搜索与复杂属性过滤。现有基于HNSW的内联过滤方法在低选择性场景下难以提供高吞吐量，且难以平衡搜索效率、过滤通用性和图连接性。

Method: FAVOR提出三个创新点：(1) 统一架构整合选择性估计与过滤ANNS执行；(2) 基于HNSW的内联过滤算法，引入排斥距离机制动态重塑向量距离分布，将非目标向量推离查询，同时将有效候选向量拉近；(3) 选择性驱动的搜索选择器，估计查询选择性并动态路由——低选择性使用预过滤暴力搜索，其他情况使用优化的HNSW搜索。

Result: 在真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，FAVOR在任意过滤条件下于Recall@10=95%时实现1.3-5倍QPS提升，且在某些特定过滤条件下性能可与定制化解决方案竞争。

Conclusion: FAVOR通过创新的排斥距离机制和选择性感知路由策略，成功解决了低选择性场景下的性能瓶颈，为混合向量-属性查询提供了高效且通用的解决方案。

Abstract: Modern retrieval systems increasingly require integrating approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) with complex attribute filtering to handle hybrid queries in applications such as recommendation systems and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). While HNSW-based inline-filtering methods show promise, existing approaches struggle to deliver high throughput under low-selectivity scenarios while balancing search efficiency, filtering generality, and index connectivity. To address these challenges, we propose FAVOR, an efficient filter-agnostic vector ANNS that supports arbitrary filtering conditions while maintaining stable performance across varying selectivity levels. FAVOR introduces three novel features: (1) an integrated architecture that unifies selectivity estimation and filtered ANNS execution, providing a cohesive solution for hybrid vector-attribute queries; (2) a HNSW-based inline-filtering algorithm that introduces an exclusion distance mechanism to dynamically reshape the vector distance distribution, pushing non-target vectors away from the query while promoting valid candidates toward the query, thus improving search efficiency without compromising generality or graph connectivity; and (3) a selectivity-driven search selector that estimates query selectivity and dynamically routes queries between a pre-filtering brute-force algorithm for low-selectivity cases and an optimized HNSW-based search algorithm for other scenarios, ensuring consistent performance. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that FAVOR achieves a 1.3-5$\times$ higher QPS at $Recall@10 = 95\%$ compared to state-of-the-art methods for arbitrary filtering conditions, while maintaining competitive performance even against tailored solutions in some filtering conditions.

</details>

### [394] [GraphDC: A Divide-and-Conquer Multi-Agent System for Scalable Graph Algorithm Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06671)
*Wenjin Li,Jiaming Cui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GraphDC是一种基于"分而治之"策略的多智能体框架，旨在提升大语言模型在图算法推理任务上的可扩展性和性能。该框架通过将大型图分解为子图，由专门智能体进行局部推理，再由主智能体整合全局信息来生成最终答案，有效降低了单个智能体的推理负担，提高了处理大规模图实例的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在图算法任务上表现不佳，原因在于图结构拓扑复杂，且往往需要系统性的多步推理，尤其在处理大规模图时问题更为突出。端到端直接推理方法在此场景下可靠性不足。

Method: 提出GraphDC多智能体框架，包含三个核心步骤：(1) 将输入图分解为更小的子图；(2) 为每个子图分配专门的智能体进行局部推理；(3) 由主智能体整合各子图的局部输出及子图间信息，最终生成完整解答。该层次化设计有效降低了推理复杂度。

Result: 大量实验表明，GraphDC在多种图算法推理任务上均一致性地优于现有方法，且在更大规模的图实例上优势更为显著，此时端到端直接推理的可靠性明显下降。

Conclusion: 基于分而治之策略的多智能体框架能够有效提升LLM在图算法推理任务上的可扩展性，通过分层设计减轻单个智能体的推理负担，缓解计算瓶颈，并在大型图实例上展现出更强的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for many mathematical problems. However, their performance on graph algorithmic tasks is still unsatisfying, since graphs are naturally more complex in topology and often require systematic multi-step reasoning, especially on larger graphs. Motivated by this gap, we propose GraphDC, a Divide-and-Conquer multi-agent framework for scalable graph algorithm reasoning. Specifically, inspired by Divide-and-Conquer design, GraphDC decomposes an input graph into smaller subgraphs, assigns each subgraph to a specialized agent for local reasoning, and uses a master agent to integrate the local outputs with inter-subgraph information to produce the final solution. This hierarchical design reduces the reasoning burden on individual agents, alleviates computational bottlenecks, and improves robustness on large graph instances. Extensive experiments show that GraphDC consistently outperforms existing methods on graph algorithm reasoning across diverse tasks and scales, especially on larger instances where direct end-to-end reasoning is less reliable.

</details>


### [395] [More Thinking, More Bias: Length-Driven Position Bias in Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06672)
*Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 推理模型的位置偏差随推理轨迹长度增加而非减少，准确率仅掩盖而非消除偏差机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chain-of-thought推理和DeepSeek-R1等推理调优模型被假定能减少浅层启发式偏差，但位置偏差在选择题问答中的表现尚不清楚。

Method: 跨13种推理模式配置（2个R1蒸馏7-8B模型、2个基模型CoT提示、DeepSeek-R1 671B）在MMLU、ARC-Challenge、GPQA上测试；使用偏相关分析控制准确率后的轨迹长度与PBS关系；截断干预实验提供因果证据。

Result: 12/13种配置显示轨迹长度与PBS正相关（0.11-0.41，p<0.05）；所有12个开源推理配置在长度四分位上显示单调递增PBS；截断实验中从更晚位置恢复的回复更倾向于位置偏好选项（R1-Qwen-7B从16%升至32%）；671B模型聚合PBS低至0.019但最长四分位仍显示PBS=0.071；直接回答的位置偏差与轨迹长度无关，是独立现象。

Conclusion: 推理模型的顺序鲁棒性不能被视为理所当然，需要在MCQ评估流程中进行系统性审计；论文提供了诊断工具包（PBS、承诺变化点、有效切换、截断探测）用于检测位置偏差。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and reasoning-tuned models such as DeepSeek-R1 are commonly assumed to reduce shallow heuristic biases by thinking carefully. We test this on position bias in multiple-choice QA and find a different story: within any reasoning-capable model, per-question position bias scales with the length of the reasoning trajectory.
  Across thirteen reasoning-mode configurations (two R1-distilled 7-8B models, two base models prompted with CoT, and DeepSeek-R1 at 671B) on MMLU, ARC-Challenge, and GPQA, twelve show a positive partial correlation between trajectory length and Position Bias Score (PBS) after controlling for accuracy, ranging from 0.11 to 0.41 (all p < 0.05). All twelve open-weight reasoning-mode configurations show monotonically increasing PBS across length quartiles. A truncation intervention provides causal evidence: continuations resumed from later points in the trajectory are increasingly likely to shift toward position-preferred options (16% to 32% for R1-Qwen-7B across absolute-position buckets).
  At 671B, aggregate PBS collapses to 0.019, but the length effect still manifests in the longest quartile (PBS = 0.071), suggesting that accuracy gates the expression of length-driven bias rather than eliminating the underlying mechanism. We additionally find that direct-answer position bias is a distinct phenomenon with a different footprint (strong in Llama-Instruct-direct, weak in Qwen-Instruct-direct, and uncorrelated with trajectory length): CoT reasoning replaces this baseline bias with length-accumulated bias.
  Our results argue that reasoning-capable models should not be treated as order-robust by default in MCQ evaluation pipelines, and offer a diagnostic toolkit (PBS, commitment change point, effective switching, truncation probes) for auditing position bias in reasoning models.

</details>


### [396] [Fast and Effective Redistricting Optimization via Composite-Move Tabu Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06682)
*Hai Jin,Diansheng Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种复合移动Tabu搜索算法(CM-Tabu)，通过分析邻接图的割点和双连通分量，在保持连通性的同时系统性地扩展搜索邻域，有效解决了空间区划问题中连通性约束导致的邻域缩小和局部最优陷阱问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间区划(spatial redistricting)是一个实际组合优化问题，需要高质量解、快速周转和灵活的多标准目标及交互式优化能力。核心挑战在于连通性约束：强制连通性会严重缩小整数规划或启发式搜索的可行邻域，削弱探索能力，并将搜索困于较差的局部最优。

Method: 提出复合移动Tabu搜索(CM-Tabu)：当边界单元单独重新分配会切断其所在选区时，算法识别可一起移动的最小单元集，或可交换的一对单元(或单元集)，作为保持连通性的复合移动。利用割点(articulation points)和双连通分量(biconnected components)分析每个选区的连通图，以线性时间生成候选的单单元和复合移动。

Result: 费城案例中，该方法能够一致地达到人口均等化的理论全局最优，并支持多标准权衡。相比传统Tabu搜索和其他基准方法，显著提高了解质量、运行间鲁棒性和计算效率。

Conclusion: CM-Tabu提供适合实际应用和决策支持工作流程的优化性能。

Abstract: Spatial redistricting is a practical combinatorial optimization problem that demands high-quality solutions, rapid turnaround, and flexibility to accommodate multi-criteria objectives and interactive refinement. A central challenge is the contiguity constraint: enforcing contiguity in integer-programming or heuristic search can severely shrink the feasible neighborhood, weaken exploration, and trap the search in poor local optima. We introduce a composite-move Tabu search (CM-Tabu) that systematically expands the feasible neighborhood space in Tabu search while preserving contiguity. When a boundary unit cannot be reassigned individually without disconnecting its district, our method identifies a minimal set of units that can move together, or a pair of units (or sets of units) that can be switched, as a contiguity-preserving composite move. Candidate single-unit and composite moves are generated in linear time by analyzing each district's contiguity graph using articulation points and biconnected components. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach substantially improves solution quality, run-to-run robustness, and computational efficiency relative to traditional Tabu search and other baselines. For example, in the Philadelphia case, the approach can consistently attain the theoretical global optimum in population-equality and support multi-criteria trade-offs. CM-Tabu delivers optimization performance suitable for real-world practices and decision-support workflows.

</details>


### [397] [State Representation and Termination for Recursive Reasoning Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06690)
*Debashis Guha,Amritendu Mukherjee,Sanjay Kukreja,Tarun Kumar*

Main category: cs.AI
