Method: 1) 问题形式化：冻结诊断分类器（REFUGE 训练的 SwinV2）+ 可训练多专家路由策略，动作空间为 AI 动作 0 加 M=12 位专家动作，π_i 落在掩码单纯形 Δ(A_i) 上；用 defer–allocate 因子分解 π_i=(1−d_i, d_i q_i)，d_i 为软转交质量，q_i 为可行专家上的条件分配。损失为非对称代价 C^ai=c_fn·y(1−p)+c_fp(1−y)p 与专家代价 C^exp 加上专家层级运营成本 γκ_j 的期望混合。
2) 双头路由：defer head 输出 d_i=1[|S_i|>0]·σ(f_def(h))；expert head 经共享 trunk 产生支持选择 logits γ_i 与分配 logits β_i。Stage I 用掩码 Gumbel–sigmoid（binary concrete + straight-through）做可行支持选择，因 log m 掩码在硬/软两个层面都精确置零，不可行专家梯度恒为 0；Stage II 用掩码 softmax 在可行集上归一化分配；独立 Bernoulli 可能选空，故用"回退到完整可行掩码"修复支持 s^♯，再重归一化得 q_i。
3) 多信号状态：冻结 logits、不确定性 u、ViM(OOD)、图像质量风险，以及由 vCDR/aCDR 导出的结构风险 p^str 与 AI–结构分歧特征，三分支编码后融合。
4) GSDP：按"可用性支持族×簇"分组，用层级经验贝叶斯收缩（global→family→group，带伪计数 n0 与 uniform floor u_ℓ）构造可靠性加权先验 p̃_g，再以 KL(q̃_g‖p̃_g) 按组有效转交负载 ω_g 加权惩罚（等价于把组级实际负载 Q_g 匹配到 D_g p̃_g）。
5) 秩主导化 JS 正则：把 q_i 排序后与截断几何参考分布比较，仅当累积前缀质量超过参考加松弛 m 时激活（χ_i），按 d_i 加权惩罚 JS 散度，防止样本级 top-heavy 分配。
6) 增强拉格朗日预算控制：对 d̄≤ρ_def 使用线性+二次罚项，λ_def 每轮投影上升更新；另以 masked-simplex 投影作最终安全层。训练用 AdamW、Optuna+TPE+Hyperband 的 16 维 HPO，全部在验证集选择。
7) 标签构造：REFUGE 无稠密专家诊断，由视盘/杯椭圆几何（vCDR/aCDR/偏心度）拟合逐专家 logistic 分数，温度标定后按 case-specific Se/Sp（随几何难度调制）用 Poisson–binomial 采样并施加 K_i≥k_min 的面板质量约束生成半合成专家标签；ORIGA 无专家标注，用 DINOv2+RETFound-MAE 裁剪视网膜表征空间的标签匹配 kNN 检索生成稀疏伪专家标签；CHAKSU 使用 5 位眼科医师原生决策，与 REFUGE 7 位标注者合并为 12 位不相交专家，逐样本可得性构成掩码。

Result: 整体测试集（N=899）：MPD²-Router Acc 0.960、Prec 0.849、F1 0.868、Sens 0.887、Spec 0.973、MCC 0.844、转交率 43.7%、ClinicalCost 0.068、ExpertCost 0.113、TotalCost 0.181，全面优于 AI-Only（Acc 0.755/F1 0.530/MCC 0.482/成本 0.372）与五个基线（Mao-TwoStage、Narasimhan-PH、Verma-OvA、Hemmer-MoE、Keswani-Joint Committee），且转交率远低于 Verma-OvA 的 74.7% 与 Hemmer-MoE 的 62.6%；在 F1–成本、MCC–成本平面上 Pareto 占优。
跨队列稳健性：REFUGE 0.975 Acc/0.113 TotalCost、CHAKSU 0.958/0.188、ORIGA 0.926/0.335（AI-Only 在 ORIGA 仅 0.491 Acc、0.773 临床成本），即在强 OOD 偏移下把性能恢复至 0.867 F1/0.820 MCC。
专家塌缩诊断：Top-1 份额 24.7%、Top-2 44.0%、熵塌缩 0.225、有效专家数 6.027、Gini_norm 0.595，优于 Hemmer-MoE 与 Keswani（后者 Top-1 87.6%、N_eff 仅 1.284），接近但未全面超过 Narasimhan-PH。
风险分层：沿 aCDR/vCDR（结构风险）与 OOD+不确定性（可靠性风险）分位分层，MPD²-Router 的成本随风险上升最慢，在最高风险五分位显著低于 AI-Only。
与人类对比：在 12/12 个专家的匹配可用子集上 F1 均优于该专家本人（最大 +0.48），且对最强 CHAKSU 阅片者仍有正增益；AI 保留子集上 REFUGE 保留 75.5% 且保留段 Acc 0.997/成本 0.007，ORIGA 保留 20.2% 且 100% 准确、零临床成本。
消融：去掉 tier-cost 代价项使 ExpertCost 由 0.133 升至 0.169、软转交 0.517→0.633；仅用临床代价会塌缩为 96.4% 无差别转交；去掉 GSDP/Rank-JS 几乎不影响精度但使 Top-1 份额 0.371→0.455/0.398（同时去掉则 0.493）、N_eff 7.603→6.082、HHI 近翻倍，证明二者分工不同且不牺牲诊断性能；AL 预算从 0.25 增至 0.70 时实际软转交单调从 0.239 升至 0.517 且始终不超预算（gap 为负），AL40–AL70 的 Acc 0.942–0.947、F1 0.813–0.825 接近无约束结果。

Conclusion: MPD²-Router 表明，将青光眼分诊建模为"掩码感知的受约束人机路由"而非分类问题，可同时解决标准 L2D 的无差别转交、专家塌缩、非对称伤害与分布偏移四类部署失效：分离"是否转交"与"转交给谁"、以 Gumbel–sigmoid 掩码门控严格落实逐样本可用性、用 GSDP 与秩-JS 共同抑制塌缩、用增强拉格朗日精确控制转交预算，从而在中等转交率下获得低临床成本、高 MCC 与均衡专家负载，并在跨队列偏移下保持有效性。作者明确指出局限：缺乏稠密的前瞻性多专家标注，评估依赖回顾性跨队列数据与部分半合成/伪标签（REFUGE 半合成、ORIGA 基于检索的伪标注），因此仍需前瞻性临床验证与相应监管审查方可部署；此外方法在每个域指标上并非全面最优（如 CHAKSU 上略逊于部分基线），其优势在于更可部署的折中操作点而非单项最优。

Abstract: Learning-to-defer (L2D) can make glaucoma screening safer by routing difficult/uncertain cases to humans, yet standard formulations overlook expert availability, heterogeneous readers behavior, workload imbalance, asymmetric diagnostic harm, case difficulty from morphology and deployment shift. We introduce MPD$^2$-Router, a mask-aware multi-expert deferral framework that recasts ophthalmic triage as constrained human--AI routing: whether to defer and to which available expert. It couples a dual-head deferral/allocation policy with mask-aware Gumbel--sigmoid gating that strictly enforces per-sample availability, and fuses uncertainty, morphology, image-quality, and OOD signals. Training uses an asymmetric cost-sensitive objective with an augmented-Lagrangian deferral budget, a group-specific distribution prior, and a rank-majorization JS regularizer that jointly prevent expert collapse without forcing uniform allocation. Across three cross-national glaucoma cohorts (REFUGE, CHAKSU, ORIGA) with a frozen REFUGE-trained backbone, MPD$^2$-Router substantially lowers clinical cost and improves MCC over AI-only at a moderate deferral rate. It is Pareto-optimal in F1--MCC--cost, robust under cross-domain shift, and yields balanced expert utilization.

</details>


### [472] [Rubric-Grounded RL: Structured Judge Rewards for Generalizable Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08061)
*Manish Bhattarai,Ismael Boureima,Nishath Rajiv Ranasinghe,Scott Pakin,Dan O'Malley*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出并形式化了「Rubric-Grounded RL（基于评分细则的强化学习）」框架：将奖励分解为多个带权重的、可验证的评分准则，由一个冻结的 LLM 裁判在策略不可见的辅助证据（grounding）下逐准则打分，聚合为归一化标量奖励并用 GRPO 优化策略。作者基于约 10 万篇 OSTI 科技文档合成问题–评分细则对，用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 训练后，留出集 rubric 归一化奖励达 71.7%（基座 26.1%、SFT 41.8%），并在 GSM8K/MATH/GPQA Main/GPQA Diamond 上取得平均 +5.13 分的迁移提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型 RL 的核心瓶颈是奖励设计：RLHF/RLAIF/DPO 等把多维质量压缩为单一标量（偏好分数、成对比较或二值验证器），在质量天然可分解的任务（技术问答、临床摘要、法律起草、代码评审）上会丢失结构信息，也就丢失了「部分正确」的学习信号。作者主张把奖励显式分解为带权重、可局部检验的准则列表，并让 LLM 裁判依据每个实例的 grounding 证据逐项打分，从而提供比二值或整体式打分更高分辨率的优化目标；同时该框架与具体领域无关，只要质量能写成加权检查表即可套用（临床指南、代码风格规范、评分方案等）。与 Rubrics as Rewards、Rubric Anchors、Rubric-Scaffolded RL 等最接近工作的差异在于：rubric 源自科学文档合成、策略在 rollout 阶段永远看不到源文档、rubric 合成与在线判分解耦（可用更强模型离线合成、更便宜模型在线判分）。

Method: 框架定义：任务实例为 (x, g, ℛ)，策略仅观测 x 生成 y，冻结裁判 J 观测 (x, g, y, ℛ) 打分。Rubric ℛ={c_1..c_M}，每条准则含非负权重 w_j、描述 η_j、必需要素 E_j、期望关键词 κ_j、验证方式 ν_j，总权重 W=Σw_j；裁判输出逐准则得分 s_j∈[0,w_j]，奖励归一化为 r=Σs_j/W∈[0,1]。GRPO 部分：每 prompt 采样 G=32 个回答，leave-one-out 基线 b_i^(g)=Σ_{g'≠g}R/（G−1）与组内标准差 σ_i 给出归一化优势 A=(R−b)/(σ+δ)，广播到所有 token；采用 clipped surrogate、k3 KL 估计（β=0.01，ε_clip=0.2，δ=1e−8）、逐 token 平均损失与 mask。机制分析给出：分辨率提升（可获 ∏|Z_j| 级奖励）、局部化（优势差异等于加权准则差之和）、特权信息式训练（grounding 仅 verifier 可见）、以及噪声衰减 Var(αᵀξ)=τ²/M_eff，M_eff=W²/Σw_j²，等权时为 M。实例化：OSTI 约 10 万篇文档经三阶段 LLM 流程生成问题–passage–rubric（语义分析 → 问题与 rubric 联合合成 → rubric 富化），加结构化质量校验（最少准则数、最小总权重、字段完整、权重非负），5–10 条准则，70/15/15 划分。训练：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，π_ref 同源初始化，B=64、G=32（有效批量 2048），AdamW lr=3e−7、weight decay 0.01、梯度裁剪 1.0、13 步 warmup 后常数学习率，单轮对话；数据合成用 GPT-OSS-120B，裁判用 GPT-OSS-20B（温度 0.1、JSON 结构化输出、解析失败给 0 分、32 个并行 judge worker、micro-batch 4）；基于 NeMo-RL 实现，生成与判分 worker 分离。

Result: 域内留出 rubric 奖励：Base 26.1% → SFT 41.8% → GRPO 71.7%（图 2 中约从 2.6/10 提升到 7.1/10，接近 GPT-OSS-120B 水平并超过若干更大对比模型）。域外推理基准（同一提示与解码设置、单样本准确率）：GSM8K 84.53→85.44、MATH 50.06→52.88、GPQA Main 25.22→33.93、GPQA Diamond 24.24→32.32，平均 +5.13，其中 GPQA 增益（+8.71/+8.08）明显大于数学类增益。训练动态：训练与验证奖励同步上升、零奖励判分比例单调下降，验证与训练间隙有界。附录中给出 LOO 基线无偏且与自身不相关的性质、k3 KL 非负性与二阶展开，以及未被主实验启用的变体（token/序列级重要性采样、双重裁剪、DAPO 动态采样、长度/截断奖励塑形）。

Conclusion: 结果表明结构化、文档 grounding 的奖励既提升域内 rubric 表现，又能诱导跨语料的行为迁移（尤其在需要协调事实、假设与证据的 GPQA 类科学推理上），为「质量天然呈 rubric 形状」的领域提供了一条有前景的后训练配方。作者同时明确限定证据强度：仅一个模型规模（8B）、一个语料族、一个裁判家族、一次 GRPO 运行，未做完整消融以隔离各组件因果贡献，无置信区间与多随机种子结果，训练与验证共用同一裁判族因而留出奖励本身不能排除 judge-specific reward hacking，尚缺人工一致性或跨裁判可靠性测量；此外单轮设定、未验证多轮交互，管线生成的题目以通用技术问答为主而非定量/代码任务，故数学与代码增益有限——后续可通过定向筛选含数学/数据分析/编程内容的文档、并在准则中显式加入方程建立、单位检查、代码正确性与可执行测试等维度来检验该配方能否进一步扩展到数学与代码基准。

Abstract: We argue that decomposing reward into weighted, verifiable criteria and using an LLM judge to score them provides a partial-credit optimization signal: instead of a binary outcome or a single holistic score, each response is graded along multiple task-specific criteria. We formalize \emph{rubric-grounded reinforcement learning (RL)}: a framework in which the policy is optimized against a structured, multi-criterion reward produced by a frozen LLM judge that conditions on auxiliary grounding the policy never sees. We instantiate the framework by deriving rubrics from an Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI)-derived corpus of roughly 100,000 scientific and technical documents and training Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). With GRPO-based training, the model achieves $71.7\%$ normalized reward on held-out rubric evaluation. The GRPO-tuned policy also improves over the base model on four reasoning benchmarks not derived from the training corpus -- GSM8K, MATH, GPQA Main, and GPQA Diamond. These results provide evidence that structured, document-grounded rewards can improve held-out rubric performance and induce transferable reasoning behaviors beyond the corpus used to construct the training environment.

</details>


### [473] [VecCISC: Improving Confidence-Informed Self-Consistency with Reasoning Trace Clustering and Candidate Answer Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08070)
*James Petullo,Sonny George,Dylan Cashman,Nianwen Xue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VecCISC 是一种轻量级自适应框架，通过对推理轨迹（reasoning trace）做嵌入聚类并筛选代表性候选，仅将高质量、去冗余的轨迹送入 critic LLM 计算置信度，从而在保持甚至略超 CISC 精度的前提下，将全流程 token 消耗降低 47%（critic 调用次数减少约 30–35%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）中的 Self-Consistency 需采样多条推理轨迹并对候选答案投票，而 CISC（Confidence-Informed Self-Consistency）通过“think twice”范式——为每条轨迹额外调用一个 critic LLM 输出 0–1 置信度，再做加权多数投票——在多种基准上显著提升准确率。但该方案存在两大问题：(1) 每个候选样本都需一次额外的、提示词冗长的 LLM 调用，推高推理开销与成本（critic 调用约占全流程 token 的 77%）；(2) 朴素 CISC 不区分幻觉、退化（文本崩塌）等低质量样本与优质样本，对所有样本一视同仁地调用 critic。动机即在不牺牲准确率的前提下削减“think twice”管线的成本。

Method: 流程：①采样——以预算 n=20 从生成模型 LLM_gen（温度 0.7）采样 n 条（推理轨迹 r_i, 答案 a_i）构成候选池 P；②嵌入——用通用嵌入模型 text-embedding-3-small 对每条推理轨迹编码得 Emb(r_i)∈R^d；③按答案分组——先按唯一答案 a 将轨迹分入组 G_a，以保证不同候选答案不被合并；④聚类——在每个 G_a 内用 KMeans 或层次凝聚聚类（HAC，cosine 距离 + average linkage）分成 min(K,|G_a|) 个簇，K 由网格搜索（在每个 dataset×model 组合的 20% holdout 上，K∈[0,20]）确定；之所以不用 DBSCAN，是因为高维嵌入空间中距离阈值 D 极难选取、轻微扰动会剧烈改变簇结构；⑤代表选择——计算各簇质心 U_i，选取与质心余弦相似度最高的轨迹作为代表（min-centroid），理由是语义偏离最小的轨迹最不易含异常推理错误；⑥置信度打分——仅对每个答案的代表轨迹调用 critic LLM（温度 0.3，verbal confidence 0–1 评分，提示词为 instruction∘question∘reasoning∘answer），得分经温度 T 的 softmax 归一化；⑦加权多数投票——累加每个候选答案的归一化置信度并取最大值作为最终答案。超参 T 在 [0,5] 网格搜索获得。对照方法包括：SC baseline、CISC、VecCISC (random)（每组随机抽 K 条，消融）、VecCISC+KMeans、VecCISC+HAC，以及 min-centroid 与 rand-trace 两种代表选择策略的消融。评测覆盖 5 个数据集（AQuA-RAT、CommonsenseQA、ARC-Challenging、MMLU-Pro、GPQA）与 5 个模型（GPT-4o mini、Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen2.5 7B、Mistral 7B v0.1、Llama 3.3 70B），每组合重复 10 次报告最优与均值，指标为 critic 调用预算削减率、token 削减率与准确率。

Result: ①Critic 调用削减：VecCISC+KMeans 平均减少 34.68% 的 critic 调用，VecCISC+HAC 平均减少 30.2%；计入 SC 采样在内的全管线调用削减分别为 17.34% 与 15.1%。②Token 削减：KMeans 变体使 critic token 下降 36.2%，HAC 变体下降 31.69%；对全流程 token 消耗平均削减 47%（token 数按 length(prompt)/4 估算）。③代表选择消融：min-centroid 在 60%（KMeans）/68%（HAC）的模型-数据集组合上比 rand-trace 更省 token，说明其倾向选中更短且更高质量的轨迹。④准确率：VecCISC+HAC 在几乎所有组合上取得最佳或次优平均分，整体优于 CISC 与 SC（如 MMLU-Pro + GPT-4o mini：66.1 vs CISC 65.9、SC 64.6；GPQA + GPT-4o mini：41.4 vs 40.5/39.9），HAC 在除 (AQuA-RAT, Mistral 7B) 与 (CommonsenseQA, GPT-4o mini) 外的所有组合上均值最佳。⑤关键消融结论：VecCISC(random) 在全部组合上显著劣于 CISC 与 SC（如 AQuA-RAT + Llama 3.1 8B 平均 66.5 vs SC 82.6），证明性能增益来自语义聚类选代表，而非单纯减少样本数。⑥案例研究：MMLU-Pro “Kingpin” 题的 20 条正确轨迹被按语义/措辞/推理步骤有效聚为 9 簇；ARC-Challenging 恐龙化石题的簇中，min-centroid 成功选中正常轨迹、规避了含文本崩塌（退化为伪代码乱码）的第 3 条轨迹。

Conclusion: VecCISC 证明，通过对候选推理轨迹做嵌入聚类并只让 critic 评估每簇的语义代表，可以用“更少但更高质量”的轨迹支撑“think twice”置信度估计，在大幅削减推理成本（整体 token 降 47%）的同时保持甚至略微提升 CISC 的准确率，因而可作为既有 think-twice 管线的轻量级增强模块。局限与展望：使用通用嵌入模型，面向特定领域任务可换用微调嵌入模型；K 与 T 依赖有标注数据的网格搜索，未来需研究无先验数据的自适应选取方式。

Abstract: A standard technique for scaling inference-time reasoning is Self-Consistency, whereby multiple candidate answers are sampled from an LLM and the most common answer is selected. More recently, it has been shown that weighted majority voting (e.g. Confidence-Informed Self Consistency (CISC)), which assigns a confidence value to each candidate answer and chooses the answer with the largest accumulated score, tends to be more accurate on a wide range of popular benchmarks. In practice, weighted majority voting necessitates calling a critic LLM on each candidate's reasoning trace to produce the answer's confidence score. This secondary series of LLM calls greatly increases the overhead and cost of weighted majority voting, despite its potential performance benefits. To reduce this expense, we propose VecCISC, a lightweight, adaptive framework that uses a measure of semantic similarity to filter reasoning traces that are semantically equivalent to others, degenerate, or hallucinated, thus decreasing the number of candidate answers that must be evaluated by the critic. To ensure adequate experimental thoroughness, we evaluate VecCISC on five challenging, widely-adopted datasets spanning the domains of mathematics, chemistry, biology, commonsense reasoning, and the humanities. Our results demonstrate that VecCISC reduces the total token usage by 47%, while maintaining or exceeding the accuracy of CISC.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [474] [EMRGF: A Practitioner Framework for Governance-Driven Enterprise Technology Modernization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06703)
*Harveen Punihani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对企业技术现代化项目高失败率问题，提出真正原因在于治理缺陷而非工程能力不足，并提出EMRGF框架作为解决方案。该框架包含四个模块、五种实施工具和培训师培训制度化模型，经验证可实现开发工作量减少30%、测试周期减少35%、零中断迁移和99.9%数据可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业技术现代化项目以高成本和高失败率著称，而主流解释（工程能力不足）被本文认为是不准确的。作者指出现有框架（ITIL、COBIT、TOGAF等）未能提供集成化、可移植的制度化运营模式，导致治理缺陷成为主要失败原因。

Method: 该研究基于24年跨金融服务业、制造业和零售业的实践经验，提出Enterprise Modernization Reliability and Governance Framework (EMRGF)，包含四个相互锁定的模块：云与遗留系统现代化治理、数据平台可靠性与证据完整性、AI赋能自动化治理、以及任务关键可靠性与根因分析例程，并通过五种实施工具和培训师培训制度化模型进行运营化。

Result: EMRGF框架的规模化应用产生了显著效果：开发工作量减少30%，测试周期减少35%，高数据量 estates 的零中断迁移，任务关键分析管道实现99.9%数据可靠性。

Conclusion: EMRGF是一个从业者开发的治理运营模型，明确对齐美国国家政策指令（NIST CSF 2.0、NIST AI RMF、执行令14028和14110），专为制度化采用设计，无需持续外部依赖即可实现。

Abstract: Enterprise technology modernization programs fail at a documented and costly rate, yet the dominant explanation -- inadequate engineering capability -- is incorrect. The primary failure mode is a governance deficit: the absence of structured, repeatable operating routines for how organizations plan, execute, validate, and hand off complex technology change. Existing frameworks -- ITIL, COBIT, TOGAF, scaled agile methodologies, and cloud provider well-architected frameworks -- address adjacent concerns but do not provide an integrated, portable institutional operating model for controlled modernization across migrations, data platforms, and AI-enabled automation. This article presents the Enterprise Modernization Reliability and Governance Framework (EMRGF), a practitioner-developed governance operating model derived from 24 years of applied delivery experience across financial services, industrial manufacturing, and retail enterprises. EMRGF comprises four interlocking modules -- Cloud and Legacy Modernization Governance, Data Platform Reliability and Evidence Integrity, AI-Enabled Automation Governance, and Mission-Critical Reliability and Root-Cause Routines -- operationalized through five implementation tools and a training-of-trainers institutionalization model. Empirical application at scale has produced a 30% reduction in development effort, a 35% reduction in testing cycles, zero-disruption migrations across high-volume data estates, and 99.9% data reliability in mission-critical analytics pipelines. The framework is explicitly aligned with U.S. national policy mandates including NIST CSF 2.0, NIST AI RMF, and Executive Orders 14028 and 14110, and is designed for institutional adoption without ongoing external dependency.

</details>


### [475] [The Single-File Test: A Longitudinal Public-Interface Evaluation of First-Output LLM Web Generation with Social Reach Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06707)
*Diego Cabezas Palacios*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究通过"HTML AI Battle"项目，对GPT、Gemini、Grok、Claude四个推理模型家族的HTML生成能力进行了8周观测比较。Claude家族表现最佳，在17个提示中有9个获胜，但较长的推理时间与更高质量无关。模型家族比提示措辞更能预测代码冗长程度，而公共指标不足以预测社交媒体影响力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI模型比较研究存在自定义指令、人格调优和修复提示等变量干扰，缺乏标准化、可复现的公共接口协议下的公平评估方法。

Method: 68个单文件HTML生成样本，17个公开实验，四个模型家族在固定公共接口协议下进行对比。使用人类评分与Gemini LLM作为评判层，评估提示遵循度、功能正确性和UI质量。同时进行两个监督预测分析：实验级别的24小时X平台曝光量模型和生成级别的HTML行数模型。

Result: Claude家族表现最强且最稳定，在人类加权评分中赢得17个提示中的9个。长推理时间与整体质量无正相关。Gemini评判者比人类评估者更宽松，且存在自我偏好偏差。X平台曝光量预测模型较弱（MAE=46,874，R²=-0.377），而HTML行数预测模型表现较好（MAE=135.2，R²=0.576），模型家族基线优于提示感知替代方案。

Conclusion: Claude在HTML生成任务中领先；代码冗长程度主要由模型家族驱动而非提示措辞；公开的技术/音频变量不足以预测24小时X平台触达量。研究受限于观测性设计、公共接口漂移、访问路径差异和单一人类评分者。

Abstract: This paper presents an eight-week observational comparison of 68 single-file HTML generations collected across 17 public experiments in the "HTML AI Battle" project between December 10, 2025 and February 4, 2026. Four reasoning model families, GPT, Gemini, Grok, and Claude, were compared under a fixed public-interface protocol with no custom instructions, no personality tuning, and no repair prompts. Each output was evaluated from a rendered browser video using human scores and a Gemini LLM-as-a-judge layer for prompt adherence, functional correctness, and UI quality, then packaged into a standardized social-media protocol spanning X (Twitter), TikTok, and YouTube. The tracker was also used for two supervised predictive analyses: an experiment-level model for 24-hour X impressions and a generation-level model for HTML verbosity.
  Under this protocol, Claude was the strongest and most consistent family, leading mean performance and winning 9/17 prompts under the primary human weighted score. Longer measured reasoning time was not associated with higher quality overall. Gemini as a judge was significantly more lenient than the human evaluator on functional correctness and overall performance, while stable self-favoring bias remained unresolved. The exploratory X-impressions model remained weak under post-screen cross-validation (MAE = 46,874, R^2 = -0.377), whereas the HTML-lines model performed better, with a model-family-only baseline outperforming prompt-aware alternatives (MAE = 135.2, R^2 = 0.576). Overall, selected pre-publication technical/audio variables were not sufficient to predict 24-hour X reach, while code verbosity was driven much more by model family than by prompt wording. The comparisons remain observational and are limited by public-interface drift, access-path differences, and one primary human scorer.

</details>


### [476] [Agentic Coding Needs Proactivity, Not Just Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06717)
*Nghi D. Q. Bui,Georgios Evangelopoulos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文探讨了编码智能体从辅助完成到主动介入的发展趋势，指出当前领域缺乏对"主动性"概念的清晰定义和评估标准，提出以"洞察策略"(insight policy)质量作为核心评估框架，并构建了包含反应式、计划式、情境感知式三个层次的主动性分类体系，以及IDQ、CGS、Learning Lift三个评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前领域缺乏对"主动性"在软件开发中含义的清晰界定，也缺少评判未经请求的智能体行为是否真正有用的标准和指标

Method: 提出三层次主动性分类法（反应式、计划式、情境感知式），对比当代编码智能体与五个实用标准，并设计主动用户模拟协议来评估洞察决策质量、上下文基础评分和学习提升效果

Result: 提出了"洞察策略"作为主动编码智能体的核心评估维度，建立了主动性的三层分类体系，并设计了具体的评估协议和三个量化指标（IDQ、CGS、Learning Lift）

Conclusion: 提出"洞察策略"(insight policy)作为评估主动编码智能体的核心框架，并设计了包含IDQ、CGS、Learning Lift三个指标的主动用户模拟评估协议

Abstract: Coding agents are rapidly changing the landscape of software development, moving from inline completion to autonomous systems that edit repositories, open pull requests, respond to issues, and run scheduled or webhook triggered routines across the development life cycle. The next generation is increasingly described as proactive and long-horizon: agents should notice relevant changes before the developer asks, connect signals across tools, decide when to interrupt, and carry preferences across sessions. Yet the field still lacks a clear account of what proactivity means for software development, how it differs from autonomy, what acceptance criteria proactive long-horizon tasks should satisfy, and which metrics determine whether unsolicited agent behavior is useful rather than merely active. Proactive coding agents should be evaluated by the quality and improvement of their insight policy: the policy that decides what matters next, what evidence supports it, whether to show it, and how to adapt after feedback. This view is grounded in the principles of mixed initiative interaction. We propose a three level taxonomy of proactivity (Reactive, Scheduled, and Situation Aware), compare contemporary coding agents against five practical criteria, and sketch an active user simulation protocol with three evaluation targets: Insight Decision Quality (IDQ), Context Grounding Score (CGS), and Learning Lift

</details>


### [477] [A Self-Healing Framework for Reliable LLM-Based Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06737)
*Cheonsu Jeong,Younggun Shin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可靠性感知的自我修复框架，用于解决LLM驱动软件智能体的不可靠性问题。该框架通过故障检测、可靠性评估和自动化恢复三大机制协同工作，在多智能体工作流环境中验证了其在提升任务成功率、增强系统鲁棒性方面的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的自主智能体在复杂软件系统中应用日益广泛，但面临幻觉、执行错误和推理不一致等不可预测故障，导致可靠性不足，制约了其在生产环境中的广泛部署。

Method: 首先定义了故障类型分类体系，并提出定量可靠性评估模型；其次设计了基于执行模式和输出一致性的异常行为识别方法；最后开发了通过自适应重规划和纠正性提示实现动态恢复的自我修复机制。该框架在多智能体工作流环境中实现并通过真实任务场景进行评估。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法显著提高了任务成功率，减少了故障传播，增强了系统鲁棒性。特别之处在于建立了整合智能体内部推理过程与外部执行结果的监控体系。

Conclusion: 该框架为保障高级自主系统的稳定性提供了有效方案，并有望降低LLM在生产环境中的应用门槛。通过整合内部推理过程与外部执行结果的监控机制，为LLM智能体的可靠性保障提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Autonomous agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being utilized in complex software systems. However, reliability remains a significant challenge due to unpredictable failures such as hallucinations, execution errors, and inconsistent reasoning. This paper proposes a reliability-aware self-healing framework for LLM-based software agents. The framework integrates failure detection, reliability assessment, and automated recovery mechanisms. First, we define a taxonomy of failure types and introduce a quantitative reliability assessment model. Next, we propose a failure detection method that identifies abnormal agent behavior based on execution patterns and output consistency. Finally, we design a self-healing mechanism that dynamically recovers from failures through adaptive replanning and corrective prompting strategies. The proposed framework was implemented in a multi-agent workflow environment and evaluated using real-world task scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly increases task success rates, reduces failure propagation, and enhances overall system robustness compared to existing methods. In particular, this study distinguishes itself by establishing an integrated monitoring system that combines the agent's internal reasoning process with external execution results. These findings are expected to contribute to securing the stability of advanced autonomous systems and lowering the barriers to LLM adoption in production environments.

</details>


### [478] [ScarfBench: A Benchmark for Cross-Framework Application Migration in Enterprise Java](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06754)
*Advait Pavuluri,Bridget McGinn,Ashita Saxena,George Safta,Srikanth Tamilselvam,Raju Pavuluri,Michele Merler,Baishakhi Ray,Rahul Krishna*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ScarfBench 是一个用于评估 LLM 编码智能体「行为保持的跨框架迁移」能力的基准测试，面向企业级 Java 应用。它包含 34 个应用族（Spring / Jakarta EE / Quarkus 三框架人工专家实现，共 102 个变体、约 151K 行 Java、1946 个文件），衍生出 204 个有向迁移任务，配套 1331 个专家编写的行为测试（1,389 条 Gherkin 场景）并在容器化「编译—部署—测试」三阶段门控的评测框架中打分。对 5 个前沿编码智能体（Claude Code/Opus 4.6、Gemini CLI/Gemini-3.1-Pro、Codex/GPT-5.4、OpenCode/GLM-5.1、Qwen CLI/Qwen3.5-397B）的评测显示：最强智能体在聚焦层迁移上测试通过率仅 15.3%，整应用仅 12.2%，204 个任务中仅 1 个达到完全行为等价；难度随目标框架显著不对称（迁移到 Jakarta EE 最难，仅 2% 通过，57% 在编译门即失败），并归纳出 13 类跨构建/部署/测试阶段的失败模式分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业级 Java 应用长期服役，其架构假设常在生产环境过时，因此需要跨框架（Spring / Jakarta EE / Quarkus）迁移以应对弃用压力与降低内存占用、加快启动、改善云弹性等非功能目标。这类迁移不是局部 API 替换：需要同时改造构建配置、依赖注入、持久化、请求处理、安全、响应式栈与部署打包，并在目标框架的编程模型与运行时假设下保持行为等价。然而现有软件工程基准（SWE-bench 系列、Multi-SWE-bench 等）主要覆盖缺陷修复、功能实现、代码补全与语言/版本升级；已有的迁移类基准（MigrationBench、JMigBench、FreshBrew、JavaBackports 等）虽更接近，但仍保留同一套框架抽象与运行时模型，未真正覆盖「跨框架」这一结构性转换。此外，已有的「编译通过 / 部署成功」类 oracle 会严重高估迁移质量——本文的核心论点之一正是「能构建并不预测正确性」。因此需要一个在容器化目标运行时中、以可观测行为等价为判据的、可复现的跨框架迁移基准。

Method: 【任务形式化】框架集合 F = {Spring, Jakarta EE, Quarkus}，应用族集合 A，任务实例为有序三元组 τ = (a, f_s, f_t)，输入源实现 I_{a,f_s} 与目标框架 f_t，输出需保持行为并使用目标框架原生范式的实现 Î_{a,f_t}。迁移是有向非对称变换（f_s→f_t ≠ f_t→f_s）。每个应用族共享一个框架中立的 oracle O_a，返回 (O_c 编译, O_d 部署, O_t 测试通过比例)，且为门控关系：O_d=0 若 O_c=0，O_t=0 若 O_d=0；任务成功严格定义为 1[O_t=1]。

【基准构建】34 个应用族全部由企业级 Java 专家手工实现三套框架变体，三个变体均须在容器化 harness 中编译、部署并通过完整 oracle 才被收录。focused 层 29 个应用源自 Eclipse 官方 jakartaee-examples 仓库，按 JSR 锚定五个层（依赖注入、托管并发、持久化、业务服务、表现层 HTTP/REST/WebSocket）；whole 层 5 个开源系统（cargotracker、coffee-shop、daytrader、petclinic、realworld）覆盖跨层耦合与外部服务（Kafka/JMS/PostgreSQL）。共 102 变体、204 有向任务、1331 个 @Test 方法、1389 条 Gherkin 场景。

【行为 oracle】以「可观测边界」（HTTP 路由、响应载荷、UI 流程、校验结果、持久状态变化）定义等价性，而非源码级单元测试，因为迁移本身会改变类布局、DI fixture、测试运行器与包结构。先按应用族定义 Gherkin feature 文件，再为每个框架变体具体化为 Playwright/pytest 测试，跨框架近乎一致，仅在框架确实暴露不同外部约定处（如 JSF 的 .xhtml 路径必须保留）才分叉。

【评测协议】五个智能体栈使用其标准仓库编辑/shell/构建/测试工具；每 (agent, task) 在 temperature 0 下运行一次，报告 pass@1，无推理期扩展。对比两种提示打包：单一整体提示 vs. skills 目录式模块化提示（6 个框架对技能包，每包含 SKILL.md + dependency-mapping/config-mapping/code-mapping 三个方向性参考文件）。执行 harness 依序执行三阶段：编译（框架专属 Maven 构建 + Docker）→ 部署（单容器或 Docker Compose，须在超时内发出就绪信号）→ 行为测试（断言通过率 S_τ；编译或部署失败则 S_τ=0，并记录首个失败阶段用于诊断）。

【失败分类】专家人工检视失败轨迹归纳出 13 类跨 build/deploy/test 三阶段的失败分类法，随后由两个独立 LLM 标注器（Claude Opus-4.7、GPT-5.5 xhigh）按固定分类法批量标注，专家审计分歧并仲裁；LLM 标注器间 Cohen's κ = 0.72。排除两类桶：智能体执行失败（LLM API 错误）与 harness 假阳性（插桩误报）。

【规模统计】每任务改动中位数 370 行增删、平均 11.4 个仅存于单侧的文件、源侧需读 360 行中位上下文；全库 204 任务编辑总量约 191 KLOC，最大 diff 为 DayTrader Spring↔Jakarta。评测成本约 4,958 美元（API 费用），本地执行环境为 48 vCPU / 约 188 GiB RAM 的 Linux VM。

Result: 【总体性能】跨框架迁移明显超出当前智能体能力。最强者在聚焦层任务上聚合测试通过率 15.3%，整应用仅 12.2%，204 个有向任务中仅 1 个产生完全行为等价的目标实现。

【三阶段漏斗】普遍呈现「编译多、部署少、通过更少」的漏斗。Claude Code + Opus-4.6 在整应用上 87% 编译 / 40% 部署 / 12% 测试（最强整应用），在聚焦层编译领先（93%）；Gemini CLI 在聚焦层部署与测试领先（61% / 15%）。这直接支撑发现 2：构建与部署成功不能预测行为正确性，仅用 build/deploy oracle 会大幅高估迁移质量。

【方向与层次不对称】按目标框架：迁移到 Quarkus 14%、Spring 12%、Jakarta EE 仅 2% 通过行为测试；57% 的 Jakarta 目标尝试在编译门即失败（对比 Spring 13%、Quarkus 28%），说明 Jakarta 的打包与服务器配置范式与模型已学到的框架惯例偏离最大。Spring↔Quarkus 相对最可解。层次上 focused 明显优于 whole。

【skills 效果】模块化技能提示主要提升可编译/可部署性，对行为正确性增益收窄：Gemini CLI 聚焦层部署从 7% 提升至 61%、Q→J 聚焦部署 7%→66%、Q→S 聚焦测试 0%→28%、Codex Q→S 聚焦测试 4%→39%；但整体应用行为成功率多数仍接近零。

【失败分类分布】构建阶段以依赖解析（OpenCode focused 达 79%）、代码编译（Gemini focused 48%）、项目结构、Maven 插件故障为主；部署阶段由资源/产物缺失、配置与启动错误、网络超时、容器退出、DI/数据库/类加载问题主导（典型错误如 Liberty 9080 端口 vs 测试期望 8080、Unsatisfied dependency、ConflictingBeanDefinition、NoClassDefFoundError: javax/persistence/Entity）；测试阶段集中于 HTTP 404 端点缺失、断言/内容不匹配、网络基础设施问题，说明失败多源于跨层协调与运行时一致性，而非孤立的 API 翻译错误。

【总体结论】当前智能体能在源码层可靠翻译框架 API，却极少能通过目标框架运行时模型重新表达应用行为；仓库级基准上的进步无法干净地迁移到这类必须真正在目标运行时执行的系统级转换。

Conclusion: 本文提出 ScarfBench——首个面向企业级 Java 跨框架行为保持重构的专家验证基准，并通过 5 个前沿智能体 × 204 个有向任务的实证评估得出三点核心发现：(1) 跨框架迁移已超出现有智能体能力上限（最强 15.3%/12.2% 测试通过，仅 1/204 完全等价）；(2) 编译与部署成功不能预测行为正确性，必须在容器化目标运行时中以可观测行为 oracle 判定；(3) 难度随目标框架显著不对称，Jakarta 最难、Spring↔Quarkus 最易，且失败集中于配置、依赖装配与部署的跨层协调点。因此，仓库级 SWE 基准的进展并不能干净地转化为系统级框架迁移能力，后者需要新的评测方法与专门的 agent 能力（构建体系迁移、配置意图推断、DI 消歧、消息模型重设计、端到端验证）。论文同时明确列出局限：顺序编译—部署—测试流水线会将「部分正确但构建失败」的候选记在最早失败阶段；每个 (agent, task) 仅温度 0 单次采样，结果为计算受限估计而非能力上限；oracle 仅覆盖可观测边界，不含竞态、资源泄漏与非功能回归，也不直接评分框架惯用性，且无形式化覆盖保证；分类法由专家归纳但 LLM 标注器未对人工标签单独校准（κ=0.72 仅反映 LLM 间一致性）；基准仅限企业级 Java，结论未必可推广到 .NET/Node.js；应用取自公开仓库（Eclipse jakartaee-examples、spring-petclinic），可能已进入前沿模型训练数据且未做去污染，报告结果可能部分反映记忆而非迁移能力。基准、harness 与智能体轨迹已开源发布于 https://scarfbench.info。

Abstract: Java remains central to enterprise software, and many applications outlive their original architecture. Migrating them across frameworks is a behavior-preserving refactoring spanning build configuration, dependency injection, persistence, request handling, and deployment. Existing software-engineering benchmarks cover bug fixing, feature implementation, and language or version modernization, but leave cross-framework refactoring largely unmeasured.
  We introduce ScarfBench, a benchmark for behavior-preserving cross-framework refactoring of enterprise Java applications. It is built from expert-written implementation triples across Spring, Jakarta EE, and Quarkus: 34 applications (29 focused single-layer, 5 whole) yielding 102 variants (~151K lines across 1946 source and test files) and 204 directed refactoring tasks. Each task gives an agent a working source application and a target framework; the agent must synthesize a target implementation preserving the source behavior. Correctness is evaluated by an application-specific executable oracle: the candidate must compile, deploy in a containerized target runtime, and pass behavioral tests over the application's observable interface.
  We evaluate five state-of-the-art coding agents on ScarfBench. The strongest achieves only 15.3% aggregate test pass on focused-layer migrations and 12.2% on whole applications, and only one of the 204 tasks yields a fully behaviorally equivalent target. Difficulty is asymmetric across framework directions and architectural layers: Spring<->Quarkus is the most tractable pair, and Jakarta-targeted migrations are hardest. From LLM-as-a-judge and expert adjudication of failed-task traces, we derive a taxonomy of recurring failure categories spanning build, deploy, and test stages. We release the benchmark, harness, and agent traces at https://scarfbench.info.

</details>


### [479] [Analyzing the Adoption of Database Management Systems Throughout the History of Open Source Projects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06817)
*Camila A. Paiva,Raquel Maximino,Frederico Paiva,Rafael Accetta Vieira,Nicole Espanha,João Felipe Pimentel,Igor Wiese,Marco Aurélio Gerosa,Igor Steinmacher,Leonardo Murta,Vanessa Braganholo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究对362个GitHub开源Java项目进行历史分析，揭示了DBMS的采用趋势和演化模式，发现关系型MySQL/PostgreSQL主导、非关系型Redis/MongoDB稳定、多DBMS共存及ORM广泛使用等关键现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然先前研究已探讨了DBMS与应用源代码的协同演化，但对于DBMS在实际系统中的采用、共用和替换模式了解较少，缺乏系统的实证研究。

Method: 通过源代码启发式方法，分析了362个托管在GitHub上的流行开源Java项目，研究了DBMS的流行度、稳定性、迁移模式、共现模式以及ORM框架的作用。

Result: MySQL和PostgreSQL是最流行的DBMS；在非关系型DBMS中，Redis和MongoDB使用最频繁且稳定性高；HyperSQL等系统则更易被替换；多DBMS共用现象频繁，表明多语言持久化模式普遍存在；ORM框架广泛用于应用与DBMS之间的交互中介。

Conclusion: 本研究为开发者、架构师、教育者和DBMS供应商提供了关于DBMS采用、组合和替换的实证证据，有助于指导数据库技术的选型和演进决策。

Abstract: Database Management Systems (DBMSs) are widely used to store, retrieve, and manage the data handled by modern applications. Although prior work has studied the co-evolution of DBMSs and application source code, less is known about DBMS adoption, co-use, and replacement in real systems. This paper presents a historical study of DBMS usage in 362 popular open-source Java projects hosted on GitHub. We investigated the adoption of the top DBMSs ranked by DB-Engines, covering relational and non-relational systems. Using source-code heuristics, we analyzed DBMS popularity, stability, migration patterns, co-occurrence, and the role of Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs). Our findings show that MySQL and PostgreSQL are the most popular DBMSs in our corpus. Among non-relational DBMSs, Redis and MongoDB are the most frequently used and tend to remain stable after adoption. In contrast, systems such as HyperSQL are more often replaced as projects evolve. We also observed frequent co-use of multiple DBMSs, suggesting patterns of polyglot persistence in which projects combine systems to handle different data needs. Finally, we found that ORM frameworks are commonly used to mediate interactions between applications and DBMSs. Overall, our study provides empirical evidence on how DBMSs are adopted, combined, and replaced over time, offering guidance for developers, architects, educators, and DBMS vendors.

</details>


### [480] [Guidelines for Cultivating a Sense of Belonging to Reduce Developer Burnout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06827)
*Bianca Trinkenreich,Marco Aurelio Gerosa,Anita Sarma,Igor Steinmacher*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文综述了软件开发和开源社区中的归属感研究，发现归属感特征包括信任、接纳、价值认可等，关联因素包括心理安全、内在动机等，并提出了包括及时认可、透明晋升规则、包容性福利、协作工具连接、无责事后分析等实用指南，以帮助减少开发者倦怠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 职业倦怠影响软件开发者的身心健康并导致人员流失，研究表明归属感缺失与更高倦怠水平相关，而归属感与韧性、工作满意度、参与度和幸福感正相关，因此需要为软件行业提供基于证据的归属感培养指导。

Method: 对软件开发和开源社区中的归属感研究进行综述，分析归属感的特征（如信任、接纳、价值认可、友谊、成员资格、相互支持、被了解）及其关联因素（包括认可、心理安全、内在动机、英语自信、任期、性别、文化权力距离），提出实用指南。

Result: 系统综述了归属感的特征（包括信任、接纳、价值认可、友谊、成员资格、相互支持、被了解）和关联因素（包括认可、心理安全、内在动机、英语自信、任期、性别、文化权力距离），并提出了一系列可操作的实践指南。

Conclusion: 提出了面向领导者和社区的实用指南，包括及时一致的认可、透明晋升规则、包容性福利和举措、通过协作工具建立有意联系、无责事后分析、可选线下聚会、非正式新人聚会、持续监测归属感和倦怠感。这些指南可帮助软件组织和开源社区培养更健康、更包容的环境，支持开发者福祉。

Abstract: Burnout affects software developers' mental and physical well-being and contributes to turnover, generating strong concerns in the software industry. Prior research has shown that lack of belonging is associated with higher levels of burnout among software developers, while a sense of belonging is linked to resilience, job satisfaction, engagement, and well-being. In this paper, we revisit recent studies on belongingness in software development teams, including proprietary software organizations and open-source software communities, to offer evidence-based guidelines for cultivating belongingness and reducing developer burnout. We summarize characteristics of belongingness, such as trust, acceptance, value recognition, friendship, membership, mutual support, and being known by others, as well as factors associated with belongingness, including recognition, psychological safety, intrinsic motivation, English confidence, tenure, gender, and cultural power distance. Based on these findings, we propose practical guidelines for leaders and communities, including timely and consistent recognition, transparent promotion rules, inclusive benefits and initiatives, intentional connections through collaborative tools, blameless postmortems, optional in-person opportunities, informal newcomer gatherings, and continuous monitoring of belongingness and burnout. These guidelines can help software organizations and open-source communities foster healthier, more inclusive environments that support developer well-being.

</details>


### [481] [SmellBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Architectural Code Smell Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07001)
*Ion George Dinu,Marian Cristian Mihăescu,Traian Rebedea*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 首次对LLM智能体在架构代码异味修复任务上的系统性评估。最佳智能体在65个高严重度架构异味上达到47.7%修复率，但存在修复激进性与代码库质量负相关的悖论——最激进智能体引入140个新异味，揭示当前LLM在跨模块架构重构方面的能力差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 架构代码异味(architectural code smells)会侵蚀软件可维护性且修复成本高昂。与本地化Bug不同，架构异味需要跨模块推理设计意图，这对开发者和自动化工具都构成挑战。尽管大语言模型在Bug修复和代码级重构上表现出色，但尚未探索其在架构代码异味修复方面的能力。

Method: 构建SmellBench任务编排框架，包含：1)针对不同异味类型的优化提示策略；2)支持迭代多步执行的机制；3)分别评估修复效果、误报识别和净代码库影响的评分方法。评估来自4个模型家族(GPT、Claude、Gemini、Mistral)的11种智能体配置，在scikit-learn项目中由PyExamine检测的65个高严重度架构异味上进行测试，结果经专家判断验证。

Result: 专家验证发现63.1%的检测异味为误报；最佳智能体达到47.7%的解决率；智能体识别误报的专家一致性可达κ=0.94；但修复激进性与净代码库质量呈负相关，最激进的智能体反而引入140个新异味。

Conclusion: 当前LLM在本地化代码转换方面的能力与跨模块重构所需的架构理解之间存在显著差距。SmellBench提供了可复用的基础设施，可用于追踪自动化软件工程这一未充分探索领域的研究进展。代码和数据已开源(https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19247588)。

Abstract: Architectural code smells erode software maintainability and are costly to repair manually, yet unlike localized bugs, they require cross-module reasoning about design intent that challenges both developers and automated tools. While large language model agents excel at bug fixing and code-level refactoring, their ability to repair architectural code smells remains unexplored. We present the first empirical evaluation of LLM agents on architectural code smell repair. We contribute SmellBench, a task orchestration framework that incorporates smell-type-specific optimized prompts and supports iterative multi-step execution, together with a scoring methodology that separately evaluates repair effectiveness, false positive identification, and net codebase impact. We evaluate 11 agent configurations from four model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Mistral) on 65 hard-severity architectural smells detected by PyExamine in the Python project scikit-learn, validated against expert judgments. Expert validation reveals that 63.1% of detected smells are false positives, while the best agent achieves a 47.7% resolution rate. Agents identify false positives with up to $κ= 0.94$ expert agreement, but repair aggressiveness and net codebase quality are inversely related: the most aggressive agent introduces 140 new smells. These findings expose a gap between current LLM capabilities in localized code transformations and the architectural understanding needed for cross-module refactoring. SmellBench provides reusable infrastructure for tracking progress on this underexplored dimension of automated software engineering. We release our code and data at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19247588.

</details>


### [482] [SARC: A Governance-by-Architecture Framework for Agentic AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07728)
*Gaston Besanson*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SARC是一个面向工具使用型AI智能体的运行时治理架构，将约束作为一等规范对象，通过四个执行站点（预行动门、行动时监控器、行动后审计器、升级路由器）在运行时强制执行，而非依赖提示词、仪表盘或事后文档。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI治理控制与AI执行之间存在结构性错位：在受监管环境中，必须约束执行的义务通常只在执行发生后才被评估。这种prompt-level或post-hoc的治理方式无法满足合规场景对实时约束的需求。

Method: SARC将约束声明为包含来源、类别、谓词、验证点、响应协议和操作点的规范对象，编译到智能体循环的四个执行点中；形式化规范-轨迹对应所需的最小不变量；证明有限奖励惩罚不能替代硬运行时约束；扩展到多智能体工作流（约束传播、权限交集、归因保留的轨迹树）。

Result: 在采购任务上对比5种基线方法：SARC在精确谓词下执行零次硬约束违反；声明的PAA节流响应使软窗口超限相对减少89.5%；谓词噪声和执行失败扫描表明残余硬违反源于执行栈错误而非环境机会。

Conclusion: SARC为义务的可执行、可检查、可审计提供了架构基础，使约束能够在运行时被强制执行而非事后评估。

Abstract: Agentic AI systems increasingly act through tools, sub-agents, and external services, but governance controls are still commonly attached to prompts, dashboards, or post-hoc documentation. This creates a structural mismatch in regulated settings: obligations that must constrain execution are often evaluated only after execution has occurred. We introduce SARC, a runtime governance architecture for tool-using agents that treats constraints as first-class specification objects alongside state, action space, and reward. A SARC specification declares each constraint's source, class, predicate, verification point, response protocol, and operating point, and compiles these into four enforcement sites in the agent loop: a Pre-Action Gate, an Action-Time Monitor, a Post-Action Auditor, and an Escalation Router. We formalize the minimal invariants required for specification-trace correspondence, show why finite reward penalties do not generally substitute for hard runtime constraints, and extend the architecture to multi-agent workflows through constraint propagation, authority intersection, and attribution-preserving trace trees. We implement a prototype audit checker and report a reproducible synthetic evaluation over 50 seeds comparing SARC against post-hoc audit, output filtering, workflow rules, and policy-as-code-only baselines on a procurement task. SARC executes zero hard-constraint violations under exact predicates; its declared PAA throttling response reduces soft-window overages by 89.5% relative to policy-as-code-only. Predicate-noise and enforcement-failure sweeps are consistent with the claim that residual hard violations under SARC scale with enforcement-stack error rather than environmental violation opportunity. SARC provides the architectural substrate through which obligations can be made executable, inspectable, and auditable at runtime.

</details>


### [483] [From Assistance to Agency: Rethinking Autonomy and Control in CI/CD Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07062)
*Marcus Emmanuel Barnes,Taher A. Ghaleb,Safwat Hassan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场/愿景型综述论文（Vision Paper）。核心观点：CI/CD 中的 AI 代理其核心难题不是提升任务性能，而是设计"权威转移"（authority transfer）——即在约束与申诉机制下把运营决策权从人控流水线移交给代理系统。作者提出"数据平面权威"（补丁生成、测试重跑等局部干预）与"控制平面权威"（修改流水线配置、部署策略、审批门禁）之区分，用以刻画"什么算 agentic""授权多少""控制权应归何处"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 代理正被部署到 CI/CD 流水线中（GitHub、GitLab、Amazon Q、Nx、Datadog Bits AI、Gitar 等），但学界缺乏共享词汇来刻画"CI/CD 何时算 agentic""委派了多少决策权""控制权应落在何处"，导致不同治理机制的系统难以比较。同时工业部署速度远超评测方法学发展。论文认为中心问题不是"提升修复性能"（capability），而是设计权威转移这一社会技术性问题。

Method: 方法为非系统性文献综述 + 代表性案例综合（明确声明非 systematic literature review）。素材来自两类：(1) 研究原型——Repairnator、R-HERO、RepairAgent、ChatRepair、BuildSheriff、LogSage、AutoGuard（RL 自愈控制层）、Bouzenia & Pradel 的 LLM 测试代理；(2) 工业平台公开文档——GitHub/GitLab/Amazon Q/Google、Nx Self-Healing CI、Datadog Bits AI Dev Agent、Gitar、Dagger 蓝图。分析框架：引入数据平面/控制平面权威二分，将 CI/CD 代理与自愈计算系统 MAPE-K 参考架构（Kephart & Chess 2003）类比，同时指出其局限（MAPE-K 假设单一受管元素与架构师全权控制反馈，而 CI/CD 的权威是"社会中介"的、多利益相关方共治）；据此提出三个概念性观察与四方向研究议程。

Result: 三项观察：(1) 约束自主（constrained autonomy）占主导——几乎所有被研究系统仅在预定义动作空间内行使受限权威，集成/合并决定仍由 PR/MR 人工把关；无任何公开系统将控制平面权威（部署策略、审批门禁、回滚阈值、工作流定义）在无人工批准下委派给代理；这被解释为组织将自动化吸收进治理敏感流程时的反复出现的增量轨迹，而非偶然。(2) 治理承担安全负担——安全性来自外部治理基础设施（PR 审批流、仓库权限、策略门禁），无形式化验证或内建安全约束；因此治理层成为"未经检验的单点信任"，随代理能力扩张风险放大。(3) 评测落后于部署——传统 CI/CD 指标（构建时长、部署频率、失败率）只面向确定性自动化，无法刻画决策质量、约束遵从、升级行为与长期治理影响；SWE-bench 等仅覆盖数据平面，缺控制平面维度。架构性风险还包括自主性升级的复合效应（局部合理的权限渐次扩展可能把发布治理从人工审核转向代理主导）与对抗鲁棒性（代理生成的工作流配置成为供应链攻击面；评审者可能对代理产物过度信任；日志/错误输出中的提示注入可操纵修复行为）。

Conclusion: Agentic CI/CD 应被刻画为"有界自主"（bounded autonomy），当前系统之所以安全，是因为把代理限制在数据平面，而该边界正日益受到挑战。权威转移是中心设计问题；研究议程按紧迫性排序为：(1) 控制平面安全与治理机制（策略感知代理、受约束动作合成、带形式化保证的自动回滚；需将 MAPE-K 扩展到社会中介权威与多利益相关方治理）；(2) 形式化自主边界（把自主度当作可配置设计参数而非涌现副产品，引入分级委派权威与运行时监控）；(3) 面向 agentic CI/CD 的评测框架（基准需报告修复成功率/修复时间、治理影响如 PR 迭代与人工覆盖频率、稳定性与回归、策略遵从度尤其是控制平面违规）；(4) 人机协同模型（明确责任边界以避免事故响应中的权威歧义与冲突动作）。局限：依赖公开工业文档，可能不完整或带营销倾向；领域演进快、长期成效证据有限，故强调权威与治理优先于长期有效性。

Abstract: AI agents are assuming active roles in Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) workflows, yet the research community lacks a shared vocabulary for describing what it means for CI/CD to be agentic, how much decision authority is delegated, and where control should reside. This paper presents a vision of agentic CI/CD in which the central challenge is not improving task performance but designing authority transfer, defined as the delegation of operational decisions from human-controlled pipelines to agent systems under specified constraints and recourse mechanisms.
  To structure this argument, we introduce a distinction between data-plane authority (localized interventions such as patch generation and test reruns) and control-plane authority (modifications to pipeline configuration, deployment policies, and approval gates). Drawing on research prototypes and industrial platforms, we show that current systems operate mainly at the data plane under bounded autonomy, with safety achieved through surrounding governance infrastructure rather than intrinsic agent guarantees. We identify three recurring patterns: constrained autonomy as the dominant design, external governance as the primary safety mechanism, and a widening gap between deployment momentum and evaluation methodology. We propose a research agenda in which control-plane safety and governance mechanisms represent the most urgent open problem, followed by formalization of autonomy boundaries, evaluation frameworks, and human--agent coordination.

</details>


### [484] [RepoZero: Can LLMs Generate a Code Repository from Scratch?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07122)
*Zhaoxi Zhang,Yiming Xu,Weikang Li,Jiahui Liang,Yunfang Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RepoZero 是一个首个支持全自动、基于执行结果的“从零生成整个代码仓库”评测基准。核心思路是把仓库生成重构为“仓库复现”：只给 Agent 提供原仓库的 API 规格与少量白盒测试，要求其用另一种语言重新实现，并通过字符串级输出等价性做黑盒验证。配套提出 ACE（Agentic Code-Test Evolution）迭代自测框架。实验显示最强模型/Agent 的通过率仅约 30%–55%，说明当前 LLM 仓库级生成能力与真实软件开发需求仍有显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码基准存在三大缺陷：(1) 大多聚焦补丁式（patch-based）仓库编辑或单文件补全，缺少“从零生成完整仓库”的评估；(2) 从零生成类基准（CodeS、EvoCodeBench、NL2RepoBench、E2EDevBench）因缺乏现成单元测试，只能依赖人工评审或 LLM-as-a-judge，引入主观偏差且复现性差；(3) 由于 LLM 在 GitHub 大规模语料上预训练，数据泄漏/记忆难以区分，且使用“冷门或新发布仓库”的做法天然限制了数据规模、需要频繁人工更新。此外，代码—测试反馈闭环（code-test loop）在既有工作流中难以采用，因为 LLM 生成的测试用例无法被独立验证，只能检验可执行性而不能检验功能正确性。因此需要一个可验证、可扩展、抗泄漏的仓库级生成评测基准。

Method: 基准设计：将“从零生成”转化为“仓库复现”，仅向 Agent 提供源仓库 API 功能规格、4 个白盒测试用例（含输入、真值输出、描述）及防投机约束（禁止外部包、禁止跨语言桥接调用、禁止读取源库源码），Agent 须以目标语言重新实现整个仓库并保持行为一致。数据构建：人工筛选源仓库（要求确定性、开源完整、架构复杂度足够），用 LLM 生成调用仓库 API 的测试文件（每文件 1–20 次 API 调用以调节难度），再由测试用例生成器产出输入输出对；每个测试用例在独立 Docker 容器中重复执行 20 次，剔除运行异常与非确定性输出（如指针地址、时间变量），有效用例少于 10 的样本被丢弃，每个样本约保留 40 个用例（20–60）。评测协议：黑盒测试（仅 4 个白盒用例入 prompt，其余隐藏）、环境隔离与只读权限、禁用外部依赖与跨语言调用。数据集含 RepoZero-Py2JS（400 样本，Python→JavaScript）与 RepoZero-C2Rust（200 样本，C/C++→Rust），并按 LOC、API 数量、输入输出复杂度（Claude-4.6-Opus/GLM-5/DeepSeek-V3.2 多模型多数投票）划分 Easy/Medium/Hard。ACE 框架：编码 Agent 生成仓库 → 测试 Agent 生成测试用例并用源仓库作为 oracle 取得真值输出（沿用同样的过滤策略）→ 全部通过则终止，否则把错误信息回传给编码 Agent 迭代修复，可与任意编码 Agent 组合。实验：在 OpenHands-bash 与 Mini-SWE-Agent 两种脚手架上评测 Kimi-K2.5/2.6、GLM-5/5.1、DeepSeek-V3.1/V3.2/V4、Ernie-5.0、Minimax-M2.5/2.7、Claude-4.6-Sonnet 等模型，指标为 Pass Rate（严格字符串级一致）与 Success Rate，并做成本-性能与失败模式分析。

Result: RepoZero 是首个同时满足仓库级、多语言、从零生成、执行验证、测试套件、自动可扩展、抗泄漏七个维度的基准。总体表现：OpenHands-bash 下 Py2JS 最佳为 Claude-4.6-Sonnet 51.46%，C2Rust 44.60%；Mini-SWE-Agent 下 Claude-4.6-Sonnet 达 54.70%/47.58%，且 Mini-SWE-Agent 普遍优于 OpenHands-bash（得益于更强的上下文工程，OpenHands-bash 甚至在 prompt 中给出的白盒用例上也失败）。最佳模型整体约 30%–55%，并随难度递减（Hard 明显低于 Easy）。基准效度符合“模型家族内性能代际递增”规律（Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek、Minimax 系列逐代提升），与行业基准排序一致；成本与通过率大致相关但非严格单调（如 GLM-5.1 成本近同 GLM-5 却大幅领先，开源与 Claude 之间仍有差距）。ACE 带来显著测试时扩展收益：以 DeepSeek V3.1 为骨干，Retry-0/1/2 下 OpenHands-bash 的 Py2JS 通过率由 26.08%→36.15%→42.88%，Mini-SWE-Agent 由 43.76%→45.67%→52.06%。失败分析归为四类：无法生成可执行代码、无法通过已给白盒用例、一般运行时错误、源/目标仓库输出不一致；运行时错误较少，约 40% 可执行代码的输出与源仓库不一致，说明“可运行≠语义正确”，凸显长上下文记忆与上下文漂移、以及自主测试驱动开发能力是决定性因素。

Conclusion: RepoZero 建立了首个可扩展、可自动执行验证的端到端仓库生成基准，证明当前最强 LLM 与 Agent 框架在此任务上仅有中等水平（整体约 40% 通过率），远低于真实软件开发要求；迭代式“代码—测试”闭环（ACE）是提升仓库级合成的有效范式，但其上限取决于 Agent 的自验证（生成高质量、可执行、可验证测试）能力，Agent 在该方面仍存在明显缺口。作者提出后续方向：(1) 发展面向全局仓库级推理的专门训练范式（强化学习、蒸馏）；(2) 设计衡量生成代码架构可读性与结构完整性的指标与约束；(3) 扩展到大规模、多语言与工业级软件开发场景，并补齐模型覆盖（因算力与成本限制，Mini-SWE-Agent 未纳入 GPT/Gemini 等闭源模型）。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown remarkable progress in code generation, yet their ability to construct complete software repositories from scratch remains poorly understood. A fundamental bottleneck is the lack of verifiable and scalable evaluation: existing benchmarks either focus on patch-based editing or rely on human or LLM-based judgments, which introduce bias and limit reproducibility. In this work, we present RepoZero, the first benchmark that enables fully automated, execution-based verification of repository-level generation from scratch. Our key idea is to reformulate generation as repository reproduction: given only API specifications, an agent must re-implement an entire repository such that its behavior matches the original implementation. This design allows for strict black-box validation via output equivalence, while naturally supporting large-scale construction by reusing existing open-source repositories. To further mitigate data leakage and shortcut solutions, we introduce cross-language constraints and a sandboxed evaluation protocol. Building on this benchmark, we propose an Agentic Code-Test Evolution (ACE) framework that performs iterative test generation and error-driven refinement, enabling effective test-time scaling for repository-level synthesis. Extensive experiments across multiple state-of-the-art LLMs and agent frameworks reveal that even the strongest LLM agents achieve only limited pass rates (30\% - 55\%), exposing a substantial gap between current capabilities and real-world software development requirements. Our results establish RepoZero as a challenging, scalable, and reliable testbed for end-to-end code generation, and highlight self-verification via test generation as a critical direction for advancing LLM-based coding agents.

</details>


### [485] [Low-code and no-code with BESSER to create and deploy smart web applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07376)
*Iván Alfonso,Armen Sulejmani,Aaron Conrardy,Jordi Cabot*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: BESSER是一个开源的低代码框架，通过基于Web的编辑器支持应用程序的设计、生成和部署，旨在解决现有商业低代码平台带来的供应商锁定和扩展性受限等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着包含AI智能体的Web应用（智能Web应用）需求不断增长，传统的应用开发方式已难以满足快速交付的需求，低代码开发范式应运而生，旨在通过模型抽象和自动化代码生成减少手写代码量。

Method: 提出BESSER开源低代码框架，用户可通过基于Web的可视化编辑器设计应用模型，由框架自动生成应用程序代码并支持部署。框架基于模型驱动开发理念，将业务逻辑抽象为模型定义，结合代码生成器实现应用自动化构建。

Result: BESSER框架实现了应用程序的设计、生成与部署全流程支持，提供了透明且可扩展的低代码开发环境。

Conclusion: BESSER通过开源方式保证了平台的透明性和可扩展性，有效规避了商业低代码平台常见的供应商锁定风险、扩展性受限等问题，为开发者提供了自由可控的低代码解决方案。

Abstract: The increasing demand for web applications containing AI-agents, seen as smart web applications, has prompted the need for new techniques to facilitate their creation. Low-code has risen as an approach that reduces the amount of handwritten code by focusing on the abstraction of components in the form of models combined with automated generators to produce applications. Existing low-code platforms are commercial, leading to drawbacks such as the risk of vendor lock-in, limited extensibility, and more. We present the open-source BESSER low-code framework, which allows users to design, generate and deploy their application via a freely accessible web-based editor, while guaranteeing transparency and extensibility.

</details>


### [486] [Exploring CoCo Challenges in ML Engineering Teams: Insights From the Semiconductor Industry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07389)
*A. Azamnouri,M. Haug,L. Woltmann,M. Fritz,J. Bogner,S. Wagner*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究在全球化半导体公司中对ML工程团队的协作与沟通（CoCo）挑战进行了定性调研，通过访谈12名从业者，识别出16个反复出现的挑战，其中角色和职责不清晰最为关键，并提出了缓解CoCo问题的有效实践建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习集成到复杂软件系统增加了团队协作与沟通的挑战。现有研究多聚焦于软件中心型企业，对硬件中心环境（如半导体行业）中CoCo挑战如何呈现缺乏实证理解。硬件中心环境具有严格数据治理、长开发周期、与物理过程紧密耦合等额外约束，这些约束会放大协调复杂性并降低灵活性。

Method: 在全球半导体公司中进行定性调研，访谈12名从业者，调查其CoCo实践、工具、挑战和方法。

Result: 识别出16个反复出现的CoCo挑战，其中"角色和职责不清晰"被确定为最关键挑战。同时归纳出从业者认为能有效缓解CoCo问题的常见实践和推荐方案。

Conclusion: 尽管研究基于单一组织背景，但发现与跨学科ML启用系统开发中的已知问题一致，同时揭示了这些挑战在硬件驱动约束下如何以不同方式呈现。结果为未来研究和工具支持指明了方向，以加强ML工程项目的CoCo并确保ML启用系统的成功。

Abstract: The integration of machine learning (ML) into complex software systems has increased challenges in collaboration and communication (CoCo) of the teams building these systems. ML engineering (MLE) teams often involve diverse roles, ML engineers, data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts, each bringing unique goals, experiences, and jargon. These interdisciplinary dynamics can make it challenging to deploy, reproduce, and maintain ML-enabled systems over the long term. Previous studies have uncovered several CoCo challenges and practices, but most have focused on software-centric companies, leaving limited empirical understanding of how these dynamics unfold in hardware-centric contexts. In hardware-centric environments, CoCo challenges are shaped by additional constraints such as strict data governance, long development cycles, and tight coupling with physical processes, which amplify coordination complexity and reduce flexibility. To strengthen empirical understanding in such settings, we present a qualitative investigation of MLE teams within a global semiconductor company, where ML-enabled systems and manufacturing processes introduce additional complexity. We interviewed 12 practitioners regarding CoCo practices, tools, challenges, and approaches. Through analysis, we identified 16 recurring challenges, with unclear roles and responsibilities emerging as the most critical, and common practices and recommendations practitioners considered effective in mitigating CoCo problems. While grounded in a single organizational context, our findings align with known issues in interdisciplinary ML-enabled systems development, but also demonstrate how these challenges manifest differently under hardware-driven constraints. Our results highlight directions for future research and tool support to strengthen CoCo in MLE projects and ensure the success of ML-enabled systems.

</details>


### [487] [Boosting Automatic Java-to-Cangjie Translation with Multi-Stage LLM Training and Error Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07403)
*Xinyue Liang,Jingxuan Zhang,Lin Li,Jun Zhang,Junhao Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出了一个多阶段训练框架，利用迭代错误修复技术将Java代码翻译为Cangjie代码，解决了低资源编程语言翻译中语法错误和语义对齐的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着Cangjie新兴编程语言的崛起，对其生态系统的需求增长，但现有大型语言模型受限于Cangjie知识不足和并行语料稀缺，在代码翻译中容易出现语法错误和语义结构错位。现有方法依赖大规模并行数据微调，无法可靠提升低资源语言的编译性和语义一致性。

Method: 提出了一个多阶段训练框架，包括：1) 构建句法知识和单语指令数据集训练LLM；2) 在训练过程中逐步整合知识，实现语义对齐和结构感知；3) 结合编译器反馈和错误修复案例检索来修复错误的Cangjie代码；4) 构建Cangjie错误修复库支持错误修复流程。

Result: 实验结果表明，在有限并行数据条件下，该方法相比现有最优方法将功能等价性提升了6.06%。消融实验验证了每个训练阶段都对最终性能有正向贡献。

Conclusion: 该多阶段训练框架结合迭代错误修复技术能够有效提升低资源编程语言的代码翻译质量，为新兴编程语言的生态建设提供了可行的自动化翻译方案。

Abstract: With the rapid evolution of emerging programming language ecosystems, the demand for code translation to low-resource languages continues to grow. As Cangjie emerges as a new programming language, its ecosystem and development toolchains are rapidly expanding. Automated translation from popular programming languages to Cangjie is therefore valuable for practical development. However, constrained by both insufficient Cangjie knowledge and scarce parallel code corpora, general Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to syntactic errors and semantic as well as structural misalignment in code translation. Existing approaches typically rely on fine-tuning with large-scale parallel data, but they cannot reliably improve compilability or semantic consistency for low-resource Cangjie languages. To tackle these challenges, we propose a multi-stage training framework of LLMs that employs the iterative error repair technique to translate Java code into Cangjie code. This training framework performs training on LLMs, gradually integrating knowledge and achieving semantic alignment as well as structure awareness. During the code translation, we also combine the compiler feedback and error repair case retrieval to repair the incorrect Cangjie code. We construct syntactic knowledge and monolingual instruction datasets to train the LLM. In addition, we also build a Cangjie error repair repository to support error repair in our approach. Experimental results show that, with limited parallel data, our approach improves functional equivalence by 6.06\% compared to the state-of-the-art approaches. Meanwhile, ablation studies confirm that each training stage positively contributes to the final performance.

</details>


### [488] [Prompt Engineering Strategies for LLM-based Qualitative Coding of Psychological Safety in Software Engineering Communities: A Controlled Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07422)
*Moaath Alshaikh,Tasneem Alshaher,Ricardo Vieira,Beatriz Santana,Clelio Xavier,Jose Amancio,Glauco Carneiro,Julio Leite,Savio Freire,Manoel Mendonca*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究通过受控实验评估了三种LLM（Claude Haiku、DeepSeek-Chat、Gemini 2.5 Flash）在定性编码任务中的表现，发现多样本提示策略可显著提升部分模型的编码一致性，但模型间稳定性差异显著，且存在系统性预测偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 定性分析在软件工程研究中至关重要，但传统人工编码过程耗时且易受主观因素影响。LLM虽有望辅助该过程，但其可靠性尚未得到充分验证。

Method: 采用受控实验设计，评估三种LLM在零样本和多样本两种提示策略下的表现，使用Cohen's kappa作为一致性指标，每种配置进行10次独立运行。

Result: 多样本提示显著提升Claude Haiku的一致性（Delta kappa = +0.034, p = 0.004），但对DeepSeek-Chat和Gemini 2.5 Flash无显著影响。模型稳定性差异明显：DeepSeek-Chat和Claude Haiku最稳定（SD ≈ 0.017），Gemini 2.5 Flash最不稳定（SD = 0.038）。所有模型均存在系统性过度预测"分享负面反馈"（偏差比高达5.25倍）和低估"表达担忧"的倾向。

Conclusion: 该研究为LLM辅助定性编码的提示工程提供了实证依据，表明多样本策略的效果因模型而异，且需关注系统性预测偏差问题。

Abstract: Qualitative analysis plays a pivotal role in understanding the human and social aspects of software engineering. However, it remains a demanding process shaped by the subjective interpretation of individual researchers and sensitive to methodological choices such as prompt design. Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising opportunities to support this type of analysis, although their reliability in reproducing human qualitative reasoning under varying prompting conditions remains largely untested. This study presents a controlled empirical evaluation of three LLMs -- Claude Haiku, DeepSeek-Chat, and Gemini 2.5 Flash -- across two prompt engineering strategies (zero-shot and multi-shot closed coding), using Cohen's kappa as the primary agreement metric over ten independent runs per configuration. Results suggest that multi-shot prompting significantly improves agreement for Claude Haiku (Delta kappa = +0.034, Wilcoxon p = 0.004) but not for DeepSeek-Chat or Gemini 2.5 Flash. Intra-model stability varies substantially -- DeepSeek-Chat and Claude Haiku exhibit the lowest variance (SD approx. 0.017), while Gemini 2.5 Flash is the least stable (SD = 0.038). A systematic over-prediction of "Sharing Negative Feedback" is identified across all models (bias ratios up to 5.25x), alongside consistent under-prediction of "Expressing Concerns." Collectively, these findings provide empirical evidence for prompt engineering guidelines in LLM-assisted qualitative coding for software engineering research.

</details>


### [489] [MASPrism: Lightweight Failure Attribution for Multi-Agent Systems Using Prefill-Stage Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07509)
*Yang Liu,Hongjiang Feng,Junsong Pu,Zhuangbin Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: MASPrism 是一个面向 LLM 多智能体系统的轻量级失败归因框架：仅用小模型（Qwen3-0.6B）的两次 prefill（前向填充）过程所暴露的内部信号——步级 token 负对数似然（NLL）与注意力权重——来定位失败原因，全程不生成任何输出 token、不做回放、不训练专用归因模型。Filtering 阶段在按步截断的紧凑 trace 上用 NLL 找“症状步”、用症状步的注意力聚合找上游候选源；Diagnosis 阶段恢复这些关键步的完整内容后重新计算信号，用注意力×NLL 差异打分并做多症状共识排序，输出带“症状→源”链接的候选列表。Who&When-HC Top-1 从 20.68% 提升到 27.59%（相对 +33.41%），TRAIL 上 Loc. Acc. 0.591（GAIA）/0.451（SWE-bench），超过 Gemini-2.5-Pro（相对 +8.24%/+89.50%），单条 trace 平均 2.66 秒、7,066 输入 token、0 输出 token，相对 A2P 提速 6.69×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统执行失败时，需从长 trace 中找出真正导致失败的步骤。但该任务有三重困难：(1) 单次执行包含大量 agent 动作、消息与工具调用，搜索空间巨大；(2) 引入错误的早期步骤往往局部看似合理，其影响经后续 agent/工具传播后才在晚期暴露，故“症状步”与“根因步”不一致，且开发者只有失败 trace 与用户请求、无正确答案作为 oracle；(3) 现有三类自动化方法代价高或条件受限：agent-based 方法（GPT-4o 的 all-at-once/step-by-step/binary search、A2P 等）需在长上下文上解码并调用大模型，token 与延迟成本高；replay-based 方法（如 FAMAS）需反复重放执行，涉及外部工具时成本极高；training-based 方法（如 AgenTracer、Aegis）依赖人工注入错误合成训练数据，故障注入模式覆盖有限、泛化风险高。因此需要一个可大规模部署、免解码、免回放、免任务特定训练的失败归因框架。

Method: 框架以 trace L={s1..sN} 为输入，仅调用同一 SLM 的两次 prefill：(1) Filtering——将每个步骤按等额 token 预算截断为固定长度前缀并加省略标记 [...]，前置“trace 已截断”的系统提示，一次 prefill 中按步平均 token NLL 得 N_i，识别症状集 M（并用 error/exception 等显式失败词做后处理加权），再以步间注意力 A_{i→j}（对所有头与最后 20% 层的注意力均匀平均）计算候选分 H_k=Σ_{m∈M,k<m} A_{m→k}，取 top-K=5 得候选集 C；(2) Diagnosis——重建 prompt，把 M 与 C 的步骤恢复全文、其余步骤仅保留短前缀，并在最早症状步前插入“该步异常，请向前追溯”的指令，第二次 prefill 重新计算 N_i 与 A_{i→j}，更新症状集 M′；对每个症状 m 与更早步 k 计算 s_{k|m}= (A_{m→k}/Ā_m)·(1+max(0, N_m−N_k))，即归一化注意力乘以方向性 NLL 差异权重（仅在症状比候选更“意外”时正向增强）；再以 Fuse(k)=Σ_m s_{k|m} 与共识因子 Score(k)=Fuse(k)·(1+λ|V_k|)（λ=0.3，V_k 为把 k 排进其前五的症状集合）排序，输出带症状—源链接的候选失败源列表。超参：Who&When 症状比例 20%，TRAIL 50%；K=5；无采样/解码/随机搜索，结果确定性。

Result: Who&When：HC Top-1 27.59%（最佳基线 A2P/GLM-5.1 为 20.68%，相对提升 33.41%；GPT-4o 三种策略最高仅 8.77%）；AG Top-1 36.51%，略低于 A2P 的 43.65%，优于 AgenTracer 37.30% 与 GPT-4o。TRAIL Loc. Acc.：GAIA 0.591（超 OpenAI o3 0.535 约 10.47%、超 Gemini-2.5-Pro 0.546 约 8.24%）；SWE-bench 0.451（超 Gemini-2.5-Pro 0.238 达 89.50%，且 o3、Claude-3.7 因上下文超限 CLE 失败而 MASPrism 可执行）。RQ2：GT 源步获得的症状注意力质量显著高于 GT 邻居与随机早期步（HC 均值差 5.24×10⁻³，p=1.90×10⁻⁹ / 9.82×10⁻⁹；AG p=3.31×10⁻⁵ / 4.98×10⁻²，Wilcoxon 单侧检验）。RQ3 消融：去掉 Diagnosis 或去掉 prompt 恢复后 HC 降至 5.17%；去掉 Filtering（原始 trace 单遍）在 GAIA 降至 0.222 且 117 个 GAIA 样本中 73 次 OOM、HC 11 次失败。RQ4：单 trace 平均 2.66 秒、7,066 输入 token、0 输出 token，A2P 为 17.82 秒、17,748 输入、620 输出 token（6.69× 提速）；跨模型鲁棒性上 Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B、Llama-3.2-1B/3B 均可用，Llama-3.2-3B 取得最高 SWE-bench 0.5116，Qwen3-0.6B 在 HC 命中数 16 与更大模型相当。

Conclusion: MASPrism 证明：语言模型在前向读取 trace 时已自然计算出的内部信号（token 级 NLL 与注意力）足以支撑“从症状回溯到源”的失败归因，无需解码诊断文本、执行回放或任务特定训练，因而可在保持竞争力的同时大幅降低延迟与 token 成本，尤其在长 trace 上具备部署稳定性，并天然输出可检查的候选列表与症状—源链接以支持人工调试工作流。其定位是“诊断路由与排序证据”而非严格因果估计，输出为需人工复核的优先级线索而非确认根因；作者指出未来工作包括分数校准、混合成功/失败 trace 上的误报控制、trace 级可疑度聚合与在线升级策略。部署前提是能访问 prefill 内部量（开源权重 SLM），仅 API 的闭源服务不在其直接目标内；应用形态是把轻量 SLM 作为昂贵主 agent 之下的“诊断层”。

Abstract: Failure attribution in LLM-based multi-agent systems aims to identify the steps that contribute to a failed execution. This task remains difficult because a single execution can contain many agent actions and tool calls, failure evidence can appear many steps after the original mistake, and existing methods often rely on costly agent workflows, replay, or training on synthetic failure logs. To address these challenges, we propose MASPrism, a lightweight framework that performs failure attribution using prefill-stage signals from a small language model (SLM). MASPrism first extracts token-level negative log-likelihood and attention weights during a prefill pass to identify symptom-like steps and earlier candidate sources, without decoding. It then reconstructs a focused diagnostic prompt and performs a second prefill pass to rank failure-source candidates. Using Qwen3-0.6B as the SLM, MASPrism achieves the best performance on three of the four evaluated subsets across Who&When and TRAIL, improving Top-1 accuracy on Who&When-HC by 33.41% over the best baseline. On TRAIL, MASPrism outperforms strong proprietary LLMs, including Gemini-2.5-Pro, with up to 89.50% relative improvement. MASPrism processes each trace in 2.66 seconds on average, achieving a 6.69$\times$ speedup over the single-pass prompting baseline, with zero output tokens. These results show that MASPrism provides an effective and practical framework for failure attribution in long multi-agent execution logs.

</details>


### [490] [Can LLMs Solve Science or Just Write Code? Evaluating Quantum Solver Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07525)
*Luciano Baresi,Domenico Bianculli,Maryse Ernzer,Livia Lestingi,Fabrizio Pastore,Seung Yeob Shin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Q-SAGE是一种迭代方法，用于评估大语言模型(LLM)生成量子科学问题求解器的能力。通过执行LLM生成的代码、对比经典求解器结果、并在容差阈值内迭代优化代码来评估模型能力。实验涵盖5类科学问题与5种LLM，结果表明迭代优化显著提升成功率但带来显著计算开销；模型能力增强后，失败模式从执行错误转向数值不准确，揭示了当前LLM量子软件的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子计算中，成功执行生成的代码并不足够，结果必须数值精确。量子求解器的生成面临非平凡映射、混合量子-经典工作流和算法近似等挑战，需要评估LLM在科学问题求解器生成方面的真实能力。

Method: 采用迭代方法：执行LLM生成的脚本，将其结果与经典求解器结果对比，若不匹配则迭代优化脚本直到两者在容差阈值内一致。使用5个不同复杂度的科学问题家族和5种LLM（开源与闭源）进行实证评估。

Result: 迭代优化显著提升成功率，但引入显著计算开销；随着模型能力提升，失败模式从执行错误转变为数值不准确。

Conclusion: 当前LLM量子软件的主要局限已从"能否执行"转变为"数值是否准确"，为后续改进指明方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong capabilities in code generation, motivating their use in automated quantum solver development. However, in quantum computing, successful execution of generated code is not sufficient: correctness depends on numerically accurate results, which are sensitive to non-trivial mappings, hybrid quantum-classical workflows, and algorithm-specific approximations. This work introduces Q-SAGE, an iterative methodology to evaluate LLMs' capability in generating quantum solvers for scientific problems. The methodology adopts an iterative approach by executing the script generated by the LLM, comparing the result with the result of a classical solver, and refining the script until the two results match within a tolerance threshold. We empirically evaluated the methodology with five families of scientific problems of different complexities and five LLMs, both open source and proprietary. The results show that iterative refinement substantially improves success rates, but introduces a significant computational overhead. Moreover, as model capability increases, failure modes shift from execution errors to numerical inaccuracies, highlighting the current limitations of LLM-based quantum software.

</details>


### [491] [System Test Generation for Virtual Reality Applications using Scenario Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07534)
*Gerry Longfils,Maxime Cauz,Arnaud Blouin,Xavier Devroey*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出UltraInstinctVR，一种针对VR应用的自动化测试方法，通过预定义VR模型自动生成和执行测试。实验在10个开源VR应用上评估，结果表明该方法在覆盖率和故障检测方面优于现有自动化VR测试工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VR应用在外科手术训练、工业营销等领域应用广泛，但其长期采用和维护受限，主要原因是缺乏针对VR特性的有效、系统化、可复现的软件测试方法。

Method: UltraInstinctVR基于预定义的VR模型（场景），自动化生成和执行具体的VR系统测试。实验采用10个开源VR应用，将该方法与现有最先进的自动化VR测试方法进行比较。

Result: UltraInstinctVR在检测独特故障方面优于现有自动化工具，能够有效识别VR应用中的真实缺陷，并提供有价值的缺陷发现洞察。

Conclusion: UltraInstinctVR是一种有效的VR应用测试方法，可弥补现有测试工具的不足，为VR应用的可靠性和质量保障提供了新途径。

Abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) applications are increasingly being integrated across a wide range of domains, including surgical training and industrial marketing. However, the long-term adoption and maintenance of VR applications remain limited, particularly due to the lack of effective, systematic, and reproducible software testing approaches tailored to their unique characteristics. To address this issue, we introduce UltraInstinctVR, a novel testing approach for VR applications. Relying on predefined VR models (scenarios), it automates the generation and execution of concrete VR system tests. In our empirical evaluation, we compare UltraInstinctVR with state-of-the-art automated VR testing approaches in terms of coverage and failure detection on 10 open-source VR applications. The results show that UltraInstinctVR outperforms existing automated tools for detecting unique failures and provides valuable insights for identifying real-world bugs in VR applications.

</details>


### [492] [Characterizing and Mitigating False-Positive Bug Reports in the Linux Kernel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07678)
*Jiashuo Tian,Dong Wang,Chen Yang,Haichi Wang,Zan Wang,Junjie Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文首次对Linux内核中的假阳性bug报告进行了全面的实证研究。通过手动构建包含2,006份bug报告的数据集，发现假阳性报告需要与真实bug相当的工作量，且主要发生在文件系统和驱动程序中，原因包括外部依赖和语义误解。评估表明，检索增强生成（RAG）在自动化检测中表现最佳，达到91%召回率和88%的F1分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 假阳性bug报告是Linux内核开发中一个重要但未被充分探索的问题。当正确的系统行为被错误标记为缺陷时，会消耗开发人员精力、误导开发者、浪费调试资源，并延迟真实bug的修复。

Method: 手动构建数据集：2,006份bug报告（1,509个真实bug + 497个假阳性），数据来源于Bugzilla和Syzkaller。评估了多种大语言模型提示策略，包括检索增强生成（RAG）。

Result: 假阳性报告需要与真实bug相当的工作量（通常需要延长讨论和非平凡的关闭时间）。假阳性多发于文件系统和驱动程序组件，主要由外部依赖和语义误解引起。RAG表现最佳，达到91%召回率和88% F1分数。

Conclusion: 该研究首次全面揭示了Linux内核中假阳性bug报告的显著成本，表明大语言模型（尤其是RAG方法）在提高内核开发效率方面具有重要潜力。

Abstract: False-positive bug reports represent a significant yet underexplored challenge in the development and maintenance of the Linux kernel. They occur when correct system behavior is mistakenly flagged as a defect, consuming developer effort without leading to actual code improvements. Such reports can mislead developers, waste debugging resources, and delay the resolution of real bugs. In this paper, we present the first comprehensive empirical study of false-positive bug reports in the Linux kernel. We manually construct a dataset of 2,006 bug reports comprising 1,509 genuine bugs and 497 false positives collected from Bugzilla and Syzkaller. Our analysis indicates that false positives demand effort comparable to real bugs, often requiring extended discussions and non-trivial closure time. They occur in several components, especially File Systems and Drivers, mainly due to external dependencies and semantic misunderstandings. To address this challenge, we evaluate large language models (LLMs) for automated false-positive bug report mitigation. Among various prompting strategies, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) performs best, achieving 91% recall and an F1 score of 88%. These findings highlight the non-negligible cost of false positive bug reports and show the promise of LLMs for more efficient false positive mitigation in the Linux kernel.

</details>


### [493] [SafeTune: Search-based Harmfulness Minimisation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07709)
*Giordano d'Aloisio,David Williams,Giusy Annunziata,Zhiwei Fei,Antinisca Di Marco,Federica Sarro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出SafeTune方法，通过超参数调优和系统提示工程来降低LLM响应危害性并提升相关性。该方法在Qwen3.5 0.8B上显著减少有害响应率并提高提示-响应相关性，发现鼓励响应重复是最有效的影响因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型(LLM)的广泛采用引发了对模型响应潜在危害性的担忧

Method: 提出SafeTune，一种基于多目标搜索的方法，通过超参数调优和系统提示工程来减轻响应危害性并提升相关性

Result: SafeTune在Qwen3.5 0.8B上显著降低了有害响应率，同时提高了提示-响应相关性（均具有较大的效应量）

Conclusion: 在探索的参数中，鼓励响应中更大的重复性在减少危害性和增加相关性方面最为有效

Abstract: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) raises concerns about the potential harmfulness of their responses. In this paper, we first investigate the harmfulness of responses from four general-purpose LLMs. Next, we propose SafeTune, a multi-objective search-based approach to mitigate harmfulness while increasing response relevance through hyperparameter tuning and system prompt engineering. Our initial evaluation shows that SafeTune significantly reduces the rate of harmful responses generated by Qwen3.5 0.8B and increases prompt-response relevance (both with a large effect size). Among the parameters we explore, we also find that encouraging greater repetition in responses is most impactful in reducing harmfulness while increasing relevance.

</details>


### [494] [The AI-Native Large-Scale Agile Software Development Manifesto](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07717)
*Ricardo Britto,Fredrik Palmgren,Nishrith Saini,Marcus Ohlin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文（Ericsson 与 Blekinge 理工学院的 Ricardo Britto、Fredrik Palmgren、Nishrith Saini、Marcus Ohlin 提出）是一篇立场/宣言型论文，提出"AI 原生的大规模敏捷软件开发宣言"。核心主张：当 LLM 智能体成为一等参与者而非外围工具时，大规模软件开发应从"会议驱动、文档繁重、顺序交接"的过程，重构为"智能、自适应、持续学习的系统"——即"人类意图 + 机器速度"（human intent, machine velocity）。全文以五条价值观对照表和六大原则（The New Process / New Teams / New Artifacts / New Assurance / Extended Workforce / New Reuse）展开，并给出 AI-native Blueprint、语义层（多域知识图谱）、平台工程支撑与未来演进方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管敏捷方法广泛落地，"真正的规模化敏捷"仍难以实现：现有大规模框架（SAFe、LeSS）以人为中心、依赖协调会议、制品同步与基于角色的交接，抑制了实时适应；同时 AI/LLM 已在个体层面（Copilot、Kiro、Claude Code）证明生产率增益，但其对组织级敏捷性的潜力尚未被探索。作者希望弥合"AI 工具化"与"AI 原生组织设计"之间的空白，指出大规模敏捷的四大障碍：碎片化协调、知识孤岛、质量保障不一致、分布式团队共享理解难以维持，导致反馈变慢、集成成本上升、系统级敏捷性退化。

Method: 采用宣言式（manifesto）研究范式，类比敏捷宣言的结构：先陈述"我们珍视什么"的价值观对照（左优于右），再给出系统性的原则与支撑性架构描述。无实证实验或用户研究，主要通过工业实践者的经验整合与设计推演论证。方法论要点包括：（1）提出 AI-native 愿景的三个强化维度——流程从顺序交接转向连续意图驱动的螺旋、制品从静态文档转向活结构化知识、团队从人机协作转向智能体自主贡献；（2）定义 Persona（角色身份/能力与判断视角）、Agent（执行引擎，拥有指令、Skills、环境与模型）、Skill（可复用能力）三个核心构造，由 supervisor 智能体编排角色化子智能体，各自限定上下文以缓解上下文溢出；（3）以统一语义层整合 Architecture、Code、Security、Dev-Intelligence 四类知识图谱，支撑跨域影响分析、事实锚定推理与"分析→决策→执行"闭环；（4）以 BDD/Given-When-Then 规格作为验证先行的契约，由智能体管理跨团队场景爆炸与冲突；（5）引入可复用蓝图（蓝图平台）与"golden paths"作为护栏，实现一致性与本地自治的平衡。

Result: 给出了完整的宣言文本与配套原则体系：（a）价值观——共享上下文与活知识 > 会议与静态文档；人类意图与 AI 执行 > 手工交接；并行持续验证 > 顺序阶段门；编排式 AI 劳动力 > 孤立工具辅助；可复用蓝图 + 本地适配 > 僵化框架或重复发明；（b）六原则——并行化流程、意图驱动的团队与"Human in Control"治理、活知识制品（AI 友好、版本受控、可追溯可回放）、验证先行（先由规格生成测试与验收标准）、编排智能体作为扩展劳动力、以蓝图为中心的新型复用；（c）AI-native Blueprint：端到端跨职能团队（架构、安全、验证、UX、DevOps 专家 persona）+ 本地智能体 + 云端智能体 + MCP 服务器 + 语义层/领域知识图谱，覆盖需求分析到并行工作流的循环迭代；（d）平台工程作为使能器，同时服务人类与智能体；（e）未来方向：更自主的智能体团队、更丰富的语义层（纳入组织学习与决策依据）、跨组织蓝图生态、agent orchestration/knowledge engineering/AI governance 等新职业角色，并提及"dark software factory"（仅智能体编码、人类仅指定行为与意图）。作者强调这是范式转移而非人力替代：瓶颈从"执行"转向"方向"。

Conclusion: 当 AI 能以机器速度执行开发活动时，规模化敏捷的瓶颈从执行转向方向。AI 原生大规模敏捷的核心是：以人类意图为中心，把 AI 智能体作为编排化、上下文感知的劳动力，把知识与制品变为可持续自我维护的活体系统，把保障从事后检查变为事前验证，从而实现更快反馈、更高质量与规模化的持续适应。宣言并非取代人类，而是把人的工作提升到定义"构建什么、为何重要、结果是否正确"，由 AI 处理"如何做"并以人无法企及的速度与规模推进；该框架需随技术演进持续修订，智能体自主性、语义层丰富度、蓝图生态与新治理角色的成熟将决定其落地程度。

Abstract: Despite the widespread adoption of agile methods, achieving true agility at scale remains elusive. Large-scale agile frameworks remain largely human-centric and manual, relying on coordination meetings, artifact synchronization, and role-based handoffs that inhibit real-time adaptation. Meanwhile, rapid advances in AI, particularly large language models, have begun transforming software engineering, yet their potential for organizational-level agility remains underexplored. We present the AI-Native Large-Scale Agile Software Development Manifesto: a set of values and principles that redefine how large-scale software development is organized when AI becomes a first-class participant rather than a peripheral tool. The manifesto is grounded in six principles, parallel processes, intent-driven teams, living knowledge, verification-first assurance, orchestrated agent workforces, and reusable blueprints, that together shift development from a meeting-driven, document-heavy, sequential process to an intelligent, adaptive, continuously learning system.

</details>


### [495] [Securing the Dark Matter: A Semantic-Enhanced Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Supply Chain Analysis of Opaque Industrial Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07737)
*Bowei Ning,Xuejun Zong,Lian Lian,Kan He,Yifei Sun,Yuxiang Lei,Plamen Vasilev*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出名为 SCAA 的语义增强神经-符号框架，面向无源码、无符号表的工业/ICS 剥离二进制固件做软件供应链漏洞检测。核心思路是把"二进制→行为语义"的恢复形式化为抽象解释的 Galois 连接，并用 Reflexive Prompting（教师 DeepSeek-v3 → Joern 结构化验证器 → 学生 Qwen3-7B）抑制 LLM 幻觉；再用满射图变换 Φ 将百万节点 CPG 压缩为千级实体、带 8 类漏洞关系的软件供应链知识图（SSCKG）；随后用领域自适应 Graphormer（注意力偏置由关系语义权重调制）做长程风险传播推理与复合风险分数（类 PageRank 幂迭代），并在嵌入空间做 APT 指纹子图匹配以检出零日。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关键基础设施软件通常以剥离符号、闭源的二进制形式交付，源码、清单（package.json 等）与标准编译元数据缺失，导致依赖"透明度假设"的 SCA/SBOM 工具完全失效，形成"透明度悖论"——监管要求深度可见，而厂商交付不透明固件。现有三类范式各有缺口：(1) 图方法（Reveal、SySeVR、VulDecgre）保留结构拓扑，但剥离后节点退化为无语义的 opcode 占位符，且消息传递 GNN 的 k-hop 感受野无法覆盖工业供应链中 10–15 跳的漏洞传播链（过平滑）；(2) LLM 方法（DeepSeek-Coder、GPT-4）语义丰富但缺乏工业领域知识，且在无结构验证器约束时会幻觉数据流拓扑，导致高召回低精确率；(3) 工业分析工具（angr、固件模糊测试、运行时监控）受状态爆炸与"环境墙"限制，难以模拟专有硬件外设。既有混合方法（如 GRACE、CodeQL）要么把 LLM 当黑盒预言机/特征抽取器而缺乏独立结构验证与形式化保证，要么锚定源码级标识符无法泛化到剥离二进制。因此需要一种能在不透明二进制上恢复行为语义、并可扩展地做全局风险推理的自动化方法。

Method: 四阶段流水线 SCAA：
(1) 二进制→CPG 抽取：用 Ghidra/Joern 将 PE/ELF/固件统一为含 AST/CFG/PDG 的 CPG G=(V,E)。
(2) Semantic Lifting（抽象解释）：定义来自 MITRE ATT&CK for ICS 的三层抽象格 A（5 大类 / 27 具体动作 / 43 风险上下文标签，偏序为包含关系，⊤ 为 Unknown）；建立 Galois 连接 (α,γ)，用 LLM 近似抽象迁移函数 F♯，要求满足可靠性条件 α(F(c)) ⊑ F♯(α(c))（允许过近似、禁止欠近似）；因 LLM 概率性无法绝对可靠，改用经验违反率 EVR 度量。Reflexive Prompting：DeepSeek-v3 教师按 [控制流前驱/映射指令/严格 JSON] 模板生成基本块语义摘要；Joern CPG 服务器作为结构化 oracle 遍历教师声明的数据流路径，UNSAT 则判为幻觉并拒绝（拒绝率 15.8%，17,814 条中拒 2,814 条）；保留的 15,000 条指令—行为对经 QLoRA（rank=16、α=32、lr=2e-4、5 epoch）微调 Qwen3-7B 学生模型。
(3) SSCKG 构建：满射变换 Φ（非同构，引入语义并塌缩冗余节点）包含实体提升 Φ_E——按基本块/函数体做规则式结构塌缩，再对外部库与跨模块函数用 Sentence-BERT(all-MiniLM-L6-v2) 嵌入 + DBSCAN(ε=0.3, min_samples=2) 做语义聚类（选 DBSCAN 因簇数先验未知且可识别噪声点）；以及关系抽取 Φ_R——从 CPG 边与 NVD 匹配派生 8 类关系本体 Σ_R（结构类 calls/depends_on/imports，数据流类 reads_from/writes_to，漏洞类 taints/reaches/vulnerable_to）。
(4) 风险推理与 APT 指纹：领域自适应 Graphormer（6 层、8 头、隐层 256、12.4M 参数；先在 Big-Vul SSCKG 预训练再在 NVD-Precise 微调 50 epoch），注意力偏置在最短路径偏置外加入边类型偏置 b_φ(e_ij)·w_vu，使 taints/reaches 权重高于 calls/imports；复合风险分数 ρ_r(v)=β·ρ_inherent+(1−β)·归一化邻居加权传播，用幂迭代求解（L1 收敛阈值 1e-6，20–30 次迭代，行随机权重矩阵保证 Perron–Frobenius 收敛），形式上类似以 ρ_inherent 为个性化向量的 Personalized PageRank；ρ_inherent 取实体行为摘要与 NVD 中 ICS CVE 描述的 SBERT 最大余弦相似度；β=0.15。APT 指纹取自 MITRE Engenuity ICS APT 数据集经完整流水线生成 SSCKG 后由专家裁剪（如 Stuxnet 仅保留 s7comm 注入子图），覆盖 Stuxnet/Triton/HAVEX/BlackEnergy/Industroyer 共 5 个指纹；匹配用非对称平均最佳余弦相似度（在 Graphormer 嵌入空间替代 NP-难的子图同构），阈值 τ_apt 通过网格搜索最大化 Youden's J 并约束 FPR≤5% 得 0.78。
实验：三个数据集（Big-Vul 188,636/10,900；NVD-Precise 工业子集 3,218/487，由 Tasking/Keil/GCC-ARM 以 -O2 编译并剥离符号；InduVul 1,247/59，来自 50 款真实 ICS 固件），70/10/20 分层划分且同一二进制的函数不跨分割；5 个基线（SySeVR、Reveal、VulDeePecker、DeepSeek-Coder、GRACE）统一使用 Ghidra 反编译输入；指标含 Pr/Rc/F1/MCC/FPR、APT 用 ROC-AUC、语义提升用 EVR 与 Cohen's κ；InduGuard 混合虚拟-物理测试床（5 家 ICS 厂商实机 + WinCC/CIMPLICITY/InTouch/TwinCAT 虚拟栈，GRFICSv2 环境），50 镜像静态可扩展性 + 15 个高影响 CVE 动态验证，对比 Black Duck、Nessus、Claroty、Ghidra 手工、GRACE、DeepSeek-Coder。

Result: RQ1：三个数据集上全面领先，Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 p<0.01。InduVul 上 F1=89.4%、MCC=0.82、P=91.2%、R=87.7%，比最强基线 GRACE 高 12.8 F1 点与 0.14 MCC；跨数据集退化仅 −1.3 点，而基线退化 −3.4~−8.8 点（Reveal 最差 −8.8）。DeepSeek-Coder 召回最高 88.1% 但精确率最低 65.4%。RQ2 消融：去 Semantic Lifting 掉 15.2 F1（长路径召回从 83.1% 降到 54.3% 的 GCN 情形体现 Graphormer 全局注意力作用，long-path 召回净增 28.8 点），去 Graphormer 换 GCN 掉 7.8，去 Reflexive Prompting 掉 6.5，去领域边编码掉 3.6（精确率掉 4.8）。RQ3：APT 检测 InduVul AUC=0.91、FPR=3.8% 时召回 72.0%；10 个保留零日检出 7 个（70%），漏检 3 个均为控制流型攻击（固件回滚、PLC 周期时间隐蔽信道、供应链替换）；单指纹阈值仅 +1.2% 且 p=0.34 不显著；Stuxnet 类“合法但异常”案例相似度 0.94 vs τ=0.78，五个基线全部判为良性。RQ4：Golden Set 500 函数（Cohen's κ=0.83，38 例分歧经协商解决）语义对齐 94.2%、EVR=5.8%；比 vanilla Qwen3-7B(28.8%) 降 4.7 倍、比 GPT-4 零样本(17.2%) 降 3.0 倍；Hardware 降 6.0 倍最显著；Cryptography 最差 16.4%（7 例完全漏判全为密码学，源于厂商定制 AES 与编译器优化/循环展开）；误差分类为欠规范 48.3%、误分类 27.6%、完全漏判 24.1%；Big-Vul 上 EVR 8.4%（Crypto 22.1%）。RQ5：β=0.15、τ_apt=0.78、ε=0.30 为最优，F1 在全测试区间内波动不超过 3.2 点；SSCKG 压缩率在三数据集稳定约 250×（CPG 32.4万→1280、61.2万→2510、84.7万→3420 实体），噪声点 4.2–5.8%。RQ6：50 镜像平均 42 s（H20）/67 s（RTX 4090 4bit 量化仅 6.2 GB 显存、完全离线），FP 从 Black Duck 的 145/镜像降至 12（−91.7%）、比 GPT-4 的 82 降 85.4%，FPR 2.8%，0 日检出 70%（Black Duck 0%、GPT-4 15%）；混合测试床 15 个 CVE 中 14 个完全检出（93.3%）、1 个部分（Triton 相似度 0.74 低于阈值），Nessus/Claroty 各仅 7 个完全检出、GRACE 仅 1 个；APT 类 2/3 检出（Stuxnet 0.94、BlackEnergy 0.86）。

Conclusion: 论文主张"透明度悖论"可通过在剥离二进制上做语义接地（semantically grounded）的神经-符号分析加以破解：把抽象解释的 Galois 连接引入 LLM 程序分析，可为"LLM 做代码理解"首次提供可度量的可靠性上界（以 EVR 形式），而非让 LLM 作无验证的黑盒预言机；同时把代码知识图从"源码语法图"推进为"行为抽象图"（SSCKG，含多跳漏洞传播的 8 类带类型关系），并用领域自适应 Graphormer + 嵌入空间指纹匹配解决长程传播与零日/APT 检出问题。实践上可支撑"行为化 SBOM"（回答"哪些组件真正 reach 到敏感操作"），契合 EO 14028、NIST SP 800-82、IEC 62443 的合规需求，且显著降低分析师误报负荷。局限包括：密码学语义难恢复（EVR 16.4%）、7B 学生模型 24 GB 显存限制边缘部署、42–67 s 延迟仅适合周期性固件准入而非在线 IDS（工业控制周期 10–100 ms）、对加壳/控制流平坦化的鲁棒性不足、无持续学习导致概念漂移、仅单二进制内推理（无跨二进制 communicates_with/authenticates_to 边）、依赖厂商披露导致的标签结构性假阴性，以及实验集中于 ICS 域的外部效度限制。后续方向：Dynamic Analysis Agent（将高风险路径接入 KLEE/Z3 求解器给出确定性可达性证明）、precompute-then-match 预计算嵌入实现近实时告警、蒸馏压缩到 sub-1B/4 GB 边缘部署、QEMU+自动脱壳提升抗混淆、弹性权重巩固式持续学习、OT 流量驱动的跨二进制关系扩展，以及映射到 SPDX/CycloneDX 与联邦式指纹共享。

Abstract: Automated vulnerability detection in critical-infrastructure software confronts a fundamental barrier: industrial software is routinely deployed as stripped, symbol-free binaries that deprive conventional Software Composition Analysis of the source-level transparency it requires. Existing binary analysis techniques close this Semantic Gap only partially -- graph-based detectors preserve structural syntax but discard behavioral semantics, while large language models supply rich semantic cues at the cost of unstable, hallucination-prone inference. To address this gap, we present a semantic-enhanced neuro-symbolic framework that reconstructs behavioral semantics directly from opaque binaries and performs tractable global risk reasoning. Three tightly coupled mechanisms drive this capability: (1) abstract interpretation combined with a reflexive prompting pipeline that structurally constrains a local LLM agent, effectively suppressing hallucinations; (2) a surjective transformation that compresses raw Code Property Graphs into typed Software Supply Chain Knowledge Graphs amenable to scalable reasoning; and (3) a domain-adapted Graphormer that captures long-range vulnerability propagation, augmented by embedding-space subgraph matching to uncover zero-day and APT-style attack patterns. Evaluated across three benchmarks of increasing domain specificity, the framework consistently outperforms all baselines on detection accuracy, semantic lifting fidelity, and APT fingerprint matching. Deployment on a hybrid virtual-physical testbed incorporating production-grade hardware from five ICS vendors further confirms strong detection coverage of high-impact CVEs while substantially reducing false-positive rates relative to leading commercial tools.

</details>


### [496] [Coding Agents Don't Know When to Act](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07769)
*Thibaud Gloaguen,Niels Mündler,Mark Müller,Veselin Raychev,Martin Vechev*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出基准 FixedBench（200 个已人工核验、无需改动的 SWE-bench Verified 任务），系统评测 5 个模型 × 4 个智能体框架，发现即使是前沿模型也会在 35%–65% 的已修复问题上产生不必要修改，暴露出 LLM 的“行动偏置”；显式提示“先复现、可弃权”可把弃权率提升至 80–88%，但会引入“过度弃权”这一对称失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在真实的自主软件维护流水线中，智能体会收到大量重复/过期的 bug 报告（文献显示最高可达 49%），而现有代码基准全部考察“必须动手修”的场景，从未系统评测智能体能否识别“代码已经正确、无需改动”并主动弃权。这一能力是无人值守维护的前提，却缺乏基准与量化；作者还怀疑当前模型的 RL 后训练目标以“产出补丁”为主导，缺少对“是否该行动”的判定训练，从而形成任务框架层面的过度依赖人类提示。

Method: 基准构建：从 SWE-bench Verified 随机抽取 200 个实例，预先施加黄金补丁构造 Resolved（已解决）任务；用弱模型 GPT-5 nano 生成不通过的补丁构造 Partial（部分修复）任务；另有 Novel 任务作为对照。场景分为 Best（有 git 历史、环境已配置）与 Worst（移除 .git、未配置环境）；另做“已存在正确测试文件”的扩展场景。指标：Resolution Rate（黄金测试是否全通过）与 Abstention Rate（剔除注释/文档/测试后净补丁为空）。提示变体四类：Issue（基线）、Edit（要求改代码）、Reproduce（先复现再修）、Abstain or Fix（先复现，若已解决则弃权）。模型：Sonnet-4.6、GPT-5.3 Codex、GPT-5.4 mini、Gemini-3 Pro、Qwen3.5-122B，配套 Claude Code / Codex / Gemini-CLI / Qwen-Code，另有 SORCAR+GPT-5.3 Codex。分析手段：人工检视 50 条轨迹定义 10 类行为，用 GPT-5.4 作为多标签评审（与人工一致率 precision 80.5%、recall 75.0%），并做思考预算（thinking effort）、场景、提示等消融；显著性用 McNemar 检验，95% 置信区间。
